text:
Sarguzasht-e-Meraj ka tasalsul. Pas Aap ﷺ ne na to Sakhra ki aisi ta'zim ki jaise Yahud karte the ke namaz bhi اسی ke peeche parhte the balke اسی ko qibla bana rakha tha. Chunke Hazrat Ka'ab Rahimahullah bhi Islam se pehle Yahudi the is liye Aap ne aisi rai pesh ki thi jise Khalifatul Muslimeen ne thukra diya aur na Aap ne Nasraniyon ki tarah Sakhra ki aihanat ki ke unhon ne to use kora karkat dalne ki jagah bana rakha tha, balke Aap ne khud us ke aas paas se kora utha kar phenka. Yeh bilkul us hadis ke mushabeh hai jis mein hai ke na to qabron par baitho na un ki taraf namaz ada karo. 

Aik taweel riwayat Meraj ki babat Abu Hurairah R.A se Gharb wali bhi marwi hai, us mein hai ke Jibraeel aur Mikaeel A.S ke laye hue pani ke tasht se use dhoya aur Aap ke seene ko khol diya, sab ghil-o-ghash door kar diya aur ilm-o-hilm, iman-o-yaqin se us par kya Islam bhar diya aur Aap ke donon kandhon ke darmiyan Mohar-e-Nubuwwat laga di. Aur aik ghore par bitha kar Aap ko Hazrat Jibraeel A.S le chale, dekha aik kaum hai idhar kheti kaat ti hai idhar barh jati hai. Hazrat Jibraeel A.S se poocha yeh kaun log hain? Farmaya yeh Allah ki rah ke mujahid hain jin ki nekiyan saat saat sau tak barhti hain, jo kharch karen us ka badla pate hain, Allah Ta'ala behtareen Razzaq hai. 

Phir Aap ka guzar us kaum par hua jin ke sar patthron se kuchle ja rahe the, har bar theek ho jate aur phir kuchle jate, dam bhar ki unhein muhlat na milti thi. Main ne poocha yeh kaun log hain? Jibraeel A.S ne farmaya yeh woh log hain ke farz namazon ke waqt un ke sar bhari ho jaya karte the. 

Phir kuch logon ko main ne dekha ke un ke aage peeche dhajiyan latak rahi hain aur oont aur janwaron ki tarah kanton daar jahannami darakht charh chug rahe aur jahannam ke patthar aur angare kha rahe hain. Main ne kaha yeh kaise log hain? Farmaya apne maal ki zakat na dene wale. Allah ne un par koi zulm nahi kiya balke yeh khud apne janon par zulm karte the. 

Phir main ne aise logon ko dekha ke un ke samne aik handiya mein to saaf suthra gosht hai, dusri mein khabeeth sara bhasa ganda gosht hai. Yeh us acche gosht se to rok diye gaye hain aur us badbudar badmaza sare hue gosht ko kha rahe hain. Main ne sawal kiya yeh kis gunah ke murtakib hain? Jawab mila ke yeh woh mard hain jo apni halal biwiyon ko chor kar haram aurton ke paas raat guzarte the aur woh aurtein hain jo apne halal khawand ko chor kar auron ke han raat guzarti theen. 

Phir Aap ne dekha ke raste mein aik lakri hai ke har kapre ko phaar deti hai aur har cheez ko zakhmi kar deti hai. Poocha yeh kya hai? Farmaya yeh Aap ke un ummatiyon ki misaal hai jo raste rok kar baith jate hain, phir is aayat ko parha: 
(وَلَا تَقْعُدُوْا بِكُلِّ صِرَاطٍ تُوْعِدُوْنَ وَتَصُدُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ مَنْ اٰمَنَ بِهٖ وَتَبْغُوْنَهَا عِوَجًا) 
(7. Al-A'raf: 86) 
Yaani har har raste par logon ko khaufzada karne aur rah-e-haq se rokne ke liye na baitha karo.

Al-Kh phir dekha ke aik shakhs bahut bara dhair jama kiye hue hai jise utha nahi sakta phir bhi woh aur barha raha hai. Poocha Jibrail (A.S) yeh kya hai? Farmaya yeh aap ki ummat ka woh shakhs hai jis ke upar logon ke huquq is qadar hain ki woh hargaz ada nahi kar sakta taham woh aur huquq charha raha hai aur amanatein liye raha hai. Phir aap ne aik jama'at ko dekha jin ki zaban aur hont lohe ke qainchiyon se kaate ja rahe hain udhar kate, udhar durust ho gaye, phir kat gaye, yehi haal barabar jari hai. Poocha yeh kon log hain? Farmaya yeh fitne ke wa'iz aur khatib hain. Phir dekha ke aik chote se patthar ke surakh se aik bara bhari bail nikal raha hai phir woh lautna chahta hai lekin nahi ja sakta tha. Phir aap aik wadi mein pohnche wahan nihayat nafees khush-gawar thandi hawa aur dil khush kun mu'attar khushbudar rahat o sukoon ki mubarak sadaein sun kar aap ne poocha yeh kya hai? Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) ne farmaya yeh jannat ki awaz hai woh keh rahi hai ke ya Allah mujh se apna waada pura kar. Mere bala-khane, resham, moti, monge, sona, chandi, jaam, katoray aur pani, doodh, sharab waghera waghera naimatein bahut ziyada ho gayin. Ise Allah ki taraf se jawab mila ke har aik musalman momin mard o aurat jo mujhe aur mere rasoolon ko manta ho naik amal karta ho mere sath kisi ko sharik na karta ho mere barabar kisi ko na samajhta ho woh sab tujh mein dakhil honge. Sun jis ke dil mein mera dar hai woh har khauf se mehfooz hai. Jo mujh se sawal karta hai woh mahroom nahi rehta. Jo mujhe qarz deta hai main use badla deta hoon, jo mujh par tawakkul karta hai main use kifayat karta hoon woh mahroom nahi rehta. Jo mujhe qarz deta hai main use badla deta hoon, jo mujh par tawakkul karta hoon main use kifayat karta hoon, main sacha mabood hoon mere siwa aur koi mabood nahi. Mere waade khilaf nahi hote momin najat-yafta hain Allah Ta'ala babarakat hai jo sab se behtar khaliq hai. Yeh sun kar jannat ne kaha bas main khush ho gayi. Phir aap ek dusri wadi mein pohnche jahan nihayat buri aur bhayanak makrooh awazein aa rahi thin aur badbu thi aap ne is ki baabat bhi Jibrail (A.S) se poocha unhon ne batlaya ke yeh jahannam ki awaz hai woh keh rahi hai ke aie Allah mujh se apna waada kar aur mujhe woh de mere tauq o zanjeer, mere shole aur garmaai, mera thaur aur lahoo peep mere azab aur saza ke saman bahut waafir ho gaye hain mera gehrao bahut ziyada hai meri aag bahut tez hai yeh sun kar jahannam ne apni raza-mandi zahir ki. Aap phir chale yahan tak ke Bait-ul-Muqaddas pohnche utar kar sakhra mein apne ghore ko bandha andar ja kar farishton ke sath namaz ada ki faraghat ke baad unhon ne poocha ke Jibrail yeh aap ke sath kon hain? Aap ne farmaya Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain. Unhon ne kaha aap ki taraf bheja gaya? Farmaya haan, sab ne marhaba kaha ke behtareen bhai aur bahut hi ache khalifa hain aur bahut achhai aur izzat se aaye hain.

Phir aap ki mulaqat nabiyon ki roohon se hui sab ne apne Parvardigar ki sana bayan ki. Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ne farmaya: Allah ka shukr hai jis ne mujhe apna Khalil banaya aur mujhe bahut bara mulk diya aur meri ummat ko aise farmanbardar banaya ke un ki iqtida ki jati hai, usi ne mujhe aag se bacha liya aur ise mere liye thandak aur salamati bana di. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne farmaya: Allah hi ki meharbani hai ke us ne mujh se kalam kiya, mere dushmanon ko, Aal-e-Firaun ko halak kiya, Bani Israel ko mere hathon nijaat di, meri ummat mein aisi jamalat rakhi jo haq ki hadi aur haq ke sath adl karne wali thi. Phir Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) ne Allah Ta'ala ki sana bayan karni shuru ki ke Alhamdulillah Allah ne mujhe azeem-ush-shan mulk diya, mujhe Zaboor ka ilm diya, mere liye loha narm kar diya, paharon ko maskhar kar diya aur parindon ko bhi jo mere sath Allah ki tasbih karte the, mujhe hikmat aur pur-zor kalam ata farmaya. Phir Hazrat Sulaiman (Alaihis Salam) ne sana-khwani shuru ki ke Alhamdulillah Allah ne hawaon ko meri tabeh kar diya aur shayateen ko bhi ke woh mere farman ke mathet bare bare mehlaat aur naqshe aur bartan waghera banate the. Us ne mujhe janwaro ki guftgoo ke samajhne ka ilm farmaya. Har cheez mein mujhe fazilat di, insano ke, jinno ke, parindo ke lashkar mere mathet kar diye aur apne bahut se momin bando par mujhe fazilat di aur mujhe woh saltanat di jo mere baad kisi ke layq nahi aur woh bhi aisi jis mein pakeezgi thi aur koi hisab na tha. Phir Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ne Allah Ta'ala ki tareef bayan karni shuru ki ke us ne mujhe apna kalma banaya aur meri misal Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) ki si ki. Jise mitti se paida kar ke keh diya tha ke hoja aur woh ho gaye the, us ne mujhe Kitab-o-Hikmat, Taurat, Injeel sikhai. Main mitti ka parinda banata phir is mein phoonk marta to woh bi-hukm-il-Ilahi zinda parinda ban kar ur jata. Main bachpan ke andhon ko aur juzamiyon ko bi-hukm-il-Ilahi acha kar deta tha, murde Allah ki ijazat se zinda ho jate the. Mujhe us ne utha liya, mujhe pak saaf kar diya, mujhe aur meri walda ko shaitan se bacha liya, hum par shaitan ka kuch dakhal na tha. Ab Janab Rasool-e-Akhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Tum sab ne Allah ki tareefein bayan kar li ab main karta hoon. Allah hi ke liye hamd-o-sana hai jis ne mujhe Rahmat-lil-Alameen bana kar apni tamam makhlooq ke liye daranewala aur khushkhabari denewala bana kar bheja, mujh par Quran-e-Kareem nazil farmaya. Jis mein har cheez ka bayan hai, meri ummat ko tamam ummaton se afzal banaya jo ke auron ki bhalai ke liye banai gayi hai. Ise behtareen ummat banaya, inhi ko awwal ki aur akhir ki ummat banaya. Mera seena khol diya, mere bojh door kar diye, mera zikr buland kar diya, mujhe shuru karne wala aur khatam karne wala banaya. Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ne farmaya: Inhi wujooh se An-Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sab se afzal hain. Imam Abu Jafar Razi (Rahimahullah) farmate hain: Shuru karne wale aap hain yaani roz-e-qayamat shafaat aap hi se shuru hogi. Phir aap ke samne teen dhake hue bartan pesh kiye gaye.

Pani ke bartan mein se Aap ne thora sa pee kar wapas kardiya phir doodh ka bartan lekar Aap ne peet bhar kar doodh piya. Phir sharab ka bartan laya gaya toh Aap ne uske peene se inkar kardiya ke main shikam ser hochuka hoon. Hazrat Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) ne farmaya yeh aapki ummat par haram kardi jaane wali hai aur agar aap ise pee lete toh aapki ummat mein se aapke tabedar bahut hi kam hote. Phir Aap ko aasman ki taraf charhaya gaya darwaza khulwana chaha toh poocha gaya yeh kaun hain? Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) ne kaha Muhammad hain (ﷺ) poocha gaya kya aapki taraf bhej diya gaya? Farmaya haan, unhon ne kaha Allah Ta'ala is bhai aur khalifa ko khush rakhe yeh bare acche bhai aur nihayat umdah khalifa hain, usi waqt darwaza khol diya gaya. Aap ne dekha ke ek shakhs hain poori paidaish ke aam logon ki tarah unki paidaish mein koi nuqsaan nahi, unke daayein ek darwaza hai jahan se khushboo ki laptein aa rahi hain aur baayein jaanib ek darwaza hai jahan se khabees hawa aa rahi hai. Dahni taraf ke darwaze ko dekh kar hans dete hain aur khush hote hain aur baayein taraf ke darwaze ko dekh kar ro dete hain aur ghamgeen hojate hain. Main ne kaha Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) yeh shaikh poori paidaish wale kaun hain? Jin ki khilqat mein kuch bhi nahi ghata, aur yeh dono darwaze kaise hain? Jawab mila ke yeh aapke walid Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) hain, daayein jaanib jannat ka darwaza hai apni jannati aulaad ko dekh kar khush ho kar hans dete hain aur baayein jaanib jahannam ka darwaza hai aap apni dozakhi aulaad ko dekh kar ro dete hain aur ghamgeen hojate hain. Phir doosre aasman ki taraf charhe usi tarah ke sawal jawab ke baad darwaza khula, wahan Aap ne do jawano ko dekha, daryaft par maloom hua ke yeh Hazrat Isa bin Maryam aur Hazrat Yahya bin Zakariya (Alaihimas Salam) hain, yeh dono aapas mein khala zaad bhai hote hain. Phir usi tarah teesre aasman par pahuche, wahan Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ko paya jinhein husn mein aur logon par wahi fazilat thi jo chand ko baaki sitaron par. Phir chothe aasman par usi tarah pahuche wahan Hazrat Idris (Alaihis Salam) ko paya jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne buland makan par charha liya hai, phir Aap paanchwe aasman par bhi unhi sawalat-o-jawabat ke baad pahuche, dekha ke ek sahib baithe hue hain unke paas kuch log hain jo unse baatein kar rahe hain, poocha yeh kaun hain? Jawab mila ke Hazrat Harun (Alaihis Salam) hain jo apni qaum mein har dil-aziz the aur yeh log Bani Israel hain. Phir usi tarah chhathe aasman par pahuche, Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko dekha, Aap ke unse bhi aage nikal jaane par woh ro diye, daryaft karne par sabab yeh maloom hua ke Bani Israel meri nisbat yeh samajhte the ke tamam aulaad-e-Adam mein Allah ke paas sab se zyada buzurg main hoon lekin yeh hain mere khalifa jo duniya mein hain aur main aakhirat mein hoon, khair sirf yahi hote toh bhi chandaan mazaiqa na tha lekin har nabi ke sath unki ummat hai.

Phir aap usi tarah satween aasman par pohnche, wahan ek sahib ko dekha jin ki daadhi mein kuch safed baal thay, woh jannat ke darwaze par ek kursi lagaye baithe hue hain, un ke paas kuch aur log bhi hain, baaz ke chehre toh roshan hain aur baaz ke chehron par kuch kam chamak hai balki rang mein kuch aur bhi hai. Yeh log uthe aur nahar mein ek ghota lagaya jis se rang qadray nikhar gaya, phir doosri nahar mein nahaye, kuch aur nikhar gaye, phir teesri mein ghusal kiya, bilkul roshan safed chehre ho gaye, aa kar doosron ke sath mil kar baith gaye aur unhi jaise ho gaye. Aap ke sawal par Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) ne bataya ke yeh aap ke walid Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) hain, ro-e-zameen par safed baal sab se pehle unhi ke nikle, yeh safed munh wale woh imandar log hain jo buraiyon se bilkul bache rahe aur jin ke chehron ke rang mein kuch kodurat thi yeh woh log hain jin se nekiyon ke sath kuch budiyan bhi sarzad ho gayi theen, un ki tauba par Allah Ta'ala meherban ho gaya. Awwal nahar Allah ki rehmat hai, doosri nemat hai, teesri sharab-e-tahoor ki nahar hai jo jannatiyon ki khas sharab hai. Phir aap Sidrat-ul-Muntaha tak pohnche toh aap se kaha gaya ke aap hi ki sunnaton par jo pabandi kare woh yahan tak pohanchaya jata hai. Is ki jad se pakeeza pani ki, saaf suthray doodh ki, lazeez besha-e-nisha sharab ki aur saaf shehad ki nahrein jari theen. Is darakht ke saye mein koi sawar agar sattar saal bhi chala jaye taham is ka saya khatam nahi hota. Is ka ek ek patta itna bada hai ke ek ek ummat ko dhanp le. Allah Ta'ala Azza wa Jall ke noor ne ise charon taraf dhak rakha tha aur parind ki shakal ke farishton ne ise chupa liya tha jo Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ki mohabbat mein wahan thay. Us waqt Allah Ta'ala Jalla Shanuhu ne aap se baatein keen, farmaya ke mango kya mangte ho? Aap ne گزارش ki ke A Allah! Tu ne Ibrahim (A.S) ko apna khaleel banaya aur unhein bada mulk diya, Musa (A.S) se tu ne baatein keen, Dawood (A.S) ko azeem-ush-shaan saltanat di aur un ke liye loha narm kar diya, Sulaiman (A.S) ko tu ne badshahat di, jinnat, insan, shayateen, hawain un ke tab-e-farman keen aur woh badshahat di jo kisi ke layak un ke siwa nahi. Isa (A.S) ko tu ne Taurat o Injeel sikhai, apne hukm se andhon aur kodhiyon ko acha karne wala aur murdon ko zinda karne wala banaya, unhein aur un ki walida ko Shaitan-e-Rajeem se bachaya ke ise un par koi dakhal na tha, meri nisbat farman ho. Rab-ul-Alameen Azza wa Jall ne farmaya: Tu mera khaleel hai, Taurat mein main ne tujhe Khaleel-ur-Rahman ka laqab diya hai, tujhe tamam logon ki taraf basheer o nazeer bana kar bheja hai, tera seena khol diya hai, tera bojh utar diya hai, tera zikr buland kar diya hai, jahan mera zikr aaye wahan tera zikr bhi hota hai aur teri ummat ko main ne sab ummaton se behtar banaya hai jo logon ke liye zuhoor mein lai gayi hai, teri ummat ko behtareen ummat banaya hai, teri hi ummat ko awwaleen aur akhireen banaya hai, un ka khutba jayaz nahi jab tak woh tere bande aur Rasool hone ki shahadat na de lein.

Main ne teri ummat mein aise log banaye hain jin ke dil mein Al-Kitab hai. Tujhe az roo-e-paidaish sab se awwal kiya aur az roo-e-ba'sat ke sab se aakhir kiya aur az roo-e- faisla ke bhi sab se awwal kiya. Tujhe main ne saat aisi aayatein dein jo baar baar dohraayi jaati hain jo tujh se pehle kisi nabi ko nahi milin. Tujhe main ne apne arsh tale se Surah Al-Baqarah ke khaatme ki aayatein dein jo tujh se pehle kisi nabi ko nahi di gayin. Main ne tujhe Kausar ata farmayi aur main ne tujhe Islam ke aath hisse diye: Islam, hijrat, jihad, namaz, sadaqa, Ramzan ke rozey, neki ka hukum, burai se rok. Aur main ne tujhe shuru karne wala aur khatam karne wala banaya. 

Pas Aap farmane lage mujhe mere Rabb ne chhe baaton ki fazilat marhamat farmayi: Kalam ki ibtida aur us ki inteha di. Jami' baatein dein. Tamam logon ki taraf khushkhabri dene wala aur aagah karne wala bana kar bheja. Mere dushman mujh se mahina bhar ki raah par hon wohin se us ke dil mein mera raab daal diya gaya. Mere liye ghanimatein halal ki gayi jo mujh se pehle kisi ke liye halal nahi huin. Mere liye saari zameen masjid aur wazu banayi gayi. 

Phir Aap par pachaas namazon ke farz hone ka aur ba-mashwara Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam - A.S) takhfeef talab karne ka aur aakhir mein paanch reh jaane ka zikr hai. Jaise ke is se pehle guzar chuka hai, pas paanch rahin aur sawab pachaas ka jis se Aap bahut hi khush hue. Jaate waqt Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam - A.S) sakht the aur aate waqt nihayat narm aur sab se behtar. 

Aur kitab ki is hadith mein bhi hai ke isi ayat (Subhan Allazi) ki tafseer mein Aap ne yeh waqia bayan farmaya. Yeh bhi wazeh rahe ke is lambi hadith ka ek rawi Abu Jafar Razi ba-zahir hafiza ke kuch aise acche nahi maloom hote. Is ke baad alfaaz mein sakht gharabat aur bahut zyada nakarat hai. Inhein zaeef bhi kaha gaya hai aur sirf unhi ki riwayat wali hadith qabil-e-tawwajuh hai. Ek aur baat yeh hai ke khwab wali hadith ka kuch hissa bhi is mein aa gaya hai. Aur yeh bhi mumkin hai ke bahut si ahadees ka majmoo'a ho ya khwab ya Meraj ke siva kisi aur waqie ki is mein riwayat ho. Wallahu A'lam. 

Bukhari Muslim ki ek riwayat mein Aap se Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam - A.S), Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam - A.S), Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam - A.S) ka huliya bayan karna waghera bhi marwi hai. Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein Hatim mein Aap se Bait-ul-Maqdis ke sawalat kiye jaane aur phir us ke zahir ho jaane ka waqia bhi hai, is mein bhi un teenon nabiyon se mulaqat karne ka aur un ka huliya bayan hai aur yeh bhi ke Aap ne unhein namaz mein khada payaya. 

Aap ne Malik khazin-e-Jahannam ko bhi dekha aur unhon ne hi ibtida Aap se salam kiya. Baihaqi waghera mein kayi ek Sahaba (Razi Allahu Anhum / R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Umme Hani ke makan par soye hue the, Aap Isha ki namaz se farigh ho gaye the, wohin se Aap ko Meraj huyi. Phir Imam Hakim ne bahut lambi hadith bayan farmayi hai jis mein darjon ka aur farishton waghera ka zikr hai. Allah ki qudrat se to koi cheez ba'eed nahi bashart-e-ke woh riwayat sahih sabit ho jaye.

Imam Baihaqi (R.H) is روایت ko bayan kar ke farmatay hain ke Makkah Sharif se Bait-ul-Muqaddas tak janay aur Meraj ke baray mein is hadith mein poori kifayat hai lekin is riwayat ko bohat aimma-e-hadith ne mursal bayan kiya hai wallahu a'lam. Ab Hazrat Aishah (R.A) ki riwayat suniye. Baihaqi mein hai ke jab subh ke waqt logon se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is baat ka zikr kiya toh bohat se log murtad ho gaye jo is se pehlay ba-iman aur tasdeeq karnay walay thay, phir Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ke paas un ka jana aur aap ka sachaa manna aur Siddiq laqab pana marwi hai. Khud Hazrat Umme Hani (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Meraj meray hi makan se karai gayi hai us raat aap namaz-e-isha ke baad meray makan par aaram farma thay. Aap bhi so gaye aur hum sab bhi. Subh se kuch hi pehlay hum ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jagaya. Phir aap ke sath hi hum ne subh ki namaz ada ki toh aap ne farmaya Umme Hani maine tumharay sath hi isha ki namaz ada ki aur ab subh ki namaz mein bhi tumharay sath hi hoon is darmiyan mein Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe Bait-ul-Muqaddas pohanchaya aur maine wahan namaz bhi parhi. Aik rawi Kalbi matrook hai aur bilkul saqit hai lekin isay Abu Yala mein aur sanad se khoob tafseel se روایت kiya hai. Tabrani mein Hazrat Umme Hani (A.S) se manqool hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) shab-e-meraj meray han soye huwe thay maine raat ko aap ki harchand talash ki lekin na paya dar tha ke kahin Quraishiyon ne koi dhoka na kiya lekin Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke Jibrail (A.S) meray paas aaye aur mera hath tham kar mujhe lay chalay darwazay par aik janwar tha jo khuchar se chhota aur gadhe se ooncha tha mujhe us par sawar kiya phir mujhe Bait-ul-Muqaddas pohanchaya. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko dikhaya woh akhlaq mein aur soorat shakal mein bilkul meray mushabiH thay. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko dikhaya lambay qad ke seedhe baalon ke aisay thay jaisay Azdushanwa ke qabeelay ke log huwa kartay thay. Isi tarah mujhe Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko bhi dikhaya darmiyana qad safed surkhi mail rang bilkul aisay jaise Urwah bin Masood Saqafi hain. Dajjal ko dekha aik ankh us ki bilkul miti hui thi. Aisa tha jaise Qatan bin Abdul Uzza. Yeh farma kar acha ab main jata hoon jo kuch dekha hai woh Quraish se bayan karta hoon. Main ne aap ka daman tham liya aur arz kiya lillah aap apni qaum mein is khawab ko bayan na karen woh aap ko jhutlayen gay aap ki baat hargiz na manayenge aur agar bas chala toh aap ki bay-adabi karenge. Lekin aap ne jhatka mar kar apna daman meray hath se chhuda liya aur seedhe Quraish ke majma mein pohanch kar sari baatein bayan farma din. Jabair bin Mut'im kehne laga bas Hazrat aj humein maloom ho gaya agar aap sachay hotay toh aisi baat hum mein baith kar na kehte. Aik shakhs ne kaha kyun Hazrat? Rastay mein hamara falan qafila bhi mila tha? Aap ne farmaya han aur un ka aik oont kho gaya tha jis ki talash kar rahay thay. Kisi ne kaha aur falan qabeelay walon ke oont bhi rastay mein milay?

Aap ne farmaya woh bhi miley thay, falan jagah thay, un mein aik surkh rang oontni thi jis ka paon toot gaya tha, un ke paas aik baray piyaley mein pani tha, jisay main ne bhi piya. Unhon ne kaha achha, un ke oonton ki ginti batao, un mein charwahay kon kon thay, yeh bhi batao? Isi waqt Allah Ta'ala ne qafila aap ke samne kar diya, aap ne sari ginti bhi bata di aur charwahon ke naam bhi bata diye. Aik charwaha un mein Ibn Abi Quhafah thay aur yeh bhi farma diya ke kal subah ko woh Saniyah pahunch jayenge. Chunache us waqt aksar log ba-toor-e-azmaish Saniyah ja pahunche, dekha ke waqai qafila agaya hai. Un se poocha ke tumhara oont gum ho gaya tha? Unhon ne kaha durust hai, gum ho gaya tha. Dusray qafilay walon se poocha ke tumhari kisi surkh rang oontni ka paon toot gaya hai? Unhon ne kaha haan, yeh bhi sahi hai. Poocha kya tumharay paas bara piyala pani ka bhi tha? Abu Bakr R.A ne kaha haan, Allah ki qasam, usay to main ne khud rakha tha aur un mein se na kisi ne usay piya na woh pani giraya gaya. Beshak Muhammad ﷺ sachay hain. Yeh aap par iman laye aur us din se un ka naam Siddiq rakha gaya. 

"Fasl" 
In tamam ahadith ki waqfiyat ke baad jin mein sahih bhi hain, hasan bhi hain, zaeif bhi hain, kam az kam itna to zaroor maloom ho gaya ke Huzoor ﷺ ka Makkah Sharif se Bait-ul-Muqaddas tak le jana hua aur yeh bhi maloom ho gaya ke yeh sirf aik hi martaba hua hai. Go raviyon ki ibaratein is baab mein mukhtalif alfaz se hain, go un mein kami beshi bhi hai, yeh koi baat nahi aur siwaye Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) ke khata se paak hai kon? 

Baaz logon ne har aisi riwayat ko aik alag waqiya kaha hai aur is ke qayil huway hain ke yeh waqiya kayi baar hua, lekin yeh log bohat door nikal gaye aur bilkul anokhi baat kahi aur na janey ki jagah chaley gaye aur phir bhi matlab hasil na hua. 

Mata-akhirin mein se baaz ne aik aur hi tawajih pesh ki hai aur us par unhe bara naaz hai, woh yeh ke aik martaba to aap ko Makkah se sirf Bait-ul-Muqaddas tak ki sair hui, aik martaba Makkah se asmanon par charhaye gaye aur aik martaba Makkah se Bait-ul-Muqaddas aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas se asmanon tak. Lekin yeh qoul bhi baid-az-qiyas aur bilkul ghareeb hai. Salaf mein se to is ka koi qayil nahi. Agar aisa hota to khud An-Hazrat ﷺ khud hi usay khol kar bayan farma detay aur ravi aap se is ke baar baar honay ki riwayat bayan karte. 

Baqol Hazrat Zuhri, Me'raj ka yeh waqiya hijrat se aik saal pehlay ka hai. Urwah bhi yehi kehte hain. Sudi kehte hain chhe mah pehlay ka hai. 

Lihaza haq baat yeh hai ke An-Hazrat ﷺ ko jaagte mein na ke khwab mein Makkah Sharif se Bait-ul-Muqaddas tak ki isra karayi gayi. Us waqt aap Buraq par sawar thay. Masjid-e-Quds ke darwazay par aap ne Buraq ko bandha, wahan ja kar is ke qibla rukh tahiyyat-ul-masjid ke taur par do rakat namaz ada ki.

Phir mi'raj laaye gaye jo darjon wali hai aur ba-taur seerhi ke hai is se aap aasman-e-duniya par charhaye gaye phir saton aasmanon par pohanchaye gaye har aasman ke muqarrabin-e-Ilahi se mulaqatein huin Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) se un ke manazil-o-darajat ke mutabiq salam-o-laik hui chhate aasman mein Kalimullah (A.S) se aur saton mein Khalilullah (A.S) se mile phir un se bhi aage barh gaye (ﷺ wa ala sairil-anbiya alaihimus-salatu was-salam). Yahan tak ke aap mustawi mein pohnche jahan qaza-o-qadr ki qalamon ki awazein aap ne sunin. Sidratul-Muntaha ko dekha jis par azmat-e-Rabi chha rahi thi. Sone ki tiydiyan aur tarah tarah ke rang wahan par nazar aa rahe thay farishte charon taraf se ise ghere hue thay. Wahin par aap ne Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) ko un ki asli surat mein dekha jin ke chhe sau par thay. Wahin aap ne raf-raf sabz rang ka dekha. Jis ne aasman ke kinaron ko dhak rakha tha. Bait-ul-Ma'moor ki ziyarat ki jo Khalilullah alaih salawatullah ke zamini Ka'be ke theek upar aasmanon par hai, yehi aasmani Ka'ba hai. Khalilullah (A.S) is se tek lagaye baithe hue thay. Is mein har roz sattar hajar farishte ibadat-e-Rabbani ke liye jaate hain magar jo aaj gaye phir un ki bari qayamat tak nahi aati. Aap ne jannat dozakh dekhi, yehi Allah Ta'ala Rahman-o-Rahim ne pachas namazein farz kar ke phir takhfif kar di. Aur panch rakhein jo khas us ki rahmat thi. Is se namaz ki buzurgi aur fazilat bhi saf taur par zahir hai phir aap wapas Bait-ul-Maqdis ki taraf utre aur aap ke sath hi tamam Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) bhi utre wahan aap ne un sab ko namaz parhai jab ke namaz ka waqt ho gaya mumkin hai woh us din ki subh ki namaz ho. Han ba'z hazrat ka qaul hai ke imamat-e-anbiya aap ne aasmanon mein ki. Lekin sahih riwayat se bazahir yeh waqia Bait-ul-Maqdis ka maloom hota hai. Go ba'z riwayaton mein yeh bhi aaya hai ke jaate hue aap ne yeh namaz parhai lekin zahir yeh hai ke aap ne wapsi mein imamat karai. Is ki ek dalil to yeh hai ke jab aasmanon par Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) se aap ki mulaqat hoti hai toh aap har ek ki babat Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) se poochte hain ke yeh kaun hain? Agar Bait-ul-Maqdis mein hi un ki imamat aap ne karai hui hoti toh ab chandaan is sawal ki zarurat nahi rehti doosre yeh ke sab se pehle aur sab se bari gharz toh bulandi par Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ke huzoor mein hazir hona tha toh bazahir yehi baat sab par muqaddam thi. Jab yeh ho chuka aur aap par aur aap ki ummat par us raat mein jo fariza-e-namaz muqarrar hona tha toh bhi ho chuka, ab aap ko apne bhaiyon ke sath jama hone ka moqa mila aur un sab ke samne aap ki buzurgi aur fazilat zahir karne ke liye Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) ke ishare se aap ne imam ban kar unhein namaz parhai. Phir Bait-ul-Maqdis se ba-zariya Buraq aap wapas raat ke andhere aur subh ke kuch hi ujale ke waqt Makkah Sharif pohnch gaye.

Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Ab yeh jo marwi hai ke Aap ke samne doodh aur shahad aur sharab ya doodh aur pani pesh kiya gaya ya charon hi cheezein, is ki babat riwayaton mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh waqia Bait-ul-Muqaddas ka hai aur yeh bhi ke yeh waqia asmanon ka ho, lekin yeh ho sakta hai ke donon hi jagah yeh cheez Aap ke samne pesh hui ho is liye ke jaise kisi aane wale ke samne ba-taur mehmani ke kuch cheez rakhi jati hai usi tarah yeh tha wallahu a'lam. Phir is mein bhi logon ne ikhtilaf kiya hai ke Meraj Aap ke jism-o-rooh samet karai gayi thi? Ya sirf roohani taur par? Aksar Ulama-e-Kiram to yahi farmate hain ke jism-o-rooh samet Aap ko Meraj hui aur hui bhi jagte mein na ke ba-taur khwab ke. Haan is ka inkar nahi ke Huzoor ﷺ ko pehle khwab mein yahi cheezein dikhai gayi hon. Aap khwab mein jo kuch mulahiza farmate use usi tarah phir waqia mein jagte hue bhi mulahiza farma lete. Is ki bari daleel ek to yeh hai ke is ke baad ki baat koi bari ahem hai. Agar yeh waqia khwab ka mana jaye to khwab mein aisi baten dekh lena itna ahem nahi ke is ko bayan farmate hue Allah Ta'ala pehle se ba-taur ehsan aur ba-taur izhar-e-qudrat apni tasbeeh bayan kare. Phir agar yeh waqia khwab ka hi tha to kuffar is tarah jaldi se Aap ki takzeeb na karte, ek shakhs apna khwab aur khwab mein dekhi hui ajeeb cheezein bayan kar raha hai ya kare to koi wajah na thi ke bharbhada kar aa jayen aur sunte hi sakhti se inkar karne lagen. Phir jo log ke is se pehle Aap par iman la chuke the aur Aap ki risalat ko qubool kar chuke the kya wajah hai ke woh waqia-e-meraj ko sun kar Islam se phir jate hain? Is se bhi zahir hai ke Aap ne khwab ka qissa bayan nahi farmaya tha. Phir Quran ke lafz bi-abdihi par ghor kijiye. Abd ka itlaq rooh aur jism donon ke majmoo'e par aata hai. Phir Asra bi-abdihi lailan ka farmana is cheez ko aur saf kar deta hai ke woh apne bande ko raat ke thode se hisse mein le gaya. Is dekhne ko logon ki aazmayish ka sabab ayat (Wa ma ja'alanar-ru'yal-lati araynaka illa fitnatal-lin-nasi wash-shajarah-mal-'an-nata fil-qur'ani wa nukhaffifuhum fa ma yaziduhum illa tughyanan kabira) (17. Al-Isra: 60) mein farmaya gaya hai. Agar yeh khwab hi tha to is mein logon ki aisi bari kaun si aazmayish thi jise mustaqil taur par bayan farmaya jata? Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) is ayat ki tafseer mein farmate hain ke yeh aankhon ka dekhna tha jo Rasool Allah ﷺ ko dikhaya gaya (Bukhari). Khud Quran farmata hai ayat (Ma zaghal-basaru wa ma tagha) (53. An-Najm: 17) na to nigah behki na bhatki. Zahir hai ke basar yani nigah insan ki zat ka ek wasf hai na ke sirf rooh ka. Phir Buraq ki sawari ka laya jana aur us safed chamkeele janwar par sawar kara kar Aap ko le jana bhi isi ki daleel hai ke yeh waqia jagne ka aur jismani hai warna sirf rooh ke liye sawari ki zaroorat nahi wallahu a'lam.

Aur log kehte hain ki yeh Mairaj sirf roohani thi na ke jismani. Chunancha Muhammad bin Ishaq likhte hain ki Hazrat Muawiyah bin Abi Sufyan ka yeh qoul marwi hai ki Hazrat Ayesha R.A farmati hain ki jism gaib nahi hua tha balki roohani Mairaj thi. Is qoul ka inkar nahi kiya gaya kyunki Hasan R.H farmate hain ayat (Wa ma ja'alanar-ru'yal-lati araynaka illa fitnatal-lin-nasi wash-shajaratal-mal'unata fil-qur'an) (17. Al-Isra: 60) ayat utri hai. Aur Hazrat Ibrahim Khalil A.S ki nisbat khabar di hai ki unhon ne farmaya main ne khwab mein tera zabah karna dekha hai ab tu soch le kya dekhta hai? Phir yehi haal raha pas zahir hai ki Anbiya Alaihimas Salam par wahi jagte mein bhi aati hai aur khwab mein bhi. Huzoor ﷺ farmaya karte the ki meri aankhein so jati hain aur dil jagta rehta hai. Wallahu A'lam is mein se kaun si sachi baat thi? Aap gaye aur aap ne bahut si baatein dekhi jis haal mein bhi aap the sote ya jagte sab haq aur sach hai. Yeh to tha Muhammad bin Ishaq R.H ka qoul. Imam Ibn Jarir R.H ne is ki bahut kuch tardid ki hai aur har tarah isay radd kiya hai aur isay khilaf-e-zahir qarar diya hai ki alfaaz-e-Qurani ke sarasar khilaf yeh qoul hai phir is ke khilaf bahut si daleelein pesh ki hain jin mein se chand hum ne bhi upar bayan kar di hain. Wallahu A'lam. Faida: Ek nihayat umdah aur bahut zabardast faida is bayan mein is riwayat se hota hai jo Hafiz Abu Nuaim Asbahani Kitab Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein laye hain ki jab Dihyah bin Khalifa Rasulullah ﷺ ne Qaisar-e-Rum ke pas ba-taur qasid ke apne namah-e-mubarak ke sath bheja. Yeh gaye, ponche aur arab tajron ko jo mulk-e-Sham mein the Herqal ne jama kiya un mein Abu Sufyan Sakhr bin Harb tha aur us ke sathi Makkah ke doosre kafir bhi the phir us ne un se bahut se sawalat kiye jo Bukhari o Muslim waghera mein mazkoor hain. Abu Sufyan ki awwal se aakhir tak yehi koshish rahi ki kisi tarah Huzoor ﷺ ki burai aur haqarat us ke samne kare taaki badshah ka dil ka milan An-Hazrat ﷺ ki taraf na ho woh khud kehta hai ki main sirf is khauf se ghalat baatein karne aur tuhmatein dharne se baaz raha ki kahin mera koi jhoot us par khul na jaye phir to yeh meri baat ko jhutla dega aur bari nadamat hogi. Usi waqt dil mein khayal aa gaya aur main ne kaha badshah salamat suniye main ek waqia bayan karoon jis se aap par yeh baat khul jaye gi ki Muhammad ﷺ bare jhoote aadmi hain suniye ek din woh kehne laga ki us raat woh Makkah se chala aur aap ki is masjid mein yaani Bait-ul-Maqdas ki masjid Quds mein aaya aur phir wapas subh se pehle Makkah ponch gaya. Meri yeh baat sunte hi Bait-ul-Maqdas ka laat padri jo Shah-e-Rum ki is majlis mein us ke pas bari izzat se baitha tha foran hi bol utha ki yeh bilkul sach hai mujhe us raat ka ilm hai. Qaisar ne tajadub-khaiz nazar se us ki taraf dekha aur adab se poocha janab ko kaise maloom hua?

Us ne kaha suniye meri aadat thi aur yeh kaam maine apne mutalliq kar rakha tha ke jab tak Masjid-e-Sharif ke tamam darwaze apne hath se band na karoon sota na tha. Us raat mein darwaze band karne ko khada hua sab darwaze achhi tarah band kar diye lekin ek darwaza mujhse band na hosaka. Maine harchand zor lagaya lekin kuwaar apni jagah se sarka bhi nahi maine usi waqt apne aadmiyon ko aawaz di woh aaye hum sab ne mil kar taqat lagai lekin sab ke sab nakaam rahe. Bas yeh maloom ho raha tha ke goya hum kisi pahaad ko uski jagah se sarkana chahte hain lekin uska pahiya tak bhi to nahi hila. Maine badhai bulwaye unhon ne bahut tarqeebein keen, koshishein keen lekin woh bhi haar gaye aur kehne lage subh par rakhiye chunacha woh darwaza us shab yunhi raha dono kuwaar bilkul khule rahe. Subh hi jab main usi darwaze ke paas gaya to dekha ke uske paas kone mein jo chattaan patthar ki thi us mein ek surakh hai aur aisa maloom hota hai ke us mein raat ko kisi ne koi janwar bandha hai uske asar aur nishaan maujood the. Main samajh gaya aur maine usi waqt apni jamaat se kaha ke aaj ki raat hamari yeh masjid kisi Nabi ke liye khuli rakhi gayi aur usne yahan zaroor namaz ada ki hai. Yeh hadith bahut lambi hai. 

"Faida" - Hazrat Abu Al-Khatab Umar bin Wahiyah apni kitab "At-Tanwir fi Mawlid As-Siraj Al-Munir" mein Hazrat Anas (R.A) ki riwayat se Meraj ki hadith warid kar ke uske mutalliq nihayat umda kalam kar ke phir farmate hain Meraj ki hadith mutawatir hai. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab, Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Ibn Masood, Hazrat Abu Zar, Hazrat Malik bin Sa'sa'ah, Hazrat Abu Hurairah, Hazrat Abu Saeed, Hazrat Ibn Abbas, Hazrat Shaddad bin Aus, Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'b, Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Qaraz, Hazrat Abu Habah, Hazrat Abu Laila, Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar, Hazrat Jabir, Hazrat Huzaifah, Hazrat Buraidah, Hazrat Abu Ayyub, Hazrat Abu Umamah, Hazrat Samurah bin Jundub, Hazrat Abu Al-Khamra, Hazrat Suhaib Rumi, Hazrat Umme Hani, Hazrat Aishah, aur Hazrat Asma waghera se marwi hai (R.A) ajmaein. 

In mein se baaz ne to ise mutawwal bayan kiya hai aur baaz ne mukhtasar. Go in mein se baaz riwayatein sanad-e-sahih nahi lekin biljumla sehat ke sath waqia-e-meraj sabit hai aur musalman ijmaayi taur par iske qayil hain haan beshak zindiq aur mulhid log iske munkir hain woh Allah ke noorani chiragh ko apne munh ki phoonkon se bujhana chahte hain. Lekin woh poori roshni ke sath chamakta hua hi rahega kafiron ko bura lage.

Tufan-e-Nuh ke baad Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ke Meraj ke waqie ke bayaan ke baad apne paighambar Kalimullah Hazrat Musa ؑ ka zikr bayaan farmata hai. Quran-e-Kareem mein umoman yeh dono bayaan ek saath aaye hain. Isi tarah Taurat aur Quran ka bayaan bhi mila jula hota hai. Hazrat Musa ki kitab ka naam Taurat hai. Woh kitab Bani Israel ke liye hadi thi. Unhein hukum huwa tha ki Allah ke siva kisi aur ko wali aur madadgar aur mabood na samjhein. Har ek nabi Allah ki tauhid lekar aata raha hai. Phir unhein kaha jata hai ki aey un buzurgon ki aulado jinhein hum ne apne is ehsan se nawaza tha ki Tufan-e-Nuh ki aalami halakat se unhein bacha liya aur apne pyare nabi Hazrat Noah ؑ ke sath kashti par chadha liya tha. Tumhein apne bado ki tarah hamari shukr guzari karni chahiye. Dekho main ne tumhari taraf apne akhri rasool Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ko bheja hai. Marwi hai ki Hazrat Noah ؑ chunke khatay peetay gharaz har waqt Allah ki hamd-o-sana bayaan farmate thay is liye aap ko shukr guzar banda kaha gaya. Musnad Ahmad waghera mein farman-e-Rasool Allah ﷺ hai ki Allah Ta'ala apne is bande se bahut khush hota hai jo nawala khaye to Allah ka shukr baja laye aur pani ka ghoont piye to Allah ka shukr ada kare. Yeh bhi marwi hai ki aap har haal mein Allah ka shukr ada karte rehte. Shafa'at wali lambi hadith jo Bukhari waghera mein hai us mein hai ki jab log talab-e-shafa'at ke liye Hazrat Noah Nabi ؑ ke pas aayenge to un se kahenge ki zameen walon ki taraf aap hi pehle rasool hain, Allah Ta'ala ne aap ka naam shukr guzar banda rakha hai. Aap apne Rab se hamari sifarish kijiye al-akh.

Tufan-e-Nuh ke baad Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ke Meraj ke waqie ke bayaan ke baad apne paighambar Kalimullah Hazrat Musa ؑ ka zikr bayaan farmata hai. Peshin-goi. Jo Kitab Bani Israel par utri thi us mein hi Allah Ta'ala ne unhein pehle hi se khabar de di thi ki woh zameen par do martaba sarkashi karenge aur sakht fasad barpa karenge, pas yahan par qazaina ke maane muqarrar kar dena aur pehle hi se khabar de dena ke hain. Jaise ayat (Wa qazaina ilaihi zalikal amr) mein yahi maane hain. Bas un ke pehle fasad ke waqt hum ne apni makhlooq mein se un logon ko un ke upar musallat kiya jo bare hi larnay walay, sakht jaan aur saaz-o-samaan se pooray lais thay, woh un par cha gaye, un ke shehar chheen liye, loot maar kar ke un ke gharon tak ko khaali kar ke be-khauf-o-khatar wapas chalay gaye, Allah ka wada poora hona hi tha. Kehtay hain ki yeh Jalut ka lashkar tha. Phir Allah ne Bani Israel ki madad ki aur yeh Hazrat Talut ki badshahat mein phir lare aur Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) ne Jalut ko qatal kiya. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki Mosul ke badshah Sakhayrab aur us ke lashkar ne un par foj-kashi ki thi. Baaz kehtay hain ki Babil ka badshah Bakht Nasar charh aya tha. Ibn Abi Hatim ne yahan par ek ajeeb-o-ghareeb qissa naqal kiya hai ki kis tarah is shakhs ne batadreej taraqqi ki thi. Awalan yeh ek faqeer tha, para rehta tha aur bheek maang kar guzara karta tha, phir to Bait-ul-Muqaddas tak us ne fateh kar liya aur wahan par Bani Israel ko bedareef qatal kiya. Ibn Jareer ne is ayat ki tafseer mein ek mutawwal marfoo hadees bayan ki hai jo mahz mauzoo hai aur us ke mauzoo honay mein kisi ko zara sa bhi shak nahi ho sakta. Tajjub hai ki bawajood is qadr wafir ilm ke Hazrat Imam Sahib ne yeh hadees waarad kar di, hamare ustad Sheikh Hafiz Allama Abu Al-Hajjaj Mizzi (Rahimahullah) ne us ke mauzoo honay ki tasreeh ki hai aur Kitab ke haashiya par likh bhi diya hai. Is baab mein Bani Israeli riwayat bhi bahut si hain lekin hum unhein waarad kar ke be-faida apni Kitab ko tool dena nahi chahtay kyunke un mein se baaz to mauzoo hain aur baaz go aisi na hon lekin bi-hamdillah hamein un riwayat ki koi zaroorat nahi. Kitabullah hamein aur tamam kitabon se be-niyaz kar denay wali hai. Allah ki Kitab aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki hadeexon ne hamein un cheezon ka muhtaj nahi rakha. Matlab sirf is qadr hai ki Bani Israel ki sarkashi ke waqt Allah ne un ke dushman un par musallat kar diye jinhon ne unhein khoob maza chakhaya, buri tarah dargat banai, un ke baal-bachon ko teh-tegh kiya, unhein is qadr zal-o-zaleel kiya ki un ke gharon tak mein ghus kar un ka satyanas kiya aur un ki sarkashi ki poori saza di. Unhon ne bhi zulm-o-ziyadati mein koi kasar utha nahi rakhi thi, awam to awam unhon ne to nabiyon ke galay katay thay, ulama ko sar-e-bazaar qatal kiya tha. Bakht Nasar mulk-e-Sham par ghalib aya, Bait-ul-Muqaddas ko weeran kar diya, wahan kam bashindon ko qatal kiya phir Damishq pahuncha yahan dekha ki ek sakht patthar par khoon josh maar raha hai, poochha yeh kya hai?

Logon ne kaha hum ne to ise baap dadaon se usi tarah dekha hai yeh khoon barabar ubalta rehta hai thehrta nahin us ne wahin par qatal-e-aam shuru kar diya sattar hazaar musalman waghera us ke haathoon yahan yeh qatal hue pas woh khoon thehar gaya. Us ne ulama aur huffaz ko aur tamam sharif aur zi-izzat logon ko bedardi se qatal kiya un mein koi bhi hafiz-e-taurat na bacha. Phir qaid karna shuru kiya un qaidiyon mein nabi-zade bhi the. Gharz ek larza-khez hangama hua lekin chunke sahi riwayaton se balke sehat ke qareeb wali riwayaton se bhi tafseelat nahin milti is liye hum ne unhe chhor diya hai wallahu a'lam. Phir farmata hai neki karne wala darasal apne liye hi bhala karta hai aur burai karne wala haqiqat mein apna hi bura karta hai jaise irshad hai: Ayat (Man 'amila salihan falinafsih wa man asaa fa'alaiha wa ma rabbuka bizallamin lil-'abeed) 41. Fussilat: 46, jo shakhs naik kaam kare woh us ke apne liye hai aur jo burai kare us ka bojh usi par hai. Phir jab doosra wada aya aur phir Bani Israel ne Allah ki nafarmaniyon par khule aam kamar kas li aur bebaki aur behayai ke sath zulm karne shuru kar diye to phir un ke dushman charh daude ke woh un ki shaklein bigaar dein aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki masjid jis tarah pehle unhon ne apne qabze mein kar li thi ab phir dobara kar lein aur jahan tak ban pare har cheez ka satyanas kar dein chunache yeh bhi ho kar raha. Tumhara Rab to hai hi rahm-o-karam karne wala aur us se na-umidi naziba hai, yeh mumkin hai ke phir se dushmanon ko past kar de haan yeh yaad rahe ke idhar tum ne sar uthaya udhar hum ne tumhara sar kuchla. Idhar tum ne fasad machaya udhar hum ne barbaad kiya. Yeh to hui duniyawi saza. Abhi akhirat ki zabardast aur ghair fani saza baqi hai. Jahannam kafiron ka qaid-khana hai jahan se na woh nikal sakein na chhoot sakein na bhaag sakein. Hamesha ke liye un ka odhna bichona yahi hai. Hazrat Qatadah (Rahimahullah) farmate hain phir bhi unhon ne sar uthaya aur bilkul farman-e-ilahi ko chhoda aur musalmanon se takra gaye to Allah Ta'ala ne Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko un par ghalib kiya aur unhe jziya dena para.

Behtareen rahnama Quran-e-Hakeem hai Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala apni kitab ki tareef mein farmata hai ke yeh Quran behtareen rah ki taraf rahbar karta hai. Imaan-dar jo imaan ke mutabiq farman-e-nabwi par amal bhi karein unhein yeh bashartein sunata hai ke un ke liye Allah ke paas bahut bara ajar hai unhein beshumar sawab milega. Aur jo imaan se khali hain unhein yeh Quran Qayamat ke din ke dardnak azabon ki khabar deta hai jaise farman hai ayat: (Fabashirhum bi 'azabin aleem - 84. Al-Inshiqaq: 24) unhein alimnak azabon ki khabar pohancha de.

Behtareen rahnama Quran-e-Hakeem hai Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala apni kitab ki tareef mein farmata hai ke yeh Quran behtareen rah ki taraf rahbar karta hai. Imaan-dar jo imaan ke mutabiq farman-e-nabwi par amal bhi karein unhein yeh bashartein sunata hai ke un ke liye Allah ke paas bahut bara ajar hai unhein beshumar sawab milega. Aur jo imaan se khali hain unhein yeh Quran Qayamat ke din ke dardnak azabon ki khabar deta hai jaise farman hai ayat: (Fabashirhum bi 'azabin aleem - 84. Al-Inshiqaq: 24) unhein alimnak azabon ki khabar pohancha de.

Badddua aur insan yaani insan kabhi kabhi ghaur aur na-umeed ho kar apni sakht ghalti se khud apne liye burai ki dua mangne lagta hai. Kabhi apne maal-o-aulad ke liye badddua karne lagta hai, kabhi maut ki, kabhi halakat ki, kabhi bardabari aur laanat ki. Lekin iska Allah is par khud us se bhi zyada meharban hai idhar woh dua kare idhar woh qabul farma le toh abhi halak ho jaye. Hadith mein bhi hai ke apni jaan-o-maal ke liye badddua na karo aisa na ho ke kisi qubuliyat ki saaat mein koi aisa bad-kalma zuban se nikal jaye. Iski wajah sirf insan ki iztirabi halat aur iski jald bazi hai. Yeh hai hi jald baaz. Hazrat Salman Farsi (R.H) aur Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne is mauqa par Hazrat Adam (A.S) ka waqia zikr kiya hai ke abhi pairon tale rooh nahi pahunchti thi ke aap ne khade hone ka irada kiya rooh sar ki taraf se aa rahi thi naak tak pahunchi toh chheenk aayi aap ne kaha Alhamdulillah. Toh Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya Yarhamka Rabbuka ya Adam (A.S) ae Adam tujh par tera Rab raham kare jab aankhon tak pahunchi toh aankhein khol kar dekhne lage. Jab aur neeche ke aaza mein pahunchi toh khushi se apne aap ko dekhne lage. Abhi pairon tak nahi pahunchi thi ke chalne ka irada kiya lekin na chal sake toh dua karne lage ke ae Allah raat se pehle rooh aa jaye.

Din aur raat ke fawaid Allah Ta'ala apni qudrat ki bari bari nishaniyon mein se do ka yahan bayan farmata hai ke din raat us ne alag alag tarah ke banaye. Raat aaram ke liye aur din talaash-e-maash ke liye, ke is mein kaam kaaj karo, sanat-o-harfat karo, sair-o-safar karo. Raat din ke ikhtilaf se dinon ki, jumu'on ki, mahinon ki, barson ki ginti maloom kar sako taake lain-den mein, mamlaat mein, qarz mein, muddat mein, ibadat ke kamon mein sahulat aur pehchan hojaye. Agar aik waqt rehta to bari mushkil hojati, sach hai agar Allah chahta to hamesha raat hi raat rakhta, koi itni qudrat nahi rakhta ke din kar de aur agar woh hamesha raat hi raat rakhta koi itni qudrat nahi rakhta ke din kar de aur agar woh hamesha din hi din rakhta to kis ki majal thi ke raat la de? Yeh nishanaat-e-qudrat sunne dekhne ke qabil hain. Yeh usi ki rahmat hai ke raat sukoon ke liye banayi aur din talaash-e-maash ke liye. In donon ko aik dusre ke peeche lagaataar aane wale banaya taake shukr-o-naseehat ka irada rakhne wale kamyab ho sakein. Isi ke haath raat din ka ikhtilaf hai, woh raat ka parda din par aur din ka naqab raat par chadha deta hai. Suraj chand usi ki matahati mein hai, har aik apne muqarrara waqt par chal phir raha hai, woh Allah Ghalib aur Ghaffar hai. Subah ka chaak karne wala hai, usi ne raat ko sukoon wali banaya hai aur suraj chand ko muqarrar kiya hai, yeh Allah Aziz-o-Haleem ka muqarrar kiya hua andaaza hai. Raat apne andhere se, chand ke zahir hone se pehchani jati hai aur din roshni se aur suraj ke chadhne se maloom hojata hai. Suraj chand donon hi roshan aur munawwar hain lekin in mein bhi poora tafawut rakha ke har aik pehchan liya jasake. Suraj ko bahut roshan aur chand ko noorani usi ne banaya hai, manzilein usi ne muqarrar ki hain taake hisab aur saal maloom rahein, Allah ki yeh paidaish haq hai. Al-Quran mein hai, log tujh se chand ke bare mein poochte hain keh de ke woh logon ke liye auqat hain aur hajj ke liye bhi, al-kh. Raat ka andhera hat jata hai, din ka ujala ajata hai. Suraj din ki alamat hai, chand raat ka nishan hai. Allah Ta'ala ne chand ko kuch siyahiwala paida kiya hai, pas raat ki nishani chand ko ba-nisbat suraj ke andar kar diya hai, is mein aik tarah ka dhabba rakh diya hai. Ibnul-Kawa ne Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ali R.A se poochha ke chand ye jhaiyyan kaisi hain? Aap ne farmaya usi ka bayan is ayat mein hai ke hum ne raat ke nishan yaani chand mein siyah dhandhlaka daal diya aur din ka nishan khoob roshan hai, yeh chand se zyada munawwar hai aur chand se bahut bara hai, din raat ko do nishaniyan muqarrar kar di hain, paidaish hi in ki isi tarah ki hai.

Insan ke aamal oopar ki aayaton mein zamane ka zikr kiya jis mein insan ke aamal hote hain ab yahan farmaya hai ki uska jo amal hota hai bhala ho ya bura woh us par chipak jata hai badla milega. Niki ka naik. Badi ka bad. Khwah woh kitni hi kam miqdaar mein kyun na ho? Jaise farman hai zarra barabar ki khair aur utni hi shar har shhar (shakhs) qamat (qayamat) ke din dekh lega. Aur jaise farman hai dayen aur bayen janib woh baithe hue hain jo baat munh se nikle woh usi waqt likh lete hain. Aur jagah hai aayat (Wa inna 'alaykum lahaafizīn 10 ۙ) 82. Al-Infitar :10) Tum par nigehban hain jo buzurg hain aur likhne wale hain. Tumhare har har fail se bakhabar hain. Aur aayat mein hai tumhein sirf tumhare kiye hue aamal ka badla milega. Aur jagah hai har burai karne wale ko saza di jayegi. Maqsood yeh ki Ibn-e-Adam ke chhote bade zahir o batin naik o bad aamal subh sham din raat barabar likhe ja rahe hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain albata har insan ki shaamat-e-amal uski gardan mein hai. Ibn Lahi'ah farmate hain yahan tak ki shagoon lena bhi, lekin is hadis ki yeh tafseer ghareeb hai wallahu aalam, iske aamal ke majmu'e ki kitab qayamat ke din ya toh iske dayen hath mein di jayegi ya bayen mein. Nekon ke dayen hath mein aur buron ke bayen hath mein khuli hui hogi ki woh bhi padh le aur dusre bhi dekh len iski tamam umar ke kul amal ismein likhe hue honge. Jaise farman hai aayat (Yunabba'ul-insanu yawma'izin bima qaddama wa akhkhar 13؀ۭ) 75. Al-Qiyamah :13) Us din insan apne tamam agle pichle aamal se khabardar kar diya jayega insan to apne mamle mein khud hi hujjat hai go apni begunahi ke kitne hi bahane pesh kar de. Us waqt isse farmaya jayega ki tu khoob janta hai ki tujh par zulm na kiya jayega. Ismein wahi likha gaya hai jo tu ne kiya hai us waqt chunki bhuli bisri cheezein bhi yaad aa jayengi. Isliye darhaqiqat koi uzr pesh karne ki gunjaish na rahegi phir samne kitab hai jo padh raha hai khwah woh duniya mein anpadh hi tha lekin aaj har shakhs ise padh lega. Gardan ka zikr khas tareeqe par isliye kiya ki woh ek مخصوص (makhsoos) hissa hum ismein jo cheez latka di gayi ho chipak gayi zaruri ho gayi shairon ne bhi is khayal ko zahir kiya hai. Rasool Allah ﷺ ka farman hai bimari ka muta'addi hona koi cheez nahi, faal koi cheez nahi, har insan ka amal uske gale ka haar hai aur rivayat mein hai ki har insan ka shagoon uske gale ka haar hai. Aap ka farman hai ki har din ke amal par mohar lag jati hai jab momin bimar padta hai toh farishte kehte hain aye Allah tu ne fulan ko toh rok liya hai Allah Ta'ala Jal Jalaluhu farmata hai iske jo amal the woh barabar likhte jao yahan tak ki main ise tandrust kar doon ya faut kar doon Qatadah ؒ kehte hain ki is aayat mein tair se murad amal hain.

Hazrat Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) farmate hain: "Aisi Ibn Adam! Tere dayen bayen farishte baithe hain, sahife khule rakhe hain; dahni janib wala nekiyan aur bayen taraf wala badiyan likh raha hai. Ab tujhe ikhtiyar hai, neki kar ya badi kar, ya ziyada se ziyada teri maut par yeh daftar lapet diye jayenge aur teri qabr mein teri gardan mein latka diye jayenge. Qiyamat ke din khule hue tere samne pesh kar diye jayenge aur tujh se kaha jayega: 'Le apna namah-e-amal khud padh le aur tu hi hisab aur insaf kar le!' Allah ki qasam, woh bada hi adil hai jo tera mamla tere hi supurd kar raha hai."
