Achhe ya bure aamal insan ke apne liye hain, jis ne rah-e-rast ikhtiyar ki, haq ki itbaa ki, nubuwwat ki maani, us ke apne haq mein achhai hai aur jo haq se hata, sahih rah se phira, us ka wabal usi par hai, koi kisi ke gunah mein pakra na jayega, har ek ka amal usi ke sath hai. Koi na hoga jo dusre ka bojh bataye aur jagah Quran mein hai, ayat: (Wa la yahmilunna athqalahum wa athqalan ma'a athqalihim wa la yus'alunna yaumal-qiyamati amma kanu yaftarun) 29. Al-Ankabut: 13. Aur ayat mein hai: (Wa min auzaril-lazina yudillunahum bi-ghairi cilmin ala sa'a ma yazirun) 16. An-Nahl: 25. Yani apne bojh ke sath yeh un ke bojh bhi uthayenge jinhe unho ne behka rakha tha. Lihaza in dono mazmunon mein koi nafi ka pehlu na samjha jaye is liye ke gumrah karne walon par un ke gumrah karne ka bojh hai na ke un ke bojh halke kiye jayenge aur un par lade jayenge, hamara adil Allah aisa nahi karta.

Phir apni ek aur rahmat bayan farmata hai ke woh Rasul ﷺ ke pahunchne se pehle kisi ummat ko azab nahi karta. Chunache Surah Tabarak mein hai ke dozakiyon se daroghe puchenge ke kya tumhare paas daranewale nahi aaye the? Woh jawab denge, beshak aaye the lekin hum ne unhe sacha na jana, unhe jhutla diya aur saaf keh diya ke tum to yunhi behk rahe ho, sare se yeh baat hi anhoni hai ke Allah kisi par kuch utare. Isi tarah jab yeh log jahannam ki taraf kashan kashan pahunchaye ja rahe honge, us waqt bhi daroghe un se puchenge ke kya tum mein se hi Rasul nahi aaye the? Jo tumhare Rab ki aayetein tumhare samne parhte hon aur tumhein is din ki mulaqat se darate hon? Yeh jawab denge ke haan yaqinan aaye lekin kalma-e-azab kafiron par theek utra. 

Aur ayat mein hai ke kuffar jahannam mein pare cheekh rahe honge ke A Allah hamein is se nikaal to hum apne qadeem kartoot chhor kar ab naik aamal karenge, to un se kaha jayega ke kya main ne tumhein itni lambi umr nahi di thi, tum agar naseebat hasil karna chahte to kar sakte the aur main ne tum mein apne Rasul bhi bheje the jinho ne khoob agah kar diya tha, ab to azab bardasht karo, zalimon ka koi madadgar nahi. Al-Gharad aur bhi bohat si aayeton se sabit hai ke Allah Ta'ala baghair Rasul bheje kisi ko jahannam mein nahi bhejta. 

Sahih Bukhari mein ayat (Inna rahmatallahi qaribum minal-muhsinin) 7. Al-A'raf: 56 ki tafsir mein ek lambi hadith marwi hai jis mein jannat dozakh ka kalam hai. Phir hai ke jannat ke bare mein Allah apni makhluq mein se kisi par zulm na karega aur woh jahannam ke liye ek nayi makhluq paida karega jo us mein daal di jayegi, jahannam kehti rahegi ke kya abhi aur zyada hai?

Us ke baabat ulama ki ek jama'at ne bahut kuch kalam kiya hai, darasal yeh jannat ke bare mein hai is liye ke woh dar-e-fazl hai aur jahannam dar-e-adl hai, is mein baghair uzr toore baghair hujjat zahir kiye koi dakhil na kiya jayega. Is liye huffaz-e-hadith ki ek jama'at ka khayal hai ke rawi ko is mein ulta yaad reh gaya aur is ki daleel Bukhari o Muslim ki woh riwayat hai jis mein usi hadith ke aakhir mein hai ke dozakh par na hogi yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala is mein apna qadam rakh dega, us waqt woh kahegi bas bas aur us waqt bhar jayegi aur chaaron taraf se simat jayegi. Allah Ta'ala kisi par zulm na karega. Haan jannat ke liye ek nayi makhlooq paida karega. Baaki raha yeh masla ke kafiron ke jo nabaligh chote bachche bachpan mein mar jaate hain aur jo deewane log hain aur neem behre aur jo aise zamane mein guzre hain jis waqt zameen par koi rasool ya deen ki sahih taleem nahi hoti aur unhein dawat-e-islam nahi pahunchti aur jo bilkul buddhe hawas bakhta hon, un ke liye kya hukm hai? Is bare mein shuru se ikhtilaf chala aa raha hai. Un ke bare mein jo hadeethein hain woh main aap ke saamne bayaan karta hoon phir aimma ka kalam bhi mukhtasaran zikr karunga, Allah Ta'ala madad kare. Pehli hadith Musnad Ahmad mein hai: Chaar qism ke log Qiyamat ke din Allah Ta'ala se guftugu karenge: Ek toh bilkul behra aadmi jo kuch bhi nahi sunta aur doosra bilkul ahmaq pagal aadmi jo kuch bhi nahi jaanta, teesra bilkul buddha phoos aadmi jis ke hawas durust nahi, chauthe woh log jo aise zamaano mein guzre hain jin mein koi paighambar ya us ki taleem maujood na thi. Behra toh kahega: Islam aaya lekin mere kaan mein koi aawaz nahi pahunchi. Deewana kahega ke Islam aaya lekin meri halat toh yeh thi ke bachche mujh par mengniyan phenk rahe the. Aur bilkul buddhe behawas aadmi kahenge ke Islam aaya lekin mere hosh o hawas hi durust na the jo main samajh kar sakta. Rasoolon ke zamaano ka aur un ki taleem ko maujood na paane walon ka qool hoga ke na rasool aaye na main ne haq paaya phir main kaise amal karta? Allah Ta'ala un ki taraf paigham bhejega ke achcha jao jahannam mein kood jao. Allah ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke agar woh farman-bardari kar lein aur jahannam mein kood padein toh jahannam ki aag un par thandak aur salamati ho jayegi. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jo kood padein ge un par toh salamati aur thandak ho jayegi aur jo rukein ge unhein hukm adooli ke baais ghaset kar jahannam mein daal diya jayega. Ibn Jareer mein is hadith ke bayaan ke baad Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ka yeh farmaan bhi hai ke agar tum chaaho toh is ki tasdeeq mein Kalamullah ki aayat (وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِيْنَ حَتّٰى نَبْعَثَ رَسُوْلًا) (Surah Al-Isra: 15) padh lo. Doosri hadith Abu Dawud Tayalisi mein hai ke hum ne Hazrat Anas R.A se sawal kiya ke Abu Hamza! Mushrikon ke bachchon ke bare mein aap kya farmate hain?

Aap ne farmaya maine Rasulullah ﷺ se suna hai ke woh gunahgaar nahi jo dozakh mein azab kiye jayein aur neko-kar bhi nahi jo jannat mein badla diye jayein. Teesri hadith Abu Yala mein hai ke un chaaron ke uzr sun kar Janab-e-Bari farmayega ke auron ke paas toh main apne Rasul bhejta tha lekin tum se main aap kehta hoon ke jao is jahannam mein chale jao jahannam mein se bhi farman-e-bari se ek gardan unchi hogi is farman ko sunte hi woh log jo naik tab'a hain foran daud kar is mein kood parenge aur jo baatin hain woh kahenge Allah paak hum isi se bachne ke liye toh yeh uzr mazrat kar rahe the Allah farmayega jab tum khud meri nahi mante toh mere rasoolon ki kya mante ab tumhare liye faisla yahi hai ke tum jahannami ho aur un farmanbardaron se kaha jayega ke tum beshak jannati ho tum ne itaat karli. 

Chauthi hadith Musnad Hafiz Abu Yala Mosli mein hai ke Rasulullah ﷺ se musalmanon ki aulad ke bare mein sawal hua toh aap ne farmaya woh apne baapon ke sath hai. Phir mushrikeen ki aulad ke bare mein pucha gaya toh aap ne farmaya woh apne baapon ke sath, toh kaha gaya Ya Rasulullah unhon ne koi amal toh nahi kiya aap ne farmaya haan lekin Allah unhe bakhubi janta hai. 

Paanchویں (paanchwein) hadith. Hafiz Abu Bakr Ahmad bin Umar bin Abdul Khaliq Bazzar ؒ apni Musnad mein rivayat karte hain ke qayamat ke din ahl-e-jahiliyat apne bojh apni kamaroon par lade hue aayenge aur Allah ke samne uzr karenge ke na hamare paas tere rasool pahuche na hamein tera koi hukm pahucha agar aisa hota toh hum ji khol kar maan lete Allah Ta'ala farmayega acha ab agar hukm karoon toh maan loge? Woh kahenge haan haan beshak bila choon-o-chra. 

Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala farmayega acha jao jahannam ke paas ja kar is mein dakhil ho jao yeh chalenge yahan tak ke us ke paas pahuch jayenge ab jo is ka josh aur is ki aawaz aur is ke azab dekhenge toh wapas aa jayenge aur kahenge اے Allah hamein is se toh bacha le. Allah Ta'ala farmayega dekho toh iqrar kar chuke ho ke meri farmanbardari karoge phir yeh nafarmani kyun? Woh kahenge acha ab ise maan lenge aur kar guzrenge chunacha un se mazboot ahad-o-peyman liye jayenge, phir yahi hukm hoga yeh jayenge aur phir khaufzada ho kar wapas lautenge aur kahenge اے Allah hum toh dar gaye hum se toh is farman par kar-band nahi hua jata. 

Ab Janab-e-Bari farmayega tum nafarmani kar chuke ab jao zillat ke sath jahannami ban jao. Aap farmate hain ke agar pehli martaba hi yeh buhkm-e-Ilahi is mein kood jaate toh aatish-e-dozakh un par sard pad jati aur un ka ek rawan bhi na jalati. 

Imam Bazzar ؒ farmate hain is hadith ka matan maroof nahi Ayyub se sirf Abaad hi rivayat karte hain aur Abaad se sirf Raihan bin Saeed rivayat karte hain. Main kehta hoon ise Ibn Hibban ne siqa batlaya hai. Yahya bin Mueen aur Nisai kehte hain un mein koi dar khauf ki baat nahi. Abu Dawood ne un se rivayat nahi ki. Abu Hatim kehte hain yeh shaikh hain un mein koi harj nahi.

Un ki hadeesein likhai jati hain aur un se daleel nahi li jati. Chhatti hadees. Imam Muhammad bin Yahya Zahli (Rahimahullah) riwayat laye hain ki Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai khali zamane wale aur majnoon aur bachche Allah ke samne aayenge ek kahega mere paas teri kitab pahunchi hi nahi, majnoon kahega main bhalai burai ki tameez hi nahi rakhta. Bachcha kahega main ne samajh boojh ka buloghat ka zamana paya hi nahi. Usi waqt un ke samne aag shole marne lagegi. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga ise hata do to jo log aayinda neki karne wale thay woh to ita'at guzaar ho jayenge aur jo is uzr ke hat jaane ke baad bhi nafarmani karne wale thay woh ruk jayenge to Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga jab tum meri hi barah-e-rast nahi mante to mere paighambaron ki kya mante? Saatween hadees. Inhi teen shakhson ke bare mein upar wali ahadees ki tarah is mein yeh bhi hai ki jab yeh jahannam ke paas pahunchenge to is mein se aise shole buland honge ki yeh samajh lenge ki yeh to saari duniya ko jala kar bhasam kar denge daudte hue wapas laut aayenge phir dobara yehi hoga Allah Azzawajal farmaye ga. Tumhari paidaish se pehle hi tumhare aamal ki khabar thi main ne ilm hote hue tumhe paida kiya tha usi ilm ke mutabiq tum ho. Ae jahannam unhe dabooch le chunacha usi waqt aag unhe luqma bana legi. Aathween hadees Hazrat Abu Hurairah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki riwayat un ke apne qaul samet pehle bayan ho chuki hai. Bukhari o Muslim mein aap hi se marwi hai ki Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya "Har bachcha deen-e-Islam par paida hota hai. Phir is ke maan baap ise yahudi, nasrani ya majoosi bana lete hain". Jaise ki bakri ke sahi salim bachche ke kaan kaat diya karte hain. Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar woh bachpan mein hi mar jaye to? Aap ne farmaya Allah ko un ke aamal ki sahi aur poori khabar thi. Musnad ki hadees mein hai ki musalman bachchon ki kafalat jannat mein Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ke supurd hai. Sahih Muslim mein hadees-e-qudsi hai ki main ne apne bandon ko muwahid yaksoo mukhlis banaya hai. Ek riwayat mein is ke sath hi musalman ka lafaz bhi hai. Nawein hadees Hafiz Abu Bakr Yarqani apni kitab Al-Mustakhraj 'Alal Bukhari mein riwayat laye hain ki Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya har bachcha fitrat par paida kiya jata hai logon ne ba-aawaz buland daryaft kiya ki mushrikon ke bachche bhi? Aap ne farmaya haan mushrikon ke bachche bhi. Tabarani ki hadees mein hai ki mushrikon ke bachche ahl-e-jannat ke khadim banaye jayenge. Dasween hadees Musnad Ahmad mein hai ki ek sahabi ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jannat mein kaun kaun jayenge. Aap ne farmaya nabi aur shaheed bachche aur zinda dar-gor kiye hue bachche. Ulema mein se baaz ka maslak to yeh hai ki un ke bare mein hum tawwaqquf karte hain, khamosh hain un ki bhi guzar chuki. Baaz kehte hain yeh jannati hain un ki daleel meraj wali woh hadees hai jo Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Samurah bin Jundab (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se marwi hai ki aap ne apne is khwab mein ek shaikh ko ek jannati darakht tale dekha, jin ke paas bahut se bachche thay.

Sawal par Hazrat Jibril A.S ne bataya ke yeh Hazrat Ibrahim A.S hain aur un ke paas yeh bachche musalmanon ki aur mushrikon ki aulaad hain, logon ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ mushrikon ki aulaad bhi? Aap ne farmaya haan mushrikon ki aulaad bhi. Ba'z ulama farmate hain yeh dozakhi hain kyunke ek hadith mein hai ke woh apne baapon ke sath hain. Ba'z ulama kehte hain un ka imtihan qayamat ke maidaanon mein ho jayega. Itaat guzar jannat mein jayenge, Allah apne sabiqa ilm ka izhaar kar ke phir unhein jannat mein pohnchayega aur ba'z wajah apni nafarmani ke jo us imtihan ke waqt un se sarzad hogi aur Allah Ta'ala apna pehla ilm aashkara kar dega. Us waqt unhein jahannam ka hukm hoga. Us mazhab se tamam ahadith aur mukhtalif daleelon mein jam ho jati hain aur pehle ki hadithein jo ek dusri ko taqwiyat pohnchati hain us maani ki kayi ek hain. Shaikh Abu Al-Hasan Ali bin Ismail Ash'ari R.H ne yahi mazhab Ahl-e-Sunnat-wal-Jama'at ka naql farmaya hai. Aur usi ki ta'eed Imam Baihaqi R.H ne Kitab-ul-I'tiqaad mein ki hai. Aur bhi bohat se muhaqqiqin ulama aur parakh wale hafizon ne yahi farmaya hai. Shaikh Abu Umar bin Abdul Barr R.H Azi ne imtihan ki ba'z riwayatein bayan kar ke likha hai is bare ki hadithein qawi nahi hain aur un se hujjat sabit nahi hoti aur ahl-e-ilm ka inkar karte hain is liye ke aakhirat dar-e-jaza hai, dar-e-amal nahi hai aur na dar-e-imtihan hai. Aur jahannam mein jane ka hukm bhi to insani taqat se baher ka hukm hai aur Allah ki yeh aadat nahi. Imam Sahib R.H ke is qaul ka jawab bhi sun lijiye, is bare jo hadithein hain, un mein se ba'z to bilkul sahi hain. Jaise ke aimma ulama ne tasreeh ki hai. Ba'z hasan hain aur ba'z zaeef bhi hain lekin woh wajah sahi aur hasan ahadith ke qawi ho jati hain aur jab yeh hai to zahir hai ke yeh hadithein hujjat-o-daleel ke qabil ho gayin ab raha Imam Sahib ka yeh farman ke aakhirat dar-e-amal aur dar-e-imtihan nahi woh dar-e-jaza hai. Yeh beshak sahi hai lekin us se us ki nafi kaise ho gayi ke qayamat ke mukhtalif maidaanon ki peshiyon mein jannat dozakh mein dakhle se pehle koi hukm ahkaam na diye jayenge. Shaikh Abu Al-Hasan Ash'ari R.H ne to mazhab Ahl-e-Sunnat-wal-Jama'at ke aqaid mein bachchon ke imtihan ko dakhil kiya hai. Mazid baran ayat-e-Quran ayat (YAWMA YUKSHAFU ‘AN SAQIN WA YUD‘AWNA ILAS-SUJUDI FALAH YASTATI‘OUN) (68. Al-Qalam: 42) is ki khuli daleel hai ke munafiq-o-momin ki tameez ke liye pindli khol di jayegi aur sajde ka hukm hoga. Sihah ki ahadith mein hai ke momin to sajda kar lenge aur munafiq ulte munh peeth ke bal gir parenge. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein us shakhs ka qissa bhi hai jo sab se aakhir mein jahannam se niklega ke woh Allah se wade waeed karega siwa us sawal ke aur koi sawal na karega us ke pura hone ke baad woh apne qaul-o-qarar se phir jayega aur ek aur sawal kar baithega waghera. Aakhirat mein Allah Ta'ala farmayega ke Ibn-e-Adam to bara hi ahad shikan hai achcha ja, jannat mein chala ja.

Phir Imam Sahib ka yeh farmana ke unhein unki taqat se kharij baat ka yaani jahannam mein kood parne ka hukum kaise ho gaya? Allah Ta'ala kisi ko uski wus'at se zyada takleef nahi deta. Yeh bhi sehat-e-hadith mein koi rok paida nahi kar sakta. Khud Imam Sahib aur tamam Musalman maante hain ke pul-e-sirat par se guzarne ka hukum sab ko hoga jo jahannam ki peeth par hoga aur talwar se zyada tez aur baal se zyada bareek hoga. Momin us par se apni nekiyon ke andaze se guzar jayenge. Baaz misl bijli ke, baaz misl hawa ke, baaz misl ghoron ke, baaz misl oonton ke, baaz misl bhagne walon ke, baaz misl pedal jaane walon ke, baaz ghutnon ke bal sarak sarak kar, baaz kat kat kar, jahannam mein parenge. Pas jab yeh cheez wahan hai to unhein jahannam mein kood parne ka hukum to us se koi nahi balki yeh us se bara aur bohat bhaari hai. Aur suniye hadith mein hai ke Dajjal ke sath aag aur baagh hoga. Shari' ؑ ne mominoon ko hukum diya hai ke woh jise aag dekh rahe hain us mein se peeyen woh unke liye thandak aur salamati ki cheez hai. Pas yeh is waqia ki saaf nazeer hai. Aur lijiye Bani Israel ne jab gosala parasti ki us ki saza mein Allah ne hukum diya ke woh aapas mein ek dusre ko qatal karein ek abr ne aa kar unhein dhanp liya ab jo talwar chali toh subh hi subh abr phatne se pehle un mein se sattar hazaar aadmi qatal ho chuke thay. Bete ne baap ko aur baap ne bete ko qatal kiya kya yeh hukum is hukum se kam tha? Kya is ka amal nafs par garaan nahi? Phir toh is ki nisbat bhi keh dena chahiye tha ke Allah kisi nafs ko uski bardasht se zyada takleef nahi deta. In tamam bahson ke saaf hone ke baad ab suniye. Mushrikeen ke bachpan mein mare hue bachon ki babat bhi bohat se aqwal hain. Ek yeh ke yeh sab Jannati hain, unki daleel wahi Meraj mein Hazrat Ibrahim ؑ ke paas mushrikon aur Musalmanon ke bachon ko An-Hazrat ﷺ ka dekhna hai aur daleel unki Musnad ki woh riwayat hai jo pehle guzar chuki ke Aap ne farmaya bachhe jannat mein hain. Haan imtihan hone ki jo hadeethein guzar sakein woh un mein se khusoos hain. Pas jin ki nisbat Rabb-ul-Aalameen ko maloom hai ke woh mutee aur farmanbardar hain unki roohein aalam-e-barzakh mein Hazrat Ibrahim ؑ ke paas hain aur Musalmanon ke bachon ki roohein bhi. Aur jin ki nisbat Allah Ta'ala janta hai ke woh qubool karne wali nahi, un ka amr Allah ke supurd hai woh Qayamat ke din jahannami honge. Jaise ke ahadeeth-e-imtihan se zahir hai. Imam Ash'ari ؓ ne ise Ahl-e-Sunnat se naql kiya hai ab koi toh kehta hai ke yeh mustaqil taur par Jannati hain koi kehta hai yeh Ahl-e-Jannat ke khadim hain. Go aisi hadith Dawood Tayalisi mein hai lekin is ki sanad zaeef hai Wallahu A'lam. Dusra qaul yeh hai ke mushrikon ke bachhe bhi apne baap dadon ke sath jahannam mein jayenge jaise ke Musnad waghera ki hadith mein hai ke woh apne baap dadon ke tabe-dar hain. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Ayesha ؓ ne pucha bhi ke bawajood be-amal hone ke? Aap ne farmaya woh kya amal karne wale thay, ise Allah Ta'ala ba-khoobi janta hai.

Abu Dawood mein hai Hazrat Aisha R.A farmati hain. "Maine Rasoolullah ﷺ se musalmanon ki aulad ki baabat sawal kiya to Aap ne farmaya woh apne baap dadon ke sath hain. Maine kaha mushrikon ki aulad? Aap ne farmaya woh apne baap dadon ke sath hain. Maine kaha baghair is ke ke unhon ne koi amal kiya ho? Aap ne farmaya woh kya karte yeh Allah ke ilm mein hai. 

Musnad ki hadith mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya agar tu chahe to main un ka rona peetna aur cheekhna chalana bhi tujhe suna doon. Imam Ahmad R.H ke sahibzade riwayat laaye hain ke Hazrat Khadija R.A ne Rasoolullah ﷺ se apne un do bachon ki nisbat sawal kiya jo Jahiliyat ke zamane mein faut hue the, Aap ne farmaya woh dono dozakh mein hain, jab Aap ne dekha ke baat unhen bhaari padi hai to Aap ne farmaya agar tum un ki jagah dekh litin to tum khud un se bezaar ho jaatin. 

Hazrat Khadija R.A ne poocha achha jo bacha Aap se hua tha? Aap ne farmaya suno momin aur un ki aulad Jannati hai aur mushrik aur un ki aulad Jahannami hai. Phir Aap ne yeh aayat padhi (Wal-lazina amanu wattaba'ahum zurriyyatuhum bi-imanin alhaqna bihim zurriyyatahum) jo log iman laaye aur un ki aulad ne un ki ittaba ki iman ke sath, hum un ki aulad unhi ke sath mila denge. 

Yeh hadith ghareeb hai, is ki isnad mein Muhammad bin Usman raawi majhool-ul-hal hain aur un ke shaikh Zazan ne Hazrat Ali R.A ko nahi paya, Wallahu A'lam. 

Abu Dawood mein hadith hai: Zinda dar-gor karne wali aur zinda dar-gor karda shuda dozakhi hain. 

Abu Dawood mein yeh sanad Hasan marwi hai, Hazrat Salma bin Qais Ashja'i Razi Allahu Anhu farmate hain main apne bhai ko liye hue Rasoolullah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kaha ke Huzoor ﷺ hamari maan Jahiliyat ke zamane mein mar gayi hain, woh sila rahmi karne wali aur mehmaan nawaz thin, hamari ek nabaligh behan unhon ne zinda dafan kar di thi. Aap ne farmaya aisa karne wali aur jis ke sath aisa kiya gaya hai dono dozakhi hain, yeh aur baat hai ke woh Islam ko pa le aur ise qabool kar le. 

Teesra qaul yeh hai ke un ke baare mein tawqif karna chahiye, koi faisla kun baat yak-tarfa na kahni chahiye. Un ka itmad Aap ke is farman par hai ke un ke aamal ka sahi aur poora ilm Allah Ta'ala ko hai. Bukhari mein hai ke mushrikon ki aulad ke baare mein jab Aap se sawal hua to Aap ne unhi lafzon mein jawab diya tha. 

Ba'z buzurg kehte hain ke yeh A'raf mein rakhe jayenge. Is qaul ka natija yahi hai ke yeh Jannati hain is liye ke A'raf koi rehne sehne ki jagah nahi, yahan wale bil-akhir Jannat mein hi jayenge, jaise ke Surah A'raf ki tafsir mein hum is ki tafsir kar aaye hain, Wallahu A'lam. 

Yeh to tha ikhtilaf mushrikon ki aulad ke baare mein, lekin mominon ki nabaligh aulad ke baare mein to ulama ka bila ikhtilaf yahi qaul hai ke woh Jannati hain, jaise ke Hazrat Imam Ahmad ka qaul hai aur yahi logon mein mashhoor bhi hai aur Insha'Allah Azza wa Jalla humein bhi yahi umeed hai.

Lekin ba'z ulama se manqul hai ke woh un ke bare mein tawquf karte hain aur kehte hain ke sab bachche Allah ki marzi aur us ki chahat ke mataht hain. Ahl-e-fiqh aur Ahl-e-Hadith ki ek jamaat is taraf bhi gayi hai. Muwatta Imam Malik ki Abwab-ul-Qadr ki ahadees mein bhi kuch isi jaisa hai go Imam Malik ka koi faisla is mein nahi. Lekin ba'z mutakhireen ka qaul hai ke musalman bachche to jannati hain aur mushrikon ke bachche mashiyat-e-Ilahi ke mataht hain. Ibn Abdul Barr ne is baat ko isi wazahat se bayan kiya hai lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai. Kitab-e-Tazkirah mein Imam Qurtubi (Rahimahullah) ne bhi yahi farmaya hai Wallahu A'lam. Is bare mein un buzurgon ne ek hadees yeh bhi وارد ki hai ke Ansoriyon ke ek bachche ke janaze mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bulaya gaya to Umm-ul-Mumineen Aisha (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) ne farmaya is bachche ko marhaba ho yeh to jannat ki chidiya hai na burai ka koi kaam kiya na us zamane ko pahuncha to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is ke siwa kuch aur bhi Ae Aisha? Suno Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne jannat wale paida kiye hain halanki woh apne baap ki peeth mein thay. Isi tarah us ne jahannam ko paida kiya hai aur is mein jalne wale paida kiye hain halanki woh abhi apne baap ki peeth mein hain. Muslim aur Sunan ki yeh hadees hai chunke yeh masala sahi daleel ke baghair sabit nahi ho sakta aur log apni be-ilmi ke bais baghair suboot-e-shari'at ke is mein kalam karne lage hain. Is liye ulama ki ek jamaat ne is mein kalam karna hi napasand rakha hai. Ibn Abbas, Qasim bin Muhammad bin Abi Bakr Siddiq aur Muhammad bin Hanafiyya waghera ka mazhab yahi hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne to mimbar par khutbe mein farmaya tha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai ke is ummat ka kaam theek thak rahega jab tak ke yeh bachchon ke bare mein aur taqdeer ke bare mein kuch kalam na karenge (Ibn Hibban). Imam Ibn Hibban kehte hain murad is se mushrikon ke bachchon ke bare mein kalam na karna hai. Aur kitabon mein yeh riwayat Hazrat Abdullah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke apne qaul se mauqufan marwi hai.

Achhe ya bure aamal insan ke apne liye hain, jis ne rah-e-rast ikhtiyar ki, haq ki itbaa ki, nubuwwat ki maani, us ke apne haq mein achhai hai aur jo haq se hata, sahih rah se phira, us ka wabal usi par hai, koi kisi ke gunah mein pakra na jayega, har ek ka amal usi ke sath hai. Koi na hoga jo dusre ka bojh bataye aur jagah Quran mein hai, ayat: (Wa la yahmilunna athqalahum wa athqalan ma'a athqalihim wa la yus'alunna yaumal-qiyamati amma kanu yaftarun) 29. Al-Ankabut: 13. Aur ayat mein hai: (Wa min auzaril-lazina yudillunahum bi-ghairi cilmin ala sa'a ma yazirun) 16. An-Nahl: 25. Yani apne bojh ke sath yeh un ke bojh bhi uthayenge jinhe unho ne behka rakha tha. Lihaza in dono mazmunon mein koi nafi ka pehlu na samjha jaye is liye ke gumrah karne walon par un ke gumrah karne ka bojh hai na ke un ke bojh halke kiye jayenge aur un par lade jayenge, hamara adil Allah aisa nahi karta.

Phir apni ek aur rahmat bayan farmata hai ke woh Rasul ﷺ ke pahunchne se pehle kisi ummat ko azab nahi karta. Chunache Surah Tabarak mein hai ke dozakiyon se daroghe puchenge ke kya tumhare paas daranewale nahi aaye the? Woh jawab denge, beshak aaye the lekin hum ne unhe sacha na jana, unhe jhutla diya aur saaf keh diya ke tum to yunhi behk rahe ho, sare se yeh baat hi anhoni hai ke Allah kisi par kuch utare. Isi tarah jab yeh log jahannam ki taraf kashan kashan pahunchaye ja rahe honge, us waqt bhi daroghe un se puchenge ke kya tum mein se hi Rasul nahi aaye the? Jo tumhare Rab ki aayetein tumhare samne parhte hon aur tumhein is din ki mulaqat se darate hon? Yeh jawab denge ke haan yaqinan aaye lekin kalma-e-azab kafiron par theek utra. 

Aur ayat mein hai ke kuffar jahannam mein pare cheekh rahe honge ke A Allah hamein is se nikaal to hum apne qadeem kartoot chhor kar ab naik aamal karenge, to un se kaha jayega ke kya main ne tumhein itni lambi umr nahi di thi, tum agar naseebat hasil karna chahte to kar sakte the aur main ne tum mein apne Rasul bhi bheje the jinho ne khoob agah kar diya tha, ab to azab bardasht karo, zalimon ka koi madadgar nahi. Al-Gharad aur bhi bohat si aayeton se sabit hai ke Allah Ta'ala baghair Rasul bheje kisi ko jahannam mein nahi bhejta. 

Sahih Bukhari mein ayat (Inna rahmatallahi qaribum minal-muhsinin) 7. Al-A'raf: 56 ki tafsir mein ek lambi hadith marwi hai jis mein jannat dozakh ka kalam hai. Phir hai ke jannat ke bare mein Allah apni makhluq mein se kisi par zulm na karega aur woh jahannam ke liye ek nayi makhluq paida karega jo us mein daal di jayegi, jahannam kehti rahegi ke kya abhi aur zyada hai?

Us ke baabat ulama ki ek jama'at ne bahut kuch kalam kiya hai, darasal yeh jannat ke bare mein hai is liye ke woh dar-e-fazl hai aur jahannam dar-e-adl hai, is mein baghair uzr toore baghair hujjat zahir kiye koi dakhil na kiya jayega. Is liye huffaz-e-hadith ki ek jama'at ka khayal hai ke rawi ko is mein ulta yaad reh gaya aur is ki daleel Bukhari o Muslim ki woh riwayat hai jis mein usi hadith ke aakhir mein hai ke dozakh par na hogi yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala is mein apna qadam rakh dega, us waqt woh kahegi bas bas aur us waqt bhar jayegi aur chaaron taraf se simat jayegi. Allah Ta'ala kisi par zulm na karega. Haan jannat ke liye ek nayi makhlooq paida karega. Baaki raha yeh masla ke kafiron ke jo nabaligh chote bachche bachpan mein mar jaate hain aur jo deewane log hain aur neem behre aur jo aise zamane mein guzre hain jis waqt zameen par koi rasool ya deen ki sahih taleem nahi hoti aur unhein dawat-e-islam nahi pahunchti aur jo bilkul buddhe hawas bakhta hon, un ke liye kya hukm hai? Is bare mein shuru se ikhtilaf chala aa raha hai. Un ke bare mein jo hadeethein hain woh main aap ke saamne bayaan karta hoon phir aimma ka kalam bhi mukhtasaran zikr karunga, Allah Ta'ala madad kare. Pehli hadith Musnad Ahmad mein hai: Chaar qism ke log Qiyamat ke din Allah Ta'ala se guftugu karenge: Ek toh bilkul behra aadmi jo kuch bhi nahi sunta aur doosra bilkul ahmaq pagal aadmi jo kuch bhi nahi jaanta, teesra bilkul buddha phoos aadmi jis ke hawas durust nahi, chauthe woh log jo aise zamaano mein guzre hain jin mein koi paighambar ya us ki taleem maujood na thi. Behra toh kahega: Islam aaya lekin mere kaan mein koi aawaz nahi pahunchi. Deewana kahega ke Islam aaya lekin meri halat toh yeh thi ke bachche mujh par mengniyan phenk rahe the. Aur bilkul buddhe behawas aadmi kahenge ke Islam aaya lekin mere hosh o hawas hi durust na the jo main samajh kar sakta. Rasoolon ke zamaano ka aur un ki taleem ko maujood na paane walon ka qool hoga ke na rasool aaye na main ne haq paaya phir main kaise amal karta? Allah Ta'ala un ki taraf paigham bhejega ke achcha jao jahannam mein kood jao. Allah ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke agar woh farman-bardari kar lein aur jahannam mein kood padein toh jahannam ki aag un par thandak aur salamati ho jayegi. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jo kood padein ge un par toh salamati aur thandak ho jayegi aur jo rukein ge unhein hukm adooli ke baais ghaset kar jahannam mein daal diya jayega. Ibn Jareer mein is hadith ke bayaan ke baad Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ka yeh farmaan bhi hai ke agar tum chaaho toh is ki tasdeeq mein Kalamullah ki aayat (وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِيْنَ حَتّٰى نَبْعَثَ رَسُوْلًا) (Surah Al-Isra: 15) padh lo. Doosri hadith Abu Dawud Tayalisi mein hai ke hum ne Hazrat Anas R.A se sawal kiya ke Abu Hamza! Mushrikon ke bachchon ke bare mein aap kya farmate hain?

Aap ne farmaya maine Rasulullah ﷺ se suna hai ke woh gunahgaar nahi jo dozakh mein azab kiye jayein aur neko-kar bhi nahi jo jannat mein badla diye jayein. Teesri hadith Abu Yala mein hai ke un chaaron ke uzr sun kar Janab-e-Bari farmayega ke auron ke paas toh main apne Rasul bhejta tha lekin tum se main aap kehta hoon ke jao is jahannam mein chale jao jahannam mein se bhi farman-e-bari se ek gardan unchi hogi is farman ko sunte hi woh log jo naik tab'a hain foran daud kar is mein kood parenge aur jo baatin hain woh kahenge Allah paak hum isi se bachne ke liye toh yeh uzr mazrat kar rahe the Allah farmayega jab tum khud meri nahi mante toh mere rasoolon ki kya mante ab tumhare liye faisla yahi hai ke tum jahannami ho aur un farmanbardaron se kaha jayega ke tum beshak jannati ho tum ne itaat karli. 

Chauthi hadith Musnad Hafiz Abu Yala Mosli mein hai ke Rasulullah ﷺ se musalmanon ki aulad ke bare mein sawal hua toh aap ne farmaya woh apne baapon ke sath hai. Phir mushrikeen ki aulad ke bare mein pucha gaya toh aap ne farmaya woh apne baapon ke sath, toh kaha gaya Ya Rasulullah unhon ne koi amal toh nahi kiya aap ne farmaya haan lekin Allah unhe bakhubi janta hai. 

Paanchویں (paanchwein) hadith. Hafiz Abu Bakr Ahmad bin Umar bin Abdul Khaliq Bazzar ؒ apni Musnad mein rivayat karte hain ke qayamat ke din ahl-e-jahiliyat apne bojh apni kamaroon par lade hue aayenge aur Allah ke samne uzr karenge ke na hamare paas tere rasool pahuche na hamein tera koi hukm pahucha agar aisa hota toh hum ji khol kar maan lete Allah Ta'ala farmayega acha ab agar hukm karoon toh maan loge? Woh kahenge haan haan beshak bila choon-o-chra. 

Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala farmayega acha jao jahannam ke paas ja kar is mein dakhil ho jao yeh chalenge yahan tak ke us ke paas pahuch jayenge ab jo is ka josh aur is ki aawaz aur is ke azab dekhenge toh wapas aa jayenge aur kahenge اے Allah hamein is se toh bacha le. Allah Ta'ala farmayega dekho toh iqrar kar chuke ho ke meri farmanbardari karoge phir yeh nafarmani kyun? Woh kahenge acha ab ise maan lenge aur kar guzrenge chunacha un se mazboot ahad-o-peyman liye jayenge, phir yahi hukm hoga yeh jayenge aur phir khaufzada ho kar wapas lautenge aur kahenge اے Allah hum toh dar gaye hum se toh is farman par kar-band nahi hua jata. 

Ab Janab-e-Bari farmayega tum nafarmani kar chuke ab jao zillat ke sath jahannami ban jao. Aap farmate hain ke agar pehli martaba hi yeh buhkm-e-Ilahi is mein kood jaate toh aatish-e-dozakh un par sard pad jati aur un ka ek rawan bhi na jalati. 

Imam Bazzar ؒ farmate hain is hadith ka matan maroof nahi Ayyub se sirf Abaad hi rivayat karte hain aur Abaad se sirf Raihan bin Saeed rivayat karte hain. Main kehta hoon ise Ibn Hibban ne siqa batlaya hai. Yahya bin Mueen aur Nisai kehte hain un mein koi dar khauf ki baat nahi. Abu Dawood ne un se rivayat nahi ki. Abu Hatim kehte hain yeh shaikh hain un mein koi harj nahi.

Un ki hadeesein likhai jati hain aur un se daleel nahi li jati. Chhatti hadees. Imam Muhammad bin Yahya Zahli (Rahimahullah) riwayat laye hain ki Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai khali zamane wale aur majnoon aur bachche Allah ke samne aayenge ek kahega mere paas teri kitab pahunchi hi nahi, majnoon kahega main bhalai burai ki tameez hi nahi rakhta. Bachcha kahega main ne samajh boojh ka buloghat ka zamana paya hi nahi. Usi waqt un ke samne aag shole marne lagegi. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga ise hata do to jo log aayinda neki karne wale thay woh to ita'at guzaar ho jayenge aur jo is uzr ke hat jaane ke baad bhi nafarmani karne wale thay woh ruk jayenge to Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga jab tum meri hi barah-e-rast nahi mante to mere paighambaron ki kya mante? Saatween hadees. Inhi teen shakhson ke bare mein upar wali ahadees ki tarah is mein yeh bhi hai ki jab yeh jahannam ke paas pahunchenge to is mein se aise shole buland honge ki yeh samajh lenge ki yeh to saari duniya ko jala kar bhasam kar denge daudte hue wapas laut aayenge phir dobara yehi hoga Allah Azzawajal farmaye ga. Tumhari paidaish se pehle hi tumhare aamal ki khabar thi main ne ilm hote hue tumhe paida kiya tha usi ilm ke mutabiq tum ho. Ae jahannam unhe dabooch le chunacha usi waqt aag unhe luqma bana legi. Aathween hadees Hazrat Abu Hurairah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki riwayat un ke apne qaul samet pehle bayan ho chuki hai. Bukhari o Muslim mein aap hi se marwi hai ki Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya "Har bachcha deen-e-Islam par paida hota hai. Phir is ke maan baap ise yahudi, nasrani ya majoosi bana lete hain". Jaise ki bakri ke sahi salim bachche ke kaan kaat diya karte hain. Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar woh bachpan mein hi mar jaye to? Aap ne farmaya Allah ko un ke aamal ki sahi aur poori khabar thi. Musnad ki hadees mein hai ki musalman bachchon ki kafalat jannat mein Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ke supurd hai. Sahih Muslim mein hadees-e-qudsi hai ki main ne apne bandon ko muwahid yaksoo mukhlis banaya hai. Ek riwayat mein is ke sath hi musalman ka lafaz bhi hai. Nawein hadees Hafiz Abu Bakr Yarqani apni kitab Al-Mustakhraj 'Alal Bukhari mein riwayat laye hain ki Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya har bachcha fitrat par paida kiya jata hai logon ne ba-aawaz buland daryaft kiya ki mushrikon ke bachche bhi? Aap ne farmaya haan mushrikon ke bachche bhi. Tabarani ki hadees mein hai ki mushrikon ke bachche ahl-e-jannat ke khadim banaye jayenge. Dasween hadees Musnad Ahmad mein hai ki ek sahabi ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jannat mein kaun kaun jayenge. Aap ne farmaya nabi aur shaheed bachche aur zinda dar-gor kiye hue bachche. Ulema mein se baaz ka maslak to yeh hai ki un ke bare mein hum tawwaqquf karte hain, khamosh hain un ki bhi guzar chuki. Baaz kehte hain yeh jannati hain un ki daleel meraj wali woh hadees hai jo Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Samurah bin Jundab (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se marwi hai ki aap ne apne is khwab mein ek shaikh ko ek jannati darakht tale dekha, jin ke paas bahut se bachche thay.

Sawal par Hazrat Jibril A.S ne bataya ke yeh Hazrat Ibrahim A.S hain aur un ke paas yeh bachche musalmanon ki aur mushrikon ki aulaad hain, logon ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ mushrikon ki aulaad bhi? Aap ne farmaya haan mushrikon ki aulaad bhi. Ba'z ulama farmate hain yeh dozakhi hain kyunke ek hadith mein hai ke woh apne baapon ke sath hain. Ba'z ulama kehte hain un ka imtihan qayamat ke maidaanon mein ho jayega. Itaat guzar jannat mein jayenge, Allah apne sabiqa ilm ka izhaar kar ke phir unhein jannat mein pohnchayega aur ba'z wajah apni nafarmani ke jo us imtihan ke waqt un se sarzad hogi aur Allah Ta'ala apna pehla ilm aashkara kar dega. Us waqt unhein jahannam ka hukm hoga. Us mazhab se tamam ahadith aur mukhtalif daleelon mein jam ho jati hain aur pehle ki hadithein jo ek dusri ko taqwiyat pohnchati hain us maani ki kayi ek hain. Shaikh Abu Al-Hasan Ali bin Ismail Ash'ari R.H ne yahi mazhab Ahl-e-Sunnat-wal-Jama'at ka naql farmaya hai. Aur usi ki ta'eed Imam Baihaqi R.H ne Kitab-ul-I'tiqaad mein ki hai. Aur bhi bohat se muhaqqiqin ulama aur parakh wale hafizon ne yahi farmaya hai. Shaikh Abu Umar bin Abdul Barr R.H Azi ne imtihan ki ba'z riwayatein bayan kar ke likha hai is bare ki hadithein qawi nahi hain aur un se hujjat sabit nahi hoti aur ahl-e-ilm ka inkar karte hain is liye ke aakhirat dar-e-jaza hai, dar-e-amal nahi hai aur na dar-e-imtihan hai. Aur jahannam mein jane ka hukm bhi to insani taqat se baher ka hukm hai aur Allah ki yeh aadat nahi. Imam Sahib R.H ke is qaul ka jawab bhi sun lijiye, is bare jo hadithein hain, un mein se ba'z to bilkul sahi hain. Jaise ke aimma ulama ne tasreeh ki hai. Ba'z hasan hain aur ba'z zaeef bhi hain lekin woh wajah sahi aur hasan ahadith ke qawi ho jati hain aur jab yeh hai to zahir hai ke yeh hadithein hujjat-o-daleel ke qabil ho gayin ab raha Imam Sahib ka yeh farman ke aakhirat dar-e-amal aur dar-e-imtihan nahi woh dar-e-jaza hai. Yeh beshak sahi hai lekin us se us ki nafi kaise ho gayi ke qayamat ke mukhtalif maidaanon ki peshiyon mein jannat dozakh mein dakhle se pehle koi hukm ahkaam na diye jayenge. Shaikh Abu Al-Hasan Ash'ari R.H ne to mazhab Ahl-e-Sunnat-wal-Jama'at ke aqaid mein bachchon ke imtihan ko dakhil kiya hai. Mazid baran ayat-e-Quran ayat (YAWMA YUKSHAFU ‘AN SAQIN WA YUD‘AWNA ILAS-SUJUDI FALAH YASTATI‘OUN) (68. Al-Qalam: 42) is ki khuli daleel hai ke munafiq-o-momin ki tameez ke liye pindli khol di jayegi aur sajde ka hukm hoga. Sihah ki ahadith mein hai ke momin to sajda kar lenge aur munafiq ulte munh peeth ke bal gir parenge. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein us shakhs ka qissa bhi hai jo sab se aakhir mein jahannam se niklega ke woh Allah se wade waeed karega siwa us sawal ke aur koi sawal na karega us ke pura hone ke baad woh apne qaul-o-qarar se phir jayega aur ek aur sawal kar baithega waghera. Aakhirat mein Allah Ta'ala farmayega ke Ibn-e-Adam to bara hi ahad shikan hai achcha ja, jannat mein chala ja.

Phir Imam Sahib ka yeh farmana ke unhein unki taqat se kharij baat ka yaani jahannam mein kood parne ka hukum kaise ho gaya? Allah Ta'ala kisi ko uski wus'at se zyada takleef nahi deta. Yeh bhi sehat-e-hadith mein koi rok paida nahi kar sakta. Khud Imam Sahib aur tamam Musalman maante hain ke pul-e-sirat par se guzarne ka hukum sab ko hoga jo jahannam ki peeth par hoga aur talwar se zyada tez aur baal se zyada bareek hoga. Momin us par se apni nekiyon ke andaze se guzar jayenge. Baaz misl bijli ke, baaz misl hawa ke, baaz misl ghoron ke, baaz misl oonton ke, baaz misl bhagne walon ke, baaz misl pedal jaane walon ke, baaz ghutnon ke bal sarak sarak kar, baaz kat kat kar, jahannam mein parenge. Pas jab yeh cheez wahan hai to unhein jahannam mein kood parne ka hukum to us se koi nahi balki yeh us se bara aur bohat bhaari hai. Aur suniye hadith mein hai ke Dajjal ke sath aag aur baagh hoga. Shari' ؑ ne mominoon ko hukum diya hai ke woh jise aag dekh rahe hain us mein se peeyen woh unke liye thandak aur salamati ki cheez hai. Pas yeh is waqia ki saaf nazeer hai. Aur lijiye Bani Israel ne jab gosala parasti ki us ki saza mein Allah ne hukum diya ke woh aapas mein ek dusre ko qatal karein ek abr ne aa kar unhein dhanp liya ab jo talwar chali toh subh hi subh abr phatne se pehle un mein se sattar hazaar aadmi qatal ho chuke thay. Bete ne baap ko aur baap ne bete ko qatal kiya kya yeh hukum is hukum se kam tha? Kya is ka amal nafs par garaan nahi? Phir toh is ki nisbat bhi keh dena chahiye tha ke Allah kisi nafs ko uski bardasht se zyada takleef nahi deta. In tamam bahson ke saaf hone ke baad ab suniye. Mushrikeen ke bachpan mein mare hue bachon ki babat bhi bohat se aqwal hain. Ek yeh ke yeh sab Jannati hain, unki daleel wahi Meraj mein Hazrat Ibrahim ؑ ke paas mushrikon aur Musalmanon ke bachon ko An-Hazrat ﷺ ka dekhna hai aur daleel unki Musnad ki woh riwayat hai jo pehle guzar chuki ke Aap ne farmaya bachhe jannat mein hain. Haan imtihan hone ki jo hadeethein guzar sakein woh un mein se khusoos hain. Pas jin ki nisbat Rabb-ul-Aalameen ko maloom hai ke woh mutee aur farmanbardar hain unki roohein aalam-e-barzakh mein Hazrat Ibrahim ؑ ke paas hain aur Musalmanon ke bachon ki roohein bhi. Aur jin ki nisbat Allah Ta'ala janta hai ke woh qubool karne wali nahi, un ka amr Allah ke supurd hai woh Qayamat ke din jahannami honge. Jaise ke ahadeeth-e-imtihan se zahir hai. Imam Ash'ari ؓ ne ise Ahl-e-Sunnat se naql kiya hai ab koi toh kehta hai ke yeh mustaqil taur par Jannati hain koi kehta hai yeh Ahl-e-Jannat ke khadim hain. Go aisi hadith Dawood Tayalisi mein hai lekin is ki sanad zaeef hai Wallahu A'lam. Dusra qaul yeh hai ke mushrikon ke bachhe bhi apne baap dadon ke sath jahannam mein jayenge jaise ke Musnad waghera ki hadith mein hai ke woh apne baap dadon ke tabe-dar hain. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Ayesha ؓ ne pucha bhi ke bawajood be-amal hone ke? Aap ne farmaya woh kya amal karne wale thay, ise Allah Ta'ala ba-khoobi janta hai.

Abu Dawood mein hai Hazrat Aisha R.A farmati hain. "Maine Rasoolullah ﷺ se musalmanon ki aulad ki baabat sawal kiya to Aap ne farmaya woh apne baap dadon ke sath hain. Maine kaha mushrikon ki aulad? Aap ne farmaya woh apne baap dadon ke sath hain. Maine kaha baghair is ke ke unhon ne koi amal kiya ho? Aap ne farmaya woh kya karte yeh Allah ke ilm mein hai. 

Musnad ki hadith mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya agar tu chahe to main un ka rona peetna aur cheekhna chalana bhi tujhe suna doon. Imam Ahmad R.H ke sahibzade riwayat laaye hain ke Hazrat Khadija R.A ne Rasoolullah ﷺ se apne un do bachon ki nisbat sawal kiya jo Jahiliyat ke zamane mein faut hue the, Aap ne farmaya woh dono dozakh mein hain, jab Aap ne dekha ke baat unhen bhaari padi hai to Aap ne farmaya agar tum un ki jagah dekh litin to tum khud un se bezaar ho jaatin. 

Hazrat Khadija R.A ne poocha achha jo bacha Aap se hua tha? Aap ne farmaya suno momin aur un ki aulad Jannati hai aur mushrik aur un ki aulad Jahannami hai. Phir Aap ne yeh aayat padhi (Wal-lazina amanu wattaba'ahum zurriyyatuhum bi-imanin alhaqna bihim zurriyyatahum) jo log iman laaye aur un ki aulad ne un ki ittaba ki iman ke sath, hum un ki aulad unhi ke sath mila denge. 

Yeh hadith ghareeb hai, is ki isnad mein Muhammad bin Usman raawi majhool-ul-hal hain aur un ke shaikh Zazan ne Hazrat Ali R.A ko nahi paya, Wallahu A'lam. 

Abu Dawood mein hadith hai: Zinda dar-gor karne wali aur zinda dar-gor karda shuda dozakhi hain. 

Abu Dawood mein yeh sanad Hasan marwi hai, Hazrat Salma bin Qais Ashja'i Razi Allahu Anhu farmate hain main apne bhai ko liye hue Rasoolullah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kaha ke Huzoor ﷺ hamari maan Jahiliyat ke zamane mein mar gayi hain, woh sila rahmi karne wali aur mehmaan nawaz thin, hamari ek nabaligh behan unhon ne zinda dafan kar di thi. Aap ne farmaya aisa karne wali aur jis ke sath aisa kiya gaya hai dono dozakhi hain, yeh aur baat hai ke woh Islam ko pa le aur ise qabool kar le. 

Teesra qaul yeh hai ke un ke baare mein tawqif karna chahiye, koi faisla kun baat yak-tarfa na kahni chahiye. Un ka itmad Aap ke is farman par hai ke un ke aamal ka sahi aur poora ilm Allah Ta'ala ko hai. Bukhari mein hai ke mushrikon ki aulad ke baare mein jab Aap se sawal hua to Aap ne unhi lafzon mein jawab diya tha. 

Ba'z buzurg kehte hain ke yeh A'raf mein rakhe jayenge. Is qaul ka natija yahi hai ke yeh Jannati hain is liye ke A'raf koi rehne sehne ki jagah nahi, yahan wale bil-akhir Jannat mein hi jayenge, jaise ke Surah A'raf ki tafsir mein hum is ki tafsir kar aaye hain, Wallahu A'lam. 

Yeh to tha ikhtilaf mushrikon ki aulad ke baare mein, lekin mominon ki nabaligh aulad ke baare mein to ulama ka bila ikhtilaf yahi qaul hai ke woh Jannati hain, jaise ke Hazrat Imam Ahmad ka qaul hai aur yahi logon mein mashhoor bhi hai aur Insha'Allah Azza wa Jalla humein bhi yahi umeed hai.

Lekin ba'z ulama se manqul hai ke woh un ke bare mein tawquf karte hain aur kehte hain ke sab bachche Allah ki marzi aur us ki chahat ke mataht hain. Ahl-e-fiqh aur Ahl-e-Hadith ki ek jamaat is taraf bhi gayi hai. Muwatta Imam Malik ki Abwab-ul-Qadr ki ahadees mein bhi kuch isi jaisa hai go Imam Malik ka koi faisla is mein nahi. Lekin ba'z mutakhireen ka qaul hai ke musalman bachche to jannati hain aur mushrikon ke bachche mashiyat-e-Ilahi ke mataht hain. Ibn Abdul Barr ne is baat ko isi wazahat se bayan kiya hai lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai. Kitab-e-Tazkirah mein Imam Qurtubi (Rahimahullah) ne bhi yahi farmaya hai Wallahu A'lam. Is bare mein un buzurgon ne ek hadees yeh bhi وارد ki hai ke Ansoriyon ke ek bachche ke janaze mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bulaya gaya to Umm-ul-Mumineen Aisha (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) ne farmaya is bachche ko marhaba ho yeh to jannat ki chidiya hai na burai ka koi kaam kiya na us zamane ko pahuncha to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is ke siwa kuch aur bhi Ae Aisha? Suno Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne jannat wale paida kiye hain halanki woh apne baap ki peeth mein thay. Isi tarah us ne jahannam ko paida kiya hai aur is mein jalne wale paida kiye hain halanki woh abhi apne baap ki peeth mein hain. Muslim aur Sunan ki yeh hadees hai chunke yeh masala sahi daleel ke baghair sabit nahi ho sakta aur log apni be-ilmi ke bais baghair suboot-e-shari'at ke is mein kalam karne lage hain. Is liye ulama ki ek jamaat ne is mein kalam karna hi napasand rakha hai. Ibn Abbas, Qasim bin Muhammad bin Abi Bakr Siddiq aur Muhammad bin Hanafiyya waghera ka mazhab yahi hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne to mimbar par khutbe mein farmaya tha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai ke is ummat ka kaam theek thak rahega jab tak ke yeh bachchon ke bare mein aur taqdeer ke bare mein kuch kalam na karenge (Ibn Hibban). Imam Ibn Hibban kehte hain murad is se mushrikon ke bachchon ke bare mein kalam na karna hai. Aur kitabon mein yeh riwayat Hazrat Abdullah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke apne qaul se mauqufan marwi hai.

Aal-e-Quresh se khitaab:

Ay Quraishiyon! Hosh sanbhalo, mere is buzurg Rasul ki takzeeb kar ke be-khauf na ho jao. Tum apne se pehle Nuh (A.S) ke baad ke logon ko dekho ke Rasulo ki takzeeb ne un ka naam-o-nishaan mita diya. Is se yeh bhi maloom hota hai ke Nuh (A.S) se pehle ke Hazrat Adam (A.S) tak ke log Deen-e-Islam par the. 

Pas tum, ay Quraishiyo, kuch un se zyada saaz-o-samaan aur ginti aur taaqat wale nahi ho. Is ke bawajood ke tum Ashraful-Rusul Khatamul-Anbiya (ﷺ) ko jhutla rahe ho, pas tum azaab aur saza ke zyada laaiq ho. 

Allah Ta'ala par apne kisi bande ka koi amal poshida nahi, khair-o-shar sab par zahir hai, khula chhipa sab woh jaanta hai, har amal ko khud dekh raha hai.

Talib-e-duniya ki chahat kuch zaroori nahin ke duniya ki har ek chahat poori ho, jis ka jo irada Allah poora karna chahe kar de lekin haan aise log aakhirat mein khaali haath reh jayenge. Yeh to wahan jahannam ke garhe mein ghare hue honge nihayat bure haal mein zillat-o-khwari mein honge. Kyunke yahan unhon ne yahi kiya tha, faani ko baaqi par duniya ko aakhirat par tarjeeh di thi is liye wahan Rahmat-e-Ilahi se door hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool اللہ ﷺ farmate hain duniya us ka ghar hai jis ke paas apni girah ki aql bilkul na ho. Haan jo sahi tareeqe se talib-dar aakhirat mein kaam aane wali nekiyan sunnat ke mutabiq karta rahe aur us ke dil mein bhi iman tasdeeq aur yaqeen ho azab sawab ke wade sahi janta ho, Allah-o-Rasool ko manta ho, un ki koshish qadr-dani se dekhi jayegi naik badla milega.

Haq daar ko haq diya jata hai yani un dono qism ke logon ko ek woh jin ka matlab sirf duniya hai dusre woh jo talib-e-akhirat hain dono qism ke logon ko hum barhate rehte hain jis mein bhi woh hain, yeh tere Rab ki ata hai, woh aisa mutasarrif aur hakim hai jo kabhi zulm nahi karta. Mustahiq-e-saadat ko saadat aur mustahiq-e-shaqawat ko shaqawat de deta hai. Us ke ahkaam koi radd nahi kar sakta, us ke roke hue ko koi de nahi sakta us ke iradon ko koi taal nahi sakta. Tere Rab ki nematein aam hain, na kisi ke roke rukein, na kisi ke hataye hatein woh na kam hoti hain na ghatti hain. Dekh lo ke duniya mein hum ne insanon ke kaise mukhtatil darje rakhe hain un mein ameer bhi hain, faqeer bhi hain darmiyana halat mein bhi hain, ache bhi hain, bure bhi hain aur darmiyana darje ke bhi. Koi bachpan mein marta hai, koi burha bada ho kar, koi us ke darmiyan. Akhirat darjon ke aitbaar se duniya se bhi badhi hui hai kuch toh tauq-o-zanjeer pehne hue jahannam ke garhon mein honge, kuch jannat ke darjon mein honge, buland-o-bala bala khanon mein nemat-o-raahat suroor-o-khushi mein, phir khud jannatiyon mein bhi darjon ka tafawut hoga ek ek darje mein zameen-o-asman ka sa tafawut hoga. Jannat mein aise ek sau darje hain. Buland darjon wale Ahl-e-Illiyyin ko is tarah dekhenge jaise tum kisi chamakte sitare ko asman ki unchai par dekhte ho. Pas akhirat darjon aur fazeelton ke aitbaar se bohat badi hai, Tabarani mein hai jo banda duniya mein jo darja chadna chahega aur apni khwahish mein kamyab hojayega darja ghata dega jo us se bohat bada hai phir aap ne yahi ayat padhi.

Faqah aur insan yeh khitab har ek mukallaf se hai. Aap ki tamam ummat ko Haq Tabarak wa Ta'ala farmata hai ki apne Rab ki ibadat mein kisi ko sharik na karo. Agar aisa karoge toh zaleel ho jaoge, Allah ki madad hat jayegi. Jis ki ibadat karoge usi ke supurd kar diye jaoge aur yeh zahir hai ki Allah ke siva koi nafa nuqsan ka malik nahi, woh wahid la sharik hai. Musnad Ahmad mein Rasool اللہ ﷺ farmate hain, jise faqah pahuche aur woh logon se ise band karwana chahe, uska faqah band na hoga aur jo Allah se iski babat dua kare, Allah uske paas tongri bhej dega, ya toh jaldi ya der se. Yeh hadith Abu Dawood o Tirmidhi mein hai. Tirmidhi ؒ ise hasan sahih ghareeb batlate hain.

Atal faisle, muhkam hukm yahan qaza'a ma'ani mein hukm farmane ke hain, takeedi hukm-e-Ilahi jo kabhi talne wala nahi, yehi hai ke ibadat Allah hi ki ho aur walidain ki itaat mein sar-e-mu farq na aaye. Ubayy bin Ka'ab, Ibn Mas'ud aur Zahhak bin Muzahim ki qirat mein qaza'a ke badle wasiyya hai. Yeh dono hukm aik sath jaise yahan hain aise hi aur bhi bahut si aayaton mein hain. Jaise farman hai aayat: (An-ishkur li wa li-walidayka ilayyal-maseer - 31. Luqman: 14) mera shukr kar aur apne ma-baap ka bhi ehsanmand reh. Khususan unke barhapay ke zamane mein unka poora adab karna, koi buri baat zuban se na nikalna yahan tak ke unke samne "uff" bhi na karna, na koi aisa kaam karna jo unhe bura maloom ho, apna hath unki taraf be-adbi se na barhana, balkay adab, izzat aur ihtiram ke sath unse baat-chit karna, narmi aur tehzeeb se guftugu karna, unki raza-mandi ke kaam karna, dukh na dena, satana nahi, unke samne tawazu, aajizi, farutani aur khaksari se rehna, unke liye unke barhapay mein aur unke inteqal ke bad duaein karte rehna. Khususan dua ke "Aww, Allah! Un par raham kar jaise raham se unhon ne mere bachpan ke zamane mein meri parwarish ki." Haan, iman-daron ko kafiron ke liye dua karna mana ho gayi hai, go woh baap hi kyun na hon? 

Ma-baap se suluk-o-ehsan ke ahkam ki hadeesein bahut si hain. Aik riwayat mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mimar par charhte hue teen dafa aamin kahi, jab Aap se wajah دریافت ki gayi to Aap ne farmaya mere paas Jibrail (Alaihis Salam / A.S) aaye aur kaha, "Aisi nabi! Us shakhs ki nak khak-alood ho, jiske paas tera zikr ho aur us ne tujh par durood bhi na parha ho, kahiye aamin." Chunacha main ne aamin kahi. Phir farmaya, "Us shakhs ki nak bhi Allah Ta'ala khak-alood kare jiski zindagi mein mah-e-Ramzan aaya aur chala bhi gaya aur uski bakhshish na hui, aamin kahiye." Chunacha main ne is par bhi aamin kahi. Phir farmaya, "Allah use bhi barbad kare jis ne apne ma-baap ko ya un mein se aik ko pa liya aur phir bhi unki khidmat kar ke jannat mein na pahunch saka, kahiye aamin." Main ne kaha, "Aamin."

Musnad Ahmad ki hadees mein hai, "Jis ne kisi musalman ma-baap ke yateem bachhe ko pala aur khilaya-pilaya yahan tak ke woh be-niyaz ho gaya, uske liye yaqinan jannat wajib hai aur jis ne kisi musalman ghulam ko azad kiya, Allah use jahannam se azad karega, uske aik aik uzw ke badle uska aik aik uzw jahannam se azad hoga." Is hadees ki aik sanad mein hai, "Jis ne apne ma-baap ko ya dono mein se kisi aik ko pa liya, phir bhi dozakh mein gaya, Allah use apni rehmat se door kare." 

Musnad Ahmad ki aik riwayat mein ye teeno cheezein aik sath bayan hui hain, yaani gardan azad karna, khidmat-e-walidain aur parwarish-e-yateem. Aik riwayat mein ma-baap ki nisbat yeh bhi hai ke Allah use door kare aur use barbad kare al-kh. Aik riwayat mein teen martaba uske liye yeh bad-dua hai.

Aik riwayat mein Huzoor ﷺ ka naam sun kar durood na parhne wale aur mah-e-Ramzan mein bakhshish-e-Ilahi se mehroom reh jane wale aur maa baap ki khidmat aur raza-mandi se jannat mein na pohnchne wale ke liye khud Huzoor ﷺ ka yeh bad-dua karna manqool hai. Aik Ansari ne Huzoor ﷺ se sawal kiya ke mere maa baap ke inteqal ke baad bhi un ke sath main koi sulook kar sakta hoon? Aap ne farmaya haan, chaar sulook: 001 un ke janaze ki namaz, 002 un ke liye dua-o-istighfar, 003 un ke wadon ko poora karna, 004 un ke doston ki izzat karna aur woh silah-e-rahmi jo sirf un ki wajah se ho. Yeh hai woh sulook jo un ki maut ke baad bhi tu un ke sath kar sakta hai (Abu Dawood, Ibn Majah). Aik shakhs ne aa kar Huzoor ﷺ se kaha, "Ya Rasulallah ﷺ! Main jihad ke irade se aap ki khidmat mein khushkhabri lekar aya hoon." Aap ne farmaya, "Teri maa hai?" Us ne kaha, "Haan." Farmaya, "Ja, usi ki khidmat mein laga reh, jannat usi ke pairon ke paas hai." Dobara se-bara us ne mukhtarif mawaqe par apni yehi baat dohrai aur yehi jawab Huzoor ﷺ ne bhi dohraiya (Nasai, Ibn Majah waghairah). Farmate hain, "Allah tumhein tumhare baapon ki nisbat wasiyyat farmata hai, Allah tumhein tumhari maon ki nisbat wasiyyat farmata hai." Pichle jumle ko teen baar bayan farmaya, "Allah tumhein tumhare qarabat-daron ki babat wasiyyat karta hai, sab se zyada nazdeek wala phir us ke paas wala" (Ibn Majah, Musnad Ahmad). Farmate hain, "Dene wale ka hath ooncha hai, apni maa se sulook kar aur apne baap se aur apni behan se aur apne bhai se phir jo us ke baad ho isi tarah darja-badarja" (Musnad Ahmad). Bazzar ki Musnad mein zaeef sanad se marwi hai ke aik shakhs apni maa ko uthaye hue tawaf kara rahe the, Huzoor ﷺ se دریافت karne lage ke ab to main ne apni walida ka haq ada kar diya hai? Aap ne farmaya, "Aik shamah bhi nahi." Wallahu A'lam.

Gunah aur Istighfar

Is se murad woh log hain, jin se jaldi mein apne maa baap ke sath koi aisi baat ho jaati hai jise woh apne nazdeek aib ki aur gunah ki baat nahi samajhte hain kyunke un ki niyat ba-khair hoti hai, is liye Allah un par rahmat karta hai jo maa baap ka farmanbardar namazi ho us ki khataayein Allah ke haan maaf hain. 

Kehte hain ke Awabeen woh log hain jo Maghrib Isha ke darmiyan nawafil padhein. Baaz kehte hain jo subah ki namaz ada karte rahein, jo har gunah ke baad tauba kar liya karein. Jo jaldi se bhalai ki taraf laut aaya karein. Tanhai mein apne gunahon ko yaad kar ke khuloos-e-dil se istighfar kar liya karein. Ubaid kehte hain jo barabar har majlis se uthte hue yeh dua padh liya karein: 
Dua: (Allahumma-ghfir li ma asabtu fi majlisi hadha).

Ibn Jarir Rahimahullah farmate hain aula qaul yeh hai ke jo gunah se tauba kar liya karein. Maasiyat se taa't ki taraf aa jaaya karein. Allah ki napasandidagi ke kaamon ko tark kar ke us ki raza-mandi aur pasandidagi ke kaam karne lagein. 

Yahi qaul bohat theek hai kyunke lafz Awwab mushtaq hai Awb se aur is ke maana rujoo karne ke hain jaise arab kehte hain (Aaba fulan) aur jaise Quran mein hai: 
Aayat: (Inna ilaina iyabahum - 88. Al-Ghashiyah: 25) 
In ka lotna hamari hi taraf hai.

Sahih hadis mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ jab safar se lautte to farmate: 
Dua: (Aaboon, taiboon, 'abidoon li-rabbina hamidoon) 
Lotne wale, tauba karne wale, ibadatein karne wale, apne Rabb ki hi taareefein karne wale.

Maa baap se husn-e-sulook ki taakeed maa baap se phir jo zyada qareeb ho aur jo zyada qareeb ho, aur hadith mein hai jo apne rizq ki aur apni umar ki taraqqi chahta ho use silah rahmi karni chahiye. Bazzaz mein hai is ayat ke utarte hi Rasulullah ﷺ ne Hazrat Fatimah ko bula kar Fadak ata farmaya. Is hadith ki sanad sahih nahi. Aur waqia bhi kuch theek nahi maloom hota is liye ke yeh ayat Makkiyah hai aur us waqt tak bagh-e-Fadak Huzoor ﷺ ke qabze mein na tha. San 7 Hijri mein Khaibar fateh hua tab bagh apke qabze mein aya pas yeh qissa is par poora nahi utarta. Masakeen aur musafirin ki poori tafseer Surah Barat mein guzar chuki hai yahan dohrane ki chandaan zaroorat nahi. Kharch ka hukum kar ke phir israaf se mana farmata hai. Na to insan ko bakhil hona chahiye na musraf balki darmiyana darja rakhe. Jaise aur ayat mein hai (Walla-zi-na iza anfaqu lam yusrifu wa lam yaqturu wa kana baina zalika qawama) (25. Al-Furqan: 67) yaani imandar apne kharch mein na to had se guzarte hain na bilkul hath rok lete hain. Phir israaf ki burai bayan farmata hai ke aise log Shaitan jaise hain. Us ne kaha hasbiyallah, acha Huzoor ﷺ jab main apke qasid ko zakat ada kar doon toh Allah o Rasul ke nazdeek main bari ho gaya? Miyana rawi ki taleem hukm ho raha hai ke apni zindagi mein miyana rawash rakho na bakheel bano na musrif. Haath gardan se na baandh lo yaani bakheel na bano ke kisi ko na do. Yahudiyon ne bhi isi muhawray ko istemal kiya hai aur kaha hai ke Allah ke haath bandhe hue hain. Un par Allah ki la'anten nazil hon ke yeh Allah ko bakheeli ki taraf mansoub karte thay. Jis se Allah Ta'ala Kareem-o-Wahhab paak aur bahut door hai. Pas bukhl se mana kar ke phir israf se rokta hai ke itna khul na khelo ke apni taqat se ziyada de dalo. Phir in dono hukmon ka sabab bayan farmata hai ke bakheeli se to malamati ban jaoge har ek ki ungli uthegi ke yeh bara bakheel hai har ek door ho jaega ke yeh mahz befayz aadmi hai. Jaise Zuhair ne apne mu'allaqa mein kaha hai: Wa man kan dha malin wa yabkhalu bi malihi, 'ala qawmihi yastaghni 'anhu wa yuzmam. Yaani jo maldar ho kar bakheeli kare log us se beniyaz ho kar is ki burai karte hain. Pas bakheeli ki wajah se insan bura ban jata hai aur logon ki nazron se gir jata hai har ek use malamat karne lagta hai aur jo had se ziyada kharch kar guzarta hai woh thak kar baith jata hai us ke haath mein kuch nahi rehta. Zaeef aur aajiz ho jata hai jaise koi janwar jo chalte chalte thak jaye aur raste mein ur jaye. Lafz haseer Surah Tabarak mein bhi aya hai. Pas yeh ba-taur laf-o-nashr ke hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadis mein hai bakheel aur sakhi ki misal un do shakhson jaisi hai jin par do lohe ke jabbe hon, seene se gale tak, sakhi to jyun jyun kharch karta hai is ki kadiyan dheeli hoti jati hain aur us ke haath khulte jate hain aur woh jabba barh jata hai yahan tak ke is ki puriyon tak pahunch jata hai aur is ke asar ko mitata hai aur bakheel jab kabhi kharch ka irada karta hai to is ke jabbe ki kadiyan aur simat jati hain woh harchand use wasee karna chahta hai lekin is mein gunjaish nahi nikalti. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Aap ne Hazrat Asma bint Abi Bakr R.A se farmaya Allah ki raah mein kharch karti reh jama na rakha kar, warna Allah bhi rok lega bandh baandh kar rok na liya kar warna phir Allah bhi rizq ka munh band karlega. Ek aur rawat mein hai shumar kar warna Allah bhi rok lega bandh baandh kar rok na liya kar warna phir Allah bhi rizq ka munh band karlega ek aur rawat mein hai shumar kar ke na rakha karo warna Allah Ta'ala bhi ginti kar ke nahi dega. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A se farmaya ke tu Allah ki raah mein kharch kiya kar, Allah Ta'ala tujhe deta rahega. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain har subah do farishte aasman se utarte hain ek dua karta hai ke اے اللہ sakhi ko badla de aur doosra dua karta hai ke bakheel ka maal talaf kar. Muslim shareef mein hai sadqe khairaat se kisi ka maal nahi ghatta aur har sakhawat karne wale ko Allah zi-izzat kar deta hai aur jo shakhs Allah ke hukm ki wajah se doosron se aajizana bartao kare Allah use buland darje ka kar deta hai.

Aik aur hadith mein hai tama se bacho, isi ne tum se agle logon ko halak kiya hai. Tama ka pehla hukm yeh hota hai ke bakhili karo, unhon ne bakhili ki phir is ne unhein silah-rahmi todne ko kaha unhon ne yeh bhi kiya, phir fisq-o-fujoor ka hukm diya, yeh is par bhi kar-band huwe. Baihaqi mein hai jab insan khairat karta hai, sattar shaitanon ke jabre toot jate hain. Musnad ki hadith mein hai darmiyana kharch rakhne wala kabhi faqir nahi hota. Phir farmata hai ke rizq dene wala, kushaadgi karne wala, tangi mein dalne wala, apni makhlooq mein apni hasb-e-mansha her-pher karne wala, jise chahe ghani aur jise chahe faqir karne wala Allah hi hai. Har baat mein is ki hikmat hai, wahi apni hikmaton ka Alim hai, woh khoob janta hai aur dekhta hai ke mustahiq-e-imarat kaun hai aur mustahiq-e-faqiri kaun hai? Hadith-e-Qudsi mein hai mere baaz bande woh hain ke faqiri hi ke qabil hain agar main unhein ameer bana doon toh un ka deen tabaah ho jaye aur mere baaz bande aise bhi hain jo ameeri ke layak hain agar main unhein faqir bana doon toh un ka deen bigad jaye. Haan yeh yaad rahe ke baaz logon ke haq mein ameeri Allah ki taraf se dheel ke taur par hoti hai aur baaz ke liye faqiri bataur-e-azab hoti hai. Allah Ta'ala hamein in donon se bachaye.

Qatl-e-Aulaad ki muzammat dekho, Allah Ta'ala apne bando par ba-nisbat un ke maa-baap ke bhi zyada meharban hai. Ek taraf maa-baap ko hukm deta hai ke apna maal apne bachon ko bataur-e-wirsay ke do aur doosri jaanib farmata hai ke unhein maar na dala karo. Jahiliyat ke log na to larkiyon ko wirsa dete the aur na unka zinda rakhna pasand karte the, balki dukhtar-kashi unki kaum ka ek aam riwaj tha. Quran is na-farjam riwaj ki tardid karta hai ke yeh khayal kis qadar bauda hai ke unhein khilayenge kahan se? Kisi ki rozi kisi ke zimma nahi, sab ka rozi-rasan Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Surah An'am mein farmaya ayat: (وَلَا تَقْتُلُوْٓا اَوْلَادَكُمْ خَشْـيَةَ اِمْلَاقٍ ۭ نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَاِيَّاكُمْ ۭ اِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ كَانَ خِطْاً كَبِيْرًا 31؀) (17. Al-Isra: 31). Faqeeri aur tang-dasti ke khauf se apni aulaad ki jaan na liya karo. Tumhein aur unhein roziyan dene wale hum hain. Unka qatl jurm-e-azeem aur gunah-e-kabeera hai. Khita ki doosri qiraat khata hai, dono ke ma'ayi ek hi hain. Bukhari o Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) ne poocha: Ya Rasulallah (ﷺ)! Allah ke nazdeek sab se bara gunah kya hai? Aap ne farmaya: Yeh ke tu kisi ko Allah ka shareek thehraye halanki usi akele ne tujhe paida kiya hai. Main ne poocha: Uske baad? Farmaya: Yeh ke tu apni aulaad ko is khauf se maar dale ke woh tere sath khayenge. Main ne kaha: Uske baad? Farmaya: Yeh ke tu apni parosan se zina-kari kare.

Kabeera gunahon se mamanat zina kari aur us ke ard-gird ki tamam siyah kariyon se Quran rok raha hai. Zina ko Shariat ne kabeera aur bahut sakht gunah bataya hai woh bad-tareen tareeqa aur nihayat buri raah hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke ek naujawan ne zina kari ki ijazat Aap se chahi log us par jhuk pade ke chup reh kya kar raha hai, kya keh raha hai. Aap ne use apne qareeb bula kar farmaya baith ja jab woh baith gaya to Aap ne farmaya kya tu is kaam ko apni maan ke liye pasand karta hai? Us ne kaha nahin Allah ki qasam nahin Ya Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe Aap par Allah fida kare hargiz nahin. Aap ne farmaya phir soch le ke koi aur kaise pasand karega? Aap ne farmaya achha to ise apni beti ke liye pasand karta hai? Us ne isi tarah takeed se inkar kiya. Aap ne farmaya theek isi tarah koi bhi ise apni betiyon ke liye pasand nahin karta achha apni behen ke liye ise tu pasand karega? Us ne isi tarah se inkar kiya Aap ne farmaya isi tarah doosre bhi apni behnon ke liye ise makrooh samajhte hain. Bata kya tu chahega ke koi teri phoopi se aisa kare? Us ne isi sakhti se inkar kiya. Aap ne farmaya isi tarah aur sab log bhi. Phir Aap ne apna hath us ke sar par rakh kar dua ki ke Ilahi is ke gunah bakhsh, is ke dil ko paak kar, ise ismat wala bana. Phir to yeh halat thi ke yeh naujawan kisi ki taraf nazar bhi na uthata. Ibn Abi al-Dunya mein hai Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate shirk ke baad koi gunah zina kari se badh kar nahin ke aadmi apna nutfa kisi aise reham mein dale jo us ke liye halal nahin.

Nahaq qatl baghair haq-e-shar'i ke kisi ko qatl karna haram hai. Bukhari Muslim mein hai jo musalman Allah ke wahid hone ki aur Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Rasool hone ki shahadat deta ho us ka qatl teen baton ke siwa halal nahin. Ya toh us ne kisi ko qatl kiya ho ya shadi shuda ho aur phir zina kiya ho ya deen ko chhod kar jamaat ko chhod diya ho. Sunan mein hai sari duniya ka fana ho jana Allah ke nazdeek ek momin ke qatl se zyada aasan hai. Agar koi shakhs nahaq dusre ke hathon qatl kiya gaya hai toh us ke warison ko Allah Ta'ala ne qatl par ghalib kar diya hai. Use qisas lene aur diyat lene aur bilkul maaf kar dene mein se ek ka ikhtiyar hai. Ek ajeeb baat yeh hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne is ayat-e-karima ke umoom se Hazrat Mu'awiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki saltanat par istidlal kiya hai ke woh badshah ban jayenge is liye ke Hazrat Usman (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) intehai mazloomi ke sath shaheed kiye gaye thay. Hazrat Mu'awiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) qatil-an-e-Hazrat Usman (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se talab karte thay ke un se qisas lein is liye ke yeh bhi Umavi thay aur Hazrat Usman (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) bhi Umavi thay. Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) is mein zara dheel kar rahe thay. Idhar Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ka mutalba Hazrat Mu'awiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se yeh tha ke mulk-e-Sham un ke supurd kar dein. Hazrat Mu'awiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain ta-waqt-e-ke aap qatil-an-e-Usman (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko na dein main mulk-e-Sham ko aap ki zer-e-hukumat na karunga chunancha aap ne ma'a kul ahl-e-Sham ke bai'at-e-Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se inkar kar diya. Is jhagde ne tool pakda aur Hazrat Mu'awiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) Sham ke hukmran ban gaye. Mu'jam Tabrani mein yeh riwayat hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne raat ki guftagu mein ek dafa farmaya ke aaj main tumhein ek baat sunata hoon na toh woh aisi posheeda hai, na aisi alaniya Hazrat Usman (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke sath jo kuch kiya gaya, us waqt main ne Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko mashwara diya ke aap yak-sooi ikhtiyar kar lein, wallah agar aap kisi patthar mein chhupe hue honge toh nikal liye jayenge lekin unhon ne meri na mani. Ab ek aur suno Allah ki qasam Mu'awiyah tum par badshah ho jayenge, is liye ke Allah ka farman hai, jo mazloom maar dala jaye, hum us ke warison ko ghalba aur taqat dete hain. Phir unhein qatl ke badle mein qatl mein had se na guzarna chahiye al-kh. Suno yeh Quraishi toh tumhein Fars-o-Room ke tariqon par amada kar denge aur suno tum par Nasara aur Yahood aur Majoosi khade ho jayenge us waqt jis ne ma'roof ko tham liya us ne nijat pa li aur jis ne chhod diya aur afsos ke tum chhodne walon mein se hi ho toh misl ek zamane walon ke ho-oge ke woh bhi halak hone walon mein halak ho gaye. Ab farmaya wali ko qatl ke badle mein had se na guzar jana chahiye ke woh qatl ke sath misla kare. Kaan, naak, kaate ya qatl ke siwa aur se badla le. Wali-e-maqtool shariat, ghalbe aur muqaddarat ke lihaz se har tarah madad kiya gaya hai.

Yatim ka maal yatim ke maal mein badniyati se her pher na karo, un ke maal un ki bulughat se pehle saaf daalne ke napak iradon se bacho. Jis ki parwarish mein yeh yatim bachche hon agar woh khud maldar hai tab to use in yateemon ke maal se bilkul alag rehna chahiye aur agar woh faqeer mohtaj hai toh khair biqadar-e-maroof kha le. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne Abu Zar R.A se farmaya main to tujhe bohat kamzor dekh raha hoon aur tere liye wohi pasand farmata hoon, jo khud apne liye chahta hoon. Khabardar kabhi do shakhson ka wali na banna aur na kabhi yatim ke maal ka mutawalli banna. Phir farmata hai waada wafai kiya karo jo wade waeed jo lain dain ho jaye us ki pasbani karo us ki baabat Qiyamat ke din jawab dahi hogi. Naap paimana poora poora kar diya logon ko un ki cheez ghata kar kam na do. Qustas ki doosri qiraat Qistas bhi hai phir hukm hota hai baghair passing ke sahi wazan batane wali seedhi tarazu se baghair dandi maare tola karo, dono jahan mein tum sab ke liye yehi behtari hai duniya mein bhi yeh tumhare lain dain ki ronaq hai aur aakhirat mein bhi yeh tumhare chhutkaare ki daleel hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ae tajiro tumhe in do cheezon ko sonpa gaya hai jin ki wajah se tum se pehle ke log barbad ho gaye yani naap tol. Nabi ﷺ farmate hain ke jo shakhsh kisi haram par qudrat rakhte hue sirf khauf-e-Khuda se ise chhod de toh Allah Ta'ala isi duniya mein use is se behtar cheez ata farmayega.

Bila tahqiq faisla na karo yani jis baat ka ilm na ho us mein zuban na hulao. Baghair ilm ke kisi ki aib-joi aur buhtan-bazi na karo. Jhooti shahadatein na dete phro. Bin dekhe na keh diya karo ke main ne dekha, na be-sune sunna bayan karo, na be-ilmi par apna janna bayan karo. Kyunke in tamam baton ki jawab-dehi Allah ke haan hogi. Gharz wahm, khayal aur guman ke taur par kuch kehna mana ho raha hai. Jaise farman-e-Quran hai ayat (Ya ayyuhal-lazina amanut-jtanibu kasiran minaz-zann) (Surah Al-Hujurat: 12), ke zyada guman se bacho, ba'z guman gunah hain. Hadith mein hai guman se bacho, guman badtareen jhooti baat hai. Abu Dawud ki hadith mein hai insan ka yeh takiya-kalam bahut hi bura hai ke log khayal karte hain. Aur hadith mein hai badtareen buhtan yeh hai ki insan jhoot-moot koi khwab ghad le aur sahih hadith mein hai jo shakhs aisa khwab az-khud ghad le Qiyamat ke din use yeh takleef di jayegi ke woh do jau ke darmiyan girah lagaye aur yeh us se hargiz nahi hona. Qiyamat ke din aankh, kaan, dil sab se baaz-purs hogi sab ko jawab-dehi karni hogi. Yahan tilak ki jagah ulaika ka istemal hai, Arab mein istemal barabar jari hai yahan tak ke shairon ke sheron mein bhi.

Takabur ke sath chalne ki mamanat: Akar kar, utra kar, takabur ke sath chalne se Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko mana farmata hai. Yeh aadat sarkash aur maghror logon ki hai phir ise neecha dikhane ke liye farmata hai ki go kitne hi buland sar ho kar chalo lekin pahari ki bulandi se past hi rahoge aur go kaise hi khat-pat karte hue paon maar maar kar chalo lekin zameen ko phaadne se rahe. Balkiye aise logon ka haal barkas hota hai jaise ki hadith mein hai ki ek shakhs chadar jode mein utrata huwa chala ja raha tha jo wahin zameen mein dhansa diya gaya jo aaj tak dhanta huwa chala ja raha hai. Quran mein Qarun ka qissa maujood hai ki woh ma' apne mahalat ke zameen-doz kar diya gaya. 

Haaan tawazu, narmi, farotni aur aajizi karne walon ko Allah Ta'ala buland karta hai woh apne aap ko haqeer samajhta hai aur log use jaleel-ul-qadr samajhte hain aur takabur karne wala apne tain bada aadmi samajhta hai aur logon ki nigahon mein woh zaleel-o-khwar hota hai yahan tak ki woh use kutton aur suaron se bhi zyada haqeer jaante hain. 

Imam Abu Bakr bin Abi Ad-Duniya ؒ apni kitab Al-Mahmul wat-Tawazu mein laye hain ki Ibn Al-Ahim darbar-e-Mansoor mein ja raha tha reshemi jubba pehne hue tha aur pndliyon ke upar se use dohra silwaya tha ki neeche se qaba bhi dikhai deti rahe aur akadta ethata ja raha tha. Hazrat Hasan ؒ ne ise is halat mein dekh kar farmaya afwoh nak chadha, bal khaya, rukhsaaron phoola, apne dand-bazu dekhta, apne tain tolta, maston ke zikr-o-shukr ko bhoola, Rab ke ahkaam ko chhode hue, Allah ke haq ko toda, deewanon ki chaal chalta, uzru uzru mein kisi ki di hui nemat rakhta, shaitan ka la'nat ka maara hua dekho ja raha hai. Al-Ahim ne sun liya aur usi waqt laut aaya aur uzr bahana karne laga. Aap ne farmaya mujh se kya maazrat karta hai Allah Ta'ala se tauba kar aur ise tark kar. Kya tu ne Allah Ta'ala ka yeh farman nahi suna ayat (Wala tamshi fil-ardi marahan innaka lan takhriqal-arda wa lan tablughal-jibala tula) (17. Al-Isra: 37). 

Aabid Bakhtari ؒ ne Aal-e-Ali mein se ek shakhs ko akadte hue chalta dekh kar farmaya ae shakhs jis ne tujhe yeh ikram diya hai us ki rosh aisi na thi. Us ne usi waqt tauba kar li. Ibn Umar ؓ ne ek aise shakhs ko dekh kar farmaya ki shaitan ke yehi bhai hote hain. Hazrat Khalid bin Ma'dan ؒ farmate hain logo akad akad kar chalna chhodo is liye ki insan. (Asl arabi mein kuch ibarat ghaib hai) is ka hath us ke baqi jism se (Ibn Abi Ad-Duniya). Ibn Abi Ad-Duniya mein hadith hai ki jab meri ummat ghuroor aur takabur ki chaal chalne lagegi aur Farsiyon aur Romiyon ko apni khidmat mein lagayegi toh Allah Ta'ala ek ko ek par musallat kar dega. 

Seyyuh ki doosri qirat Seyyituh hai toh ma'yani yeh hue ki jin jin kaamon se hum ne tumhein roka hai yeh sab kaam nihayat bure hain aur Allah Ta'ala ke napasandeeda hain. Yaani apni aulad ko qatal na karo se lekar akad kar na chalo tak ke tamam kaam.

Aur Sayyi'ah ki qira'at par matlab yeh hai ke Aayat (Wa Qada Rabbuka) se yahan tak jo hukum ahkam aur jo maman'at aur rok bayan hui is mein jin bure kamon ka zikr hai woh sab Allah ke nazdeek makrooh kaam hain. Imam Ibn Jarir (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne yehi taujeeh bayan farmai hai.

Zaleel ki aadaatein yeh ahkaam hum ne diye hain. Sab behtreen ausaaf hain aur jin baaton se hum ne roka hai woh bari zaleel khsaltein hain hum yeh sab baatein teri taraf ba-zariya wahi ke nazil farma rahe hain ke tu logon ko hukam de aur mana kare. Dekh mere sath kisi ko mabood na thirana warna woh waqt aayega ke khud apne aap ko malamat karne lagega aur Allah ki taraf se bhi malamat hogi balki tamam aur makhlooq ki taraf se bhi. Aur tu har bhalai se door kardiya jayega. Is aayat mein bi-wasita Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap ki ummat se khitab hai kyunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) toh masoom hain.

Mujrimana soch par tabsarah mal'oon mushrikon ki tardeed ho rahi hai ke yeh tum ne khoob taqseem ki hai ke bete tumhare aur betiyan Allah ki. Jo tumhein ناپسند (napasand) jin se tum jalo kadho. Balke zinda dargor kardo unhein Allah ke liye sabit karo. Aur aayaton mein bhi un ka yeh kamina pan bayan hua hai ke yeh kehte hain Rab-e-Rahman ki aulaad hai haqiqatan unka yeh qaul nihayat hi bura hai bahut mumkin hai ke is se aasman phat jaye, zameen shaq hojaye, pahad choora choora hojaye ke yeh Allah-e-Rahman ki aulaad thehra rahe hain halanki Allah ko yeh kisi tarah layak hi nahi. Zameen-o-Aasman ki kul makhlooq us ki ghulam hai. Sab us ke shumar mein hain aur ginti mein aur ek ek us ke samne Qiyamat ke din tanha pesh hone wala hai.

Dalail ke sath hidayat is pak kitab mein hum ne tamam misalein khol khol kar bayan farma di hain. Wa'ade wa'eid saf taur par mazkur hain taake log buraiyon se aur Allah ki na-farmaniyon se bachein. Lekin taham zalim log to haq se nafrat rakhte aur us se dur bhagne mein hi barh rahe hain.

Logon aql ke naakhun lo jo mushrik Allah ke sath auron ki bhi ibadat karte hain aur unhein shareeq-e-Ilahi maante hain aur samajhte hain ki unhi ki wajah se hum qurb-e-Ilahi hasil kar sakte hain, unse kaho ki agar tumhara yeh guman-e-fasid kuch bhi jaan rakhta hota aur Allah ke sath waqayi koi aise maabud hote ki woh jise chahein qurb-e-Ilahi dilwa dein aur jis ki jo chahein sifarish kar dein toh khud woh maabud hi us ki ibadat karte, us ka qurb dhoondte, pas tumhein sirf usi ki ibadat karni chahiye, na us ke siva dusre ki ibadat, na dusre maabud ki koi zarurat ki Allah mein aur tum mein woh wasita bane. Allah ko yeh wasite sakht napasand aur makrooh maloom hote hain aur un se woh inkar karta hai apne tamam nabiyon rasolon ki zaban se us se mana farmata hai. Us ki zat zalimon ke bayan karda is wasf se bilkul pak hai aur us ke siva koi maabud nahi. In aludgiyon se hamara Maula pak hai, woh Ahad aur Samad hai, woh maan baap aur aulad se pak hai, us ki jins ka koi nahi.
