Subhan Al-Ali Al-A'la saton asman-o-zameen aur un mein basne wali kul makhlooq us ki quddusiyat, tasbeeh, tanzeeh, ta'zeem, jalalat, buzurgi, barai, pakeezagi aur taarif bayan karti hai aur mushrikeen jo nikm-e-aur batil ausaf zat-e-haq ke liye mante hain, un se yeh tamam makhlooq bara'at ka izhar karti hai aur us ki uluhiyat aur rububiyat mein use wahid aur la shareek manti hai. Har hasti Allah ki tawheed ki zinda shahadat hai. In nalaiq logon ke aqwal se makhlooq takleef mein hai. Qareeb hai ke asman phat jaye, zameen dhans jaye, pahaar toot jayen. Tabrani mein marwi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ko maqam-e-Ibrahim aur Zamzam ke darmiyan se Jibreel-o-Mikaeel Masjid-e-Aqsa tak shab-e-meraj mein le gaye, Jibreel ap ke dayen the aur Mikaeel bayen. Ap ko saton asman tak ura le gaye wahan se ap loote. Ap farmate hain ke main ne buland asmanon mein bohat si tasbeehat ke sath yeh tasbeeh suni ke Sabahat-us-samawat-ul-ula min dhil-mahabati mushfiqat-uz-dhawil-ulu bima ala Subhan-al-Ali Subhanahu wa Ta'ala. Makhlooq mein se har ek cheez us ki pakeezagi aur taarif bayan kar rahi hai. Lekin ae logon tum un ki tasbeeh ko nahi samajhte is liye ke woh tumhari zuban mein nahi. Haiwanat, nabatat, jamadat sab us ke tasbeeh khwan hain. Ibn Masood ؓ se Sahih Bukhari mein sabit hai ke khana khate mein khane ki tasbeeh hum sunte rehte the. Abu Zar wali hadith mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apni muthi mein chand kankariyan leen, main ne khud suna ke woh shehad ki makkhiyon ki bhanbhanahat ki tarah tasbeeh-e-bari kar rahi thi. Isi tarah Hazrat Abu Bakar ؓ ke hath mein aur Hazrat Umar ؓ aur Hazrat Usman ؓ ke hath mein bhi. Yeh hadith sahih mein aur musandon mein mashhoor hai. Kuch logon ko Huzoor ﷺ ne apni oontniyon aur janwaro par saw

Aap ko gussa aagaya aur us ka daman ghasit-te huwe farmaya ke tujhe main janwaro ka libas pehne huwe toh nahi dekhta? Phir Huzoor ﷺ wapas chale diye aur baith kar farmane lage ke Hazrat Nuh Alaihis Salam ne apni wafat ke waqt apne bachon ko bula kar farmaya ke main tumhe ba-taur wasiyat ke do hukum deta hoon aur do mumana'at, ek toh main tumhe Allah ke sath kisi ko sharik karne se mana karta hoon, doosre takabbur se rokta hoon aur pehle hukum toh tumhe yeh karta hoon ke La Ilaha Illallah kehte raho is liye ke agar aasman aur zameen aur un ki tamam cheezein tarazu ke palre mein rakh di jayen aur doosre mein sirf yehi kalma ho toh bhi yehi kalma wazni rahega, so agar tamam aasman-o-zameen ek halka bana diye jayen aur un par is ko rakh diya jaye toh woh unhein pash pash kar de, doosra hukum mera Subhanallahi wa Bihamdihi parhne ka hai ke yeh har cheez ki namaz hai aur isi ki wajah se har ek ko rizq diya jata hai. Ibn Jareer mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya aao main tumhe batlaon ke Hazrat Nuh Alaihis Salam ne apne larke ko kya hukum diya, farmaya ke pyare bacche main tumhe hukum deta hoon ke Subhanallah kaha karo, yeh kul makhlooq ki tasbeeh hai aur isi se makhlooq ko rozi di jati hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai har cheez is ki tasbeeh-o-hamd bayan karti hai, is ki isnad bu-wajh-e-audi rawi ke zaeef hai. Ikrimah R.H farmate hain satoon, darakht, darwazon ki chulein, un ki khulne aur band hone ki aawaz, pani ki khad-khadahat yeh sab tasbeeh-e-Ilahi hai. Allah farmata hai ke har cheez hamd-o-sana ke bayan mein mashghool hai. Ibrahim kehte hain taam bhi tasbeeh-khwani karta hai, Surah Hajj ki ayat bhi is ki shahadat deti hai. Aur mufassireen kehte hain ke har zi-rooh cheez tasbeeh-khwan hai, jaise haiywanat aur nabatat. Ek martaba Hazrat Hasan Rahimahullah ke paas khwan aaya toh Abu Yazeed Qashi ne kaha ke اے Abu Saeed kya yeh khwan bhi tasbeeh-go hai? Aap ne farmaya han tha. Matlab yeh hai ke jab tak tar lakri ki soorat mein tha tasbeeh-go tha jab kat kar sookh gaya tasbeeh jati rahi. Is qaul ki taeed mein is hadis se bhi madad li ja sakti hai ke Huzoor ﷺ do kabron ke paas se guzarte hain farmaye hain unhein azab kiya ja raha hai aur kisi bari cheez mein nahi, ek toh peshab ke waqt parde ka khayal nahi karta tha aur doosra chughal-khor tha, phir Aap ne ek tar tehni le ke is ke do tukde kar ke dono kabron par gaad diye aur farmaya ke shayad jab tak yeh khushk na hon, un ke azab mein takhfeef rahe (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Is se ba'z ulama ne kaha hai ke jab tak yeh tar rahengi tasbeeh parhti rahengi jab khushk hojayengi tasbeeh band hojayegi wallahu a'lam. Allah Ta'ala Haleem-o-Ghafoor hai apne gunahgaron ko saza karne mein jaldi nahi karta, takheer karta hai, dheel deta hai, phir bhi agar kufr-o-fisq par ura rahe toh achanak azab musallat kar deta hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Allah Ta'ala mohlat deta hai, phir jab muakhiza karta hai toh nahi chorta.

Dekho Quran mein hai ke jab tera Rab kisi basti ke logon ko un ke mazalim par pakadta hai toh phir aisi hi pakad hoti hai al-kh. Aur aayat mein hai ke bahut si zalim bastiyon ko hum ne muhlat di phir aakhirash pakad liya. Aur aayat mein hai aayat: (Fa ka-ayyin min qaryatin ahlaknaha wa hiya zalimatun fahiya khawiyatun 'ala 'urushiha wa bi'rim mu'attalatin wa qasrim masheed) (Surah Al-Hajj: 45). Haan jo gunahon se ruk jaye, un se hat jaye, taubah kare toh Allah Ta'ala bhi us par rahm aur meharbani karta hai. Jaise aayat-e-Quran mein hai jo shakhs burai kare ya apni jaan par zulm kare? Phir istaghfar kare toh Allah ko bakhshne wala aur meharban payega. Surah Fatir ke aakhir ki aayaton mein yehi bayan hai.

Kuffar ka ek nafsiyati tajziya farmata hai ke Quran ki tilawat ke waqt un ke dilon par parde par jaate hain, koi asar un ke dilon tak nahi pahunchta. Woh hijaab unhe chhupa leta hai. Yahan mastoor saatir ke maane mein hai jaise maimoon aur mash-oom maane mein ya man aur shaaim ke hain. Woh parde go bazahir nazar na aayein lekin hidayat mein aur un mein woh had-e-faasil ho jaate hain. 

Musnad Abu Yala Mosuli mein hai ke Surah Tabbat Yada ke utarne par aurat Umm Jameel shor machaati dhaari daar patthar haath mein liye yeh kehti hui aayi ke is Muzammam ko hum maane wale nahi hume iska deen naپسند hai, hum iske farmaan ke mukhalif hain. Us waqt Rasool-ul-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) baithe hue the, Hazrat Abu Bakr (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) Aap ke paas the, kehne lage, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh aa rahi hai aur Aap ko dekh legi. Aap ne farmaya be-fikr raho yeh mujhe nahi dekh sakti aur Aap ne is se bachne ke liye tilawat-e-Quran shuru kardi. Yahi ayat tilawat farmayi woh aayi aur Hazrat Siddique Akbar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se poochne lagi ke maine suna hai tumhare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne meri hajow ki hai, Aap ne farmaya, nahi, Rab-e-Kaaba ki qasam teri hajow Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne nahi ki, woh yeh kehti hui lauti ke tamam Qurash jaante hain ke main un ke sardar ki ladki hoon. 

Akinnah kinaanah ki jama hai is parde ne un ke dilon ko dhak rakha hai jis se yeh Quran samajh nahi sakte un ke kaanon mein bojh hai, jis se woh Quran is tarah sun nahi sakte ke unhe faayda pahuche aur jab tu Quran mein Allah ki wahdaniyat ka zikar padhta hai toh yeh be-tarah bhaag khade hote hain. Nafoor jama hai naafir ki jaise qaid ki jama uqood aati hai aur ho sakta hai ke yeh masdar baghair fel ho wallahu alam. Jaise aur ayat mein hai ke Allah wahid ke zikar se be-eemaanon ke dil uchaat ho jaate hain. 

Musalamanon ka La ilaha illallah ka mushrikon par bahut giraan guzarta tha Iblees aur uska lashkar is se bahut chidta tha. Iske dabane ki poori koshish karta tha lekin Allah ka irada un ke barkhilaf ise buland karne aur izzat dene aur phailane ka tha. Yahi woh kalma hai ke iska qaail falah paata hai iska aamil madad diya jata hai dekh lo is jazeere ke halaat tumhare samne hain ke yahan se wahan tak yeh paak kalma phail gaya. 

Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is se murad shaitano ka bhaagna hai go baat yeh theek hai. Allah ke zikar se, azaan se, tilawat-e-Quran se, shaitan bhaagta hai lekin is ayat ki tafseer karna gharabat se khaali nahi.

Sardaran-e-Kufr ka Almiya: Sardaran-e-Kufr jo aapas mein baatein banate thay woh Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ko pohanchai ja rahi hain ke aap toh tilawat mein mashghool hote hain yeh chupke chupke kaha karte hain ke is par kisi ne jadoo kardiya hai aur ho sakta hai ke yeh matlab ho ke yeh toh ek insaan hai jo khane peene ka mohtaj hai. Go yeh lafz isi maani mein sher mein bhi hai aur Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ne isi ko theek bhi batlaya hai lekin yeh ghaur talab hai. Unka irada is moqa par is kehne se yeh tha ke khud yeh jadoo mein mubtala hai koi hai jo ise is moqa par kuch padha jata hai. Kafir log tarah tarah ke wahm aap ki nisbat zahir karte thay koi kehta aap shair hain, koi kehta kahin hain, koi majnoon batlata, koi jadugar waghera. Is liye farmata hai ke dekho yeh kaise behak rahe hain ke haq ki jaanib aa hi nahi sakte. 

Seerat-e-Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke Abu Sufyan bin Harb, Abu Jahl bin Hisham, Akhnas bin Shariq raat ke waqt apne apne gharon se Kalamullah Sharif Huzoor ﷺ ki zubani sunne ke liye nikle, aap apne ghar mein raat ko namaz padh rahe thay. Yeh log aa kar chup chaap chup kar idhar udhar baith gaye, ek ko doosre ki khabar na thi, raat ko sunte rahe fajr hote waqt yahan se chale, ittefaqan raste mein sab ki aapas mein mulaqat ho gayi, ek doosre ko malamat karne lage aur kehne lage ab se yeh harkat na karna warna aur log to bilkul isi ke ho jayenge. 

Lekin raat ko phir yeh teeno aa gaye aur apni apni jagah baith kar Quran sunne mein raat guzaari. Subah wapas chale raste mein mil gaye, phir se kal ki baatein dohraayi aur aaj pukhta irada kiya ke ab se aisa kaam hargiz koi na karega. Teesri raat phir yehi hua ab ke unhon ne kaha aao ahd karlein ke ab nahi aayenge, chunacha qaul o qarar kar ke juda huwe. Subah ko Akhnas apni laathi sanbhaale Abu Sufyan ke ghar pohancha aur kehne laga Abu Hanzala mujhe batao tumhari apni raye Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ki baabat kya hai? Usne kaha Abu Thalba jo aaytein Quran ki main ne suni hain, un mein se bahut si aayton ka toh matlab main jaan gaya, lekin bahut si aayton ki murad mujhe maloom nahi hui. Akhnas ne kaha Wallah mera bhi yehi haal hai. 

Yahan se ho kar Akhnas Abu Jahl ke paas pohancha. Usse bhi yehi sawal kiya, usne kaha suniye; sharafat o sardari ke bare mein hamara Banu Abd-e-Manaf se muddat ka jhagda chala aata hai, unhon ne khilaya toh hum ne bhi khilana shuru kardiya, unhon ne sawariyan dein toh hum ne bhi unhe sawariyon ke janwar diye. Unhon ne logon ke sath salook kiye aur un inaamat mein hum ne bhi unse peeche rehna pasand na kiya. Ab jab ke tamam baton mein woh aur hum barabar rahe, is daud mein jab woh baazi le ja na sake toh jhat se unhon ne keh diya ke hum mein nabuwat hai, hum mein ek shakhs hai, jis ke paas aasmani wahi aati hai, ab batao isko hum kaise maan lein? Wallah na is par hum iman layenge na kabhi ise sacha kahenge. Usi waqt Akhnas use chhod kar chal diya.

Sab dobara paida honge. Kafir jo qayamat ke qayil na the aur marne ke baad ke jeene ko mahal jaante the, woh batour-e-inkar pucha karte the ke kya hum jab haddi aur mitti ho jayenge, ghubar ban jayenge, kuch na rahenge, bilkul mit jayenge, phir bhi nayi pedaish se paida honge? 

Surah An-Naziat mein in munkaron ka qaul bayan hua hai ke kya hum marne ke baad ulte paon zindagi mein lautaye jayenge? Aur woh bhi aisi halat mein ke hamari haddiyan bhi gul sar gayi hon? Bhai yeh toh bare hi khasare ki baat hai. 

Surah Yasin mein hai ke yeh hamare samne misalein bayan karne baith gaya aur apni pedaish ko faramosh kar gaya. Al-khis. 

Pas unhein jawab diya jata hai ke haddiyan toh kya, tum khwah patthar ban jao, khwah loha ban jao, khwah isse bhi zyada sakht cheez ban jao, masalan pahar ya zameen ya aasman, balke tum khud maut hi kyun na ban jao, Allah par tumhara jalana mushkil nahi, jo chaho ho jao, dobara uthoge zaroor. 

Hadith mein hai ke bheriye ki surat mein maut ko qayamat ke din jannat dozakh ke darmiyan laya jata hai aur dono se kaha jayega ke ise pehchante ho? Sab kahenge haan, phir ise wahin zabah kar diya jayega aur munadi ho jayegi ke aye jantiyo ab dawam hai, maut nahi aur aye jahanniyo ab hamesha qiyam hai, maut nahi. 

Yahan farman hai ke yeh puchte hain ke achha jab hum haddiyan aur chora ho jayenge ya patthar aur loha ho jayenge ya jo hum chahein aur jo bari se bari sakht cheez ho, woh hum ho jayenge, toh yeh toh batlao ke kis ke ikhtiyar mein hai ke ab humein phir se is zindagi ki taraf lota de? 

In ke is sawal aur be-ja aitraz ke jawab mein Allah Ta'ala ne unhein samjhaya ke tumhein lotane wala tumhara sacha خالق (Khaliq) Allah Ta'ala hai. Jis ne tumhein pehli baar paida kiya hai jab ke tum kuch na the. Phir is par dusri baar ki pedaish kya giran hai? Balke bahut asan hai, tum khwah kuch bhi ban jao. 

Yeh jawab chunke la-jawab hai, hairan toh ho jayenge lekin phir bhi apni shararat se baaz na aayenge, bad-aqeedagi na chorenge aur batour-e-mazaq sar hilate hue kahenge ke achha yeh hoga kab? Sache ho toh waqt ka taayun kar do. 

Be-imanon ka yeh shewa hai ke woh jaldi machate rehte hain. Haan, hai toh woh waqt kareeb hi, tum is ke liye intezar kar lo, ghaflat na barto. Is ke aane mein koi shak nahi. Aane wali cheez ko aayi hui samjha karo. 

Allah ki ek aawaz ke sath hi tum zameen se nikal khare hoge, ek aankh jhapakane ki dair bhi toh na lagegi. Allah ke farman ke sath hi tumhara maidan-e-mahshar par ho jayega. Qabron se uthkar Allah ki tareefein karte hue is ke ahkam ki baja-aavari mein khare ho jayenge. 

Hamd ke layak wahi hai, tum is ke hukm se aur irade se bahar nahi ho. Hadith mein hai ke La ilaha illallah kehne walon par un ki qabron mein koi wehshat nahi hogi. Goya ke main unhein dekh raha hoon ke woh qabron se uth rahe hain, apne sar se mitti jhaarte hue La ilaha illallah kehte hue uth khare honge. Kahenge ke Allah ki hamd hai jis ne hum se gham dur kar diya.

Surah Fatir ki tafsir mein yeh bayan aa raha hai insha'Allah. Us waqt tumhara yaqeen hoga ki tum bahut hi kam muddat duniya mein rahe goya subh ya sham koi kahega das din koi kahega ek din koi samjhega ek saat hi. Sawaal par yahi kahenge ki ek din ya din ka kuch hissa hi. Aur is par qasmeien khayeinge. Isi tarah duniya mein bhi apne jhoot par qasmeien khate rahe the.

Surah An-Naziat mein in munkaron ka qaul bayan hua hai ke kya hum marne ke baad ulte paon zindagi mein lautaye jayenge? Aur woh bhi aisi halat mein ke hamari haddiyan bhi gul sar gayi hon? Bhai yeh toh bare hi khasare ki baat hai. 

Surah Yasin mein hai ke yeh hamare samne misalein bayan karne baith gaya aur apni pedaish ko faramosh kar gaya. Al-khis. 

Pas unhein jawab diya jata hai ke haddiyan toh kya, tum khwah patthar ban jao, khwah loha ban jao, khwah isse bhi zyada sakht cheez ban jao, masalan pahar ya zameen ya aasman, balke tum khud maut hi kyun na ban jao, Allah par tumhara jalana mushkil nahi, jo chaho ho jao, dobara uthoge zaroor. 

Hadith mein hai ke bheriye ki surat mein maut ko qayamat ke din jannat dozakh ke darmiyan laya jata hai aur dono se kaha jayega ke ise pehchante ho? Sab kahenge haan, phir ise wahin zabah kar diya jayega aur munadi ho jayegi ke aye jantiyo ab dawam hai, maut nahi aur aye jahanniyo ab hamesha qiyam hai, maut nahi. 

Yahan farman hai ke yeh puchte hain ke achha jab hum haddiyan aur chora ho jayenge ya patthar aur loha ho jayenge ya jo hum chahein aur jo bari se bari sakht cheez ho, woh hum ho jayenge, toh yeh toh batlao ke kis ke ikhtiyar mein hai ke ab humein phir se is zindagi ki taraf lota de? 

In ke is sawal aur be-ja aitraz ke jawab mein Allah Ta'ala ne unhein samjhaya ke tumhein lotane wala tumhara sacha خالق (Khaliq) Allah Ta'ala hai. Jis ne tumhein pehli baar paida kiya hai jab ke tum kuch na the. Phir is par dusri baar ki pedaish kya giran hai? Balke bahut asan hai, tum khwah kuch bhi ban jao. 

Yeh jawab chunke la-jawab hai, hairan toh ho jayenge lekin phir bhi apni shararat se baaz na aayenge, bad-aqeedagi na chorenge aur batour-e-mazaq sar hilate hue kahenge ke achha yeh hoga kab? Sache ho toh waqt ka taayun kar do. 

Be-imanon ka yeh shewa hai ke woh jaldi machate rehte hain. Haan, hai toh woh waqt kareeb hi, tum is ke liye intezar kar lo, ghaflat na barto. Is ke aane mein koi shak nahi. Aane wali cheez ko aayi hui samjha karo. 

Allah ki ek aawaz ke sath hi tum zameen se nikal khare hoge, ek aankh jhapakane ki dair bhi toh na lagegi. Allah ke farman ke sath hi tumhara maidan-e-mahshar par ho jayega. Qabron se uthkar Allah ki tareefein karte hue is ke ahkam ki baja-aavari mein khare ho jayenge. 

Hamd ke layak wahi hai, tum is ke hukm se aur irade se bahar nahi ho. Hadith mein hai ke La ilaha illallah kehne walon par un ki qabron mein koi wehshat nahi hogi. Goya ke main unhein dekh raha hoon ke woh qabron se uth rahe hain, apne sar se mitti jhaarte hue La ilaha illallah kehte hue uth khare honge. Kahenge ke Allah ki hamd hai jis ne hum se gham dur kar diya.

Surah Fatir ki tafsir mein yeh bayan aa raha hai insha'Allah. Us waqt tumhara yaqeen hoga ki tum bahut hi kam muddat duniya mein rahe goya subh ya sham koi kahega das din koi kahega ek din koi samjhega ek saat hi. Musalaman-e-ek dusre ka ehtram karo Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ﷺ se farmata hai ke aap momin bando se farma dein ke woh acche alfaaz, behtar faqro aur tehzeeb se kalam karte rahein, warna shaitan unke aapas mein sar phatool aur burai dalwa dega, lrai jhagre shuru hojayenge. Woh insan ka dushman hai ghaat mein laga rehta hai, isi liye hadith mein musalman bhai ki taraf kisi hathiyar se ishara karna bhi haram hai ke kahin shaitan use laga na de aur ye jahannami na ban jaye. Mulahiza ho Musnad Ahmad. Huzoor ﷺ ne logo ke ek majma mein farmaya ke sab musalman aapas mein bhai bhai hain koi kisi par zulm-o-sitam na kare koi kisi ko be-izzat na kare phir aap ne apne seene ki taraf ishara kar ke farmaya taqwa yahan hai jo do shakhs aapas mein deeni dost hon phir un mein judai hojaye use un mein se jo bayan kare woh bayan karne wala bura hai woh badtar hai woh nihayat shareer hai (Musnad).

Afzal-ul-Anbiya (Alaihis Salatu Wassalam) tumhara Rabb tumse bakhubi waqif hai, woh hidayat ke mustahiq logon ko bakhubi jaanta hai. Woh jis par chahta hai raham karta hai, apni ita'at ki taufeeq deta hai aur apni jaanib jhuka leta hai. Isi tarah jise chahe bad-a'mali par pakad leta hai aur saza deta hai. Humne tujhe unka zimmedaar nahi banaya, tera kaam hoshiyar kar dena hai, tere manne waale jannati honge aur na manne waale dozakhi banenge. Zameen-o-Aasman ke tamaam insan, jinnat, farishton ka use ilm hai, har ek ke maratib ka use ilm hai, ek ko ek par fazilat hai, nabiyon mein bhi darje hain, koi Kalimullah hai, koi buland darja hai. Ek hadith mein hai ke nabiyon mein fazilatein qaim na kiya karo, isse matlab sirf ta'assub aur nafs-parasti se apne taur par fazilat qaim karna hai na yeh ke Quran-o-Hadith se sabit-shuda fazilat se bhi inkar. Jo fazilat jis nabi ki az roo-e-daleel sabit ho jayegi uska manna wajib hai. Maani hui baat hai ke tamaam ambiya se rusul afzal hain aur rusulon mein paanch Ulul-Azm rusul sabse afzal hain jinka naam Surah Ahzab ki ayat mein hai yaani Muhammad, Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa salawatullahi alaihim ajma'in. Surah Shura ki ayat (Shara‘ lakum minad-dini ma wassa bihi Nuhan wallazi auhainaka wa ma wassaina bihi Ibrahima wa Musa wa ‘Isa an aqimud-dina wa la tatafarraqu fihi kabura ‘alal-mushrikina ma tad‘uhum ilaihi Allahu yajtabi ilaihi mai yashau wa yahdi ilaihi mai yunib [42. Ash-Shura: 13]) mein bhi in paanchon ke naam maujood hain. Jis tarah yeh sab cheezein saari ummat maanti hai, usi tarah baghair ikhtilaaf ke yeh bhi sabit hai ke inmein bhi sabse afzal Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ hain. Phir Hazrat Ibrahim A.S phir Hazrat Musa A.S jaisa ke mashhoor hai, humne iske dalaail dusri jagah tafseel se bayan kiye hain wallahul-muwaffaq. Phir farmata hai humne Dawud paigambar A.S ko Zabur di. Yeh bhi unki fazilat aur sharaf ki daleel hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain Hazrat Dawud A.S par Quran itna asaan kar diya gaya tha ke janwar par zeen kasi jaye itni si der mein aap Quran padh liya karte the.

Waseela ya qurb-e-Ilahi Allah ke siwa auron ki ibadat karne walon se kahiye ke tum unhein khoob pukar kar dekh lo ke aya woh tumhare kuch kaam asakte hain? Na unke bas ki yeh baat hai ke mushkil-kushai kardein na yeh baat ke use kisi aur par taal dein woh mahz be-bas hain, qadir aur taqat wala sirf Allah wahid hi hai. Makhlooq ka khaliq aur sab ka hukmaran wahi hai. Yeh mushrik kaha karte the ke hum farishton, Maseeh aur Uzair ki ibadat karte hain. Unke mabood to khud Allah ki nazdiki ki justaju mein hain. Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke jin jinon ki yeh mushrikeen parastish karte the woh khud musalman ho gaye the lekin yeh ab tak apne kufr par jame hue hain, is liye unhein khabardar kiya gaya ke tumhare mabood khud Allah ki taraf jhuk gaye. Ibn Masood R.A kehte hain yeh jin farishton ki ek qism se the. Hazrat Isa A.S, Hazrat Maryam A.S, Hazrat Uzair A.S, sooraj chand, farishte sab qurb-e-Ilahi ki talash mein hain. Ibn Jareer farmate hain theek matlab yeh hai ke jin jinon ko yeh poojte the ayat mein wahi murad hain kyunke Hazrat Maseeh A.S waghera ka zamana to guzar chuka tha aur farishte pehle hi se abid-e-Ilahi the to murad yahan bhi jinat hain. Waseela ke maani qurbat-o-nazdiki ke hain jaise ke Hazrat Qatadah R.H ka qaul hai. Yeh sab buzurg usi dhun mein hain ke kaun Allah se zyada nazdiki hasil karle? Woh Allah ki rehmat ke khwahan aur us ke azab se tarsan hain. Haqeeqat mein baghair in dono baaton ke ibadat na-mukammal hai. Khouf gunahon se rokta hai aur umeed ita'at par amada karti hai darhaqeeqat us ke azab darne ke laiq hain. Allah humein bachaye.

Woh nuskha jo Lauh-e-Mahfuz mein likh diya gaya hai woh hukm jo jari kar diya gaya hai us ka bayaan is aayat mein hai ke gunehgaron ki bastiyan yaqeenan veeran kar di jayengi ya un ke gunahon ki wajah se tabahi ke qareeb ho jayengi, is mein hamari janib se koi zulm na hoga balke un ke apne kartoot ka khamiyaza hoga, Rab ki aayton aur us ke rasoolon se sarkashi karne ka phal hoga.

Ajab-o-Gharib Maang
Huzoor ﷺ ke zamane ke kafiron ne aap se kaha ke Hazrat aap ke pehle ke anbiya mein se baaz ke taabi hawa thi, baaz murdon ko zinda kardiya karte the, waghera. Ab agar aap chahte hain ke hum bhi aap par iman layein toh aap is Safa pahaad ko sone ka kardein, hum aap ke sachai ke qayil hojayenge. Aap par wahi aayi ke agar aap ki bhi yahi khwahish ho toh main is pahaad ko abhi sone ka bana deta hoon. Lekin yeh khayal rahe ke agar phir bhi yeh iman na laye toh ab inhein mohlat na milegi, fi-l-for azab aajayega aur tabaah karde jayenge. Aur agar aap ko inhein taakhir dene aur sochne ka moqa dena منظور hai toh main aisa karoon. Aap ne farmaya Ae Allah main inhein baaqi rakhne mein hi khush hoon. Musnad mein itna aur bhi hai ke inhone yeh bhi kaha tha ke baaqi ki aur pahadiyan yahan se khask jayein taake hum yahan kheti-baari karsakein. Al-kh aisi par yeh ayat nazil hui. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aap ne dua mangi, Jibrail Alaihis Salam aaye aur kaha aap ka parvardigar aap ko salam kehta hai aur farmata hai ke agar aap chahein toh subah ko hi yeh pahaad sone ka hojaye lekin agar phir bhi in mein se koi iman na laya toh use woh saza hogi jo is se pehle kisi ko na hui ho aur agar aap ka irada ho toh main in par tauba aur rahmat ke darwaze khule chhodoon. Aap ne doosri shaq ikhtiyar ki. 

Musnad Abu Yala mein hai ke ayat (Wa anzir asheeratakal-aqrabeen - 26. Ash-Shu'ara: 214) jab utri toh tameel-e-irshad ke liye Jabal-e-Abi Qabis par chadh gaye aur farmane lage Ae Bani Abd Manaf main tumhe daranewala hoon. Quresh yeh aawaz sunte hi jamah hogaye phir kehne lage sunein aap nubuwwat ke mudda'i hain. Sulaiman Nabi Alaihis Salam ke taabi hawa thi, Musa Nabi Alaihis Salam ke taabi darya hogaya tha, Isa Nabi Alaihis Salam murdon ko zinda kiya karte the. Tu bhi Nabi hai Allah se keh ke yeh pahaad yahan se hatwa kar zameen qabil-e-zira'at bana de taake hum kheti-baari karein. Yeh nahi toh hamare murdon ki zindagi ki dua Allah se kar ke hum aur woh mil kar baithein aur un se baatein karein. Yeh bhi nahi toh is pahaad ko sone ka banwa de ke hum jaade aur garmiyon ke safar se nijaat paayein usi waqt aap par wahi utrni shuru hogayi is ke khatme par aap ne farmaya is ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke tum ne jo kuch mujh se talab kiya tha mujhe is ke hojane mein aur is baat mein ke darwaza-e-rahmat mein chale jao, ikhtiyar diya gaya ke iman-o-Islam ke baad tum rahmat-e-Ilahi samet lo ya tum yeh nishanaat dekh lo lekin phir na mano toh gumrah hojayo aur rahmat ke darwaze tum par band hojayein toh main toh dar gaya aur main ne dar-e-rahmat ka khula hona hi pasand kiya. Kyunke doosri soorat mein tumhare iman na lane par tum par woh azab utrte jo tum se pehle kisi par na utre the is par yeh ayatein utrin. Aur ayat (Wa lau anna quranan suyyirat bihil-jibalu au quttiat bihil-ardu au kullima bihil-mawta - 13. Ar-Ra'd: 31).

Al-Ra'd: 31), nazil hui yani aayton ke bhejne aur munh maange mojizon ke dikhane se hum aajiz to nahi balki yeh hum par bahut aasan hai jo teri kaum chahti hai, hum unhein dikha dete lekin is soorat mein un ke na manne par phir hamare azab na rukte. Aglon ko dekh lo ki usi mein barbad hue. Chunacha Surah Maidah mein hai ki main tum par dastarkhwan utar raha hoon lekin is ke baad jo kufr karega use aisi saza di jayegi jo is se pehle kisi ko na hui ho. Samudiyon ko dekho ki unhon ne ek khaas patthar mein se oontni ka nikalna talab kiya. Hazrat Salih A.S ki dua par woh nikli lekin woh na mane balki us oontni ki kochen kaat din, Rasool ko jhutlate rahe, jis par unhein teen din ki mohlat mili aur aakhir gharat kar diye gaye. Un ki yeh oontni bhi Allah ki wahdaniyat ki ek nishani thi aur is ke Rasool ki sadaqat ki alamat thi. Lekin un logon ne phir bhi kufr kiya, is ka pani band kiya bilakhir use qatl kar diya, jis ki padash mein sab maar dale gaye aur Allah zabardast ki pakar mein aa gaye, aayten sirf dhamkane ke liye hoti hain ki woh ibrat aur naseehat hasil kar lein. Marwi hai ki Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A ke zamane mein Kufe mein zalzala aaya to aap ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala chahta hai ki tum is ki janib jhuko, tumhein foran is ki taraf mutawajjo ho jana chahiye. Hazrat Umar R.A ke zamane mein Madina Shareef mein kai baar jhatke mehsoos hue to aap ne farmaya Wallah tum ne zaroor koi nayi baat ki hai, dekho agar ab aisa hua to main tumhein sakht sazayein doonga. Muttafaq Alaih hadees mein hai ki aap ne farmaya sooraj chaand Allah ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain un mein kisi ki maut-o-hayat se grahan nahi lagta balki Allah Ta'ala un se apne bandon ko khaufzada kar deta hai, jab tum yeh dekho to zikrullah, dua aur istighfar ki taraf jhuk pardo. Aye Ummat-e-Muhammad Wallah Allah se zyada gairat wala koi nahi ki is ke londi ghulam zana kari karein. Aye Ummat-e-Muhammad Wallah jo main janta hoon, agar tum jante to bahut kam hanste zyada rote.

Maqsad-e-Mi'raj Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala apne Rasul (A.S) ko tabligh-e-din ki raghibat dila raha hai aur aap ke bacha'o ki zimmedari le raha hai ki sab log usi ki qudrat tale hain, woh sab par ghalib hai, sab us ke matahat hain, woh un sab se tujhe bachata rahega. Jo hum ne tujhe dikhaya woh logon ke liye ek sarih aazmaish hai. Yeh dikhana mi'raj wali raat tha, jo aap ki aankhon ne dekha. Nafrati darakht se murad Zaqqum ka darakht hai. Bahut se tabieen aur Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ki yeh dikhana aankh ka dikhana, mushahida tha jo shab-e-mi'raj mein karaya gaya tha. Mi'raj ki hadeesain bahut poori tafseel ke sath is surat ke shuru mein bayan ho chuki hain. Yeh bhi guzar chuka hai ki mi'raj ke waqie ko sun ke bahut se musalman murtad ho gaye aur haq se phir gaye kyunki un ki aql mein yeh na aaya toh apni jahalat se ise jhootha jaana aur din ko chhor kar baithe. Un ke barkhilaf kamil iman wale apne yaqeen mein aur barh gaye aur un ke iman aur mazboot ho gaye. Sabit-qadami aur istiqlal mein zyada ho gaye. Pas is waqie ko logon ke aazmaish aur un ke imtihan ka zariya Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala ne kar diya. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne jab khabar di aur Quran mein aayat utri ki dozakhiyon ko Zaqqum ka darakht khilaya jayega aur aap ne ise dekha bhi toh kafiron ne ise sach na mana aur Abu Jhal maloon mazaq urate hue kehne laga lao khajoor aur makhan lao aur is ka Zaqqum karo yani dono ko mila do aur khub shok se khao bas yahi Zaqqum hai, phir is khurak se ghabrane ke kya ma'ani? Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ki is se murad Bani Umayyah hain lekin yeh qaul bilkul zaeef aur ghareeb hain. Pehle qaul ke qail woh tamam mufassir hain jo is aayat ko mi'raj ke bare mein mante hain. Jaise Ibn Abbas, Masruq, Abu Malik, Hasan Basri waghera. Sahl bin Saeed kehte hain Huzoor (ﷺ) ne falan qabile walon ko apne mimbar par bandaron ki tarah nachta hua dekha aur aap ko is se bahut ranj hua phir inteqal tak aap poori hansi se hanste hue nahi dikhai diye usi ki taraf is aayat mein ishara hai. (Ibn Jarir) Lekin yeh sanad bilkul zaeef hai. Muhammad bin Hasan bin Zubala matrook hai aur un ke ustad bhi bilkul zaeef hain. Khud Imam Ibn Jarir (Rahimahullah) ka pasandeeda qaul bhi yahi hai ki murad is se shab-e-mi'raj hai aur Shajarat-uz-Zaqqum hai kyunki mufassireen ka is par ittefaq hai. Hum kafiron ko apne azabon waghera se dara rahe hain lekin woh apni zid, takabbur, hat-dharmi aur be-imani mein aur barh rahe hain.

Iblis ki qadimi dushmani

Iblis ki qadimi adawat se insan ko agah kiya ja raha hai ke woh baap Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) ka khula dushman tha, uski aulad barabar usi tarah tumhari dushman hai, sajde ka hukam sun kar sab farishton ne to sir jhaka diya lekin usne takabbur jataya, use haqir samjha aur saf inkar kar diya ke namumkin hai ke mera sir kisi mitti se bane hue ke samne jhuke, main isse kahin afzal hoon, main aag hoon yeh khak hai. Phir uski dhitai dekhiye ke Allah Jalla wa Ala ke darbar mein gustakhana lehje se kehta hai ke acha use agar Tu ne mujh par fazilat di to kya hua main bhi iski aulad ko barbad kar ke hi chhodunga, sab ko apna tabedar bana loon ga aur behka doon ga, bas thode se mere phande se chhoot jayenge baqi sab ko gharat kar doon ga.

Shaitani awaz ka behkawa: Iblis ne Allah se mohlat chahi, Allah Ta'ala ne manzoor farma li aur irshad hua ke waqt-e-maloom tak mohlat hai, teri aur tere tabeadaron ki buraiyon ke badle Jahannam hai, jo poori saza hai. Apni awaz se behka sake behka le yani gaane aur tamashon se unhe behkata phire. Jo bhi Allah ki nafarmani ki taraf bulane wali sada ho woh shaitani awaz hai. Isi tarah tu apne piyade aur sawar lag kar jis par tujh se hamla ho sake, hamla kar le. Rajil jam hai rajil ki jaise rakb jam raqib ki aur sahb jam hai sahib ki. Matlab yeh hai ke jis qadar tujh se ho sake un par apna tasallut aur iqtidar jama. Yeh amr-e-qadri hai na ke hukum. Shaitano ki yahi khislat hai ke woh bandgan-e-Rabb ko bhadkate aur behkate rehte hain. Unhe gunahon par amada karte rehte hain. Allah ki masiyat mein jo sawari par ho aur paidal ho, woh shaitani lashkar mein hai, aise jinn bhi hain aur insan bhi hain, jo uske moti hain. Jab kisi par awazein uthai jayen toh arab kehte hain ajlab falan ala falan. Aap ka yeh farman ke ghor dor mein jlab nahi, woh bhi isi se maakhuz hai. Jabla ka ishtiqaq bhi isi se hai yani awazon ka buland hona. Unke maal aur aulad mein bhi tu sharik reh. Yani Allah ki nafarmaniyon mein unka maal kharch kara, sood khwari un se kara. Burai se maal jama karein aur haram kariyon mein kharch karein. Halal janwaron ko apni khwahish se haram qarar dein waghaira. Aulad mein شرکت yeh hai maslan zina kari jis se aulad ho. Jo aulad bachpan mein wajah-e-bewqoofi un ke maan baap ne zinda dargor kar di ho ya maar dali ho ya use yahudi nasrani majoosi waghaira bana diya ho. Auladon ke naam Abdul Harith, Abdul Shams aur falan rakha ho. Gharz kisi soorat mein bhi shaitan ko is mein dakhil kiya ho, ya us ko sath kiya ho, yahi shaitan ki شرکت hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke Allah Azz-o-Jal farmata hai main ne apne bandon ko aik taraf muwahid paida kiya phir shaitan ne aa kar unhe behka diya aur halal cheezein haram kar dien. Bukhari o Muslim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain ke tum mein se jo apni biwi ke paas jane ka irada kare yeh parh le dua (Allahumma jannibnash-shaitana wa jannibish-shaitana ma razaqtana) yani ya Allah tu humein shaitan se bacha aur ise bhi jo tu humein ata farmaye. Tu agar is mein koi bacha Allah ki taraf se thehar jayega toh use hargiz hargiz kabhi bhi shaitan koi zarar nahi pohncha sakega. Phir farmata hai ke ja tu unhe dhoke ke jhoote wade diya kar, chanacha qayamat ke din yeh khud kahega ke Allah ke wade toh sab sache thay aur mere wade sab ghalat thay. Phir farmata hai ke mere momin bande meri hifazat mein hain, main unhe shaitan rajeem se bachata rahunga. Allah ki wakalat us ki hifazat us ki nusrat us ki ta'eed bandon ko kafi hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain ke momin apne shaitan par is tarah qaboo pa leta hai jaise woh shakhs jo kisi janwar ko lagam charhaye hue ho.

Asaniyan hi asaniyan Allah Ta'ala apna ehsan banata hai ke usne apne bando ki asani aur sahulat ke liye aur unki tijarat o safar ke liye daryao mein kashtiyan chala di hain, uske fazl o karam lutf o raham ka ek nishaan yeh bhi hai ke tum door daraz mulko mein ja asakte ho aur khas fazl yaani apni roziyan hasil kar sakte ho.

Musibat khatm hote hi shirk Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ka irshad ho raha hai ke bande musibat ke waqt to khulus ke sath apne parwardigar ki taraf jhukte hain aur us se dili duaein karne lagte hain aur jahan woh musibat Allah Ta'ala ne taal di to yeh aankhen pher lete hain. Fath-e-Makkah ke waqt jab ke Abu Jahl ka larka Ikrimah Habshah jaane ke irade se bhaga aur kashti mein baith kar chala ittefaqan kashti tufan mein phans gayi, baad-e-mukhalif ke jhonke use patte ki tarah hilane lage, us waqt kashti mein jitne kuffar the, sab ek dusre se kehne lage is waqt siwaye Allah Ta'ala ke aur koi kuch kaam nahi aane ka. Usi ko pukaro. Ikrimah ke dil mein usi waqt khayal aaya ke jab tari mein sirf wahi kaam kar sakta hai to zahir hai ke khushki mein bhi wahi kaam kar sakta hai. Ikrimah ke dil mein usi waqt khayal aaya ke jab tari mein sirf wahi kaam kar sakta hai to zahir hai ke khushki mein bhi wahi kaam kar sakta hai. Ae Allah main nazr manta hu ke agar tune mujhe is aafat se bacha liya toh main seedha ja kar Muhammad ﷺ ke hath mein hath de dunga aur yaqinan woh mujh par meharbani aur rahm-o-karam farmayenge ﷺ chunache samundar se paar hote hi woh seedhe Rasool Kareem ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur Islam قبول kiya phir to Islam ke pehlwan sabit hue R.A wa arzahu. Pas farmata hai ke samundar ki is musibat ke waqt to Allah ke siwa sab ko bhool jate ho lekin jate ho lekin phir us ke hatte hi Allah ki tauhid hata dete ho aur dusro se iltijayein karne lagte ho. Insan hai hi aisa nashukra ke nemato ko bhula baithta hai balki munkir ho jata hai haan jise Allah bacha le aur taufiq-e-khair de.

Izhar-e-qudrat-o-ikhtiyar-e-Rab-ul-Alamin logon ko dara raha hai ke jo tari mein tumhein dubo sakta tha, woh khushki mein dhansane ki qudrat bhi rakhta hai phir wahan to sirf usi ko pukarna aur yahan uske sath auron ko sharik karna yeh kis qadr na-insafi hai? Woh to tum par patharon ki barish bhi barsa kar halak kar sakta hai jaise lotiyon par hue thay. Jiska bayan khud Quran mein kayi jagah hai. Surah Tabarak mein farmaya ke kya tumhein us Allah ka dar nahi jo asmanon mein hai ke kahin woh tumhein zamin mein na dhansa de ke yakayak zamin junbish karne lage. Kya tumhe asmanon wale Allah ka khauf nahi ke kahin woh tum par pathar na barsa de phir jaan lo ke darane ka anjam kya hota hai. Phir farmata hai ke us waqt tum na apna madadgar paoge, na dastgir, na wakil, na karsaz, na nigahban, na pasban.

Samandar ho ya sahra, har jagah اسی ka iqtidar hai. Irshad ho raha hai ke "Aye mankaro! Samandar mein tum meri tauheed ke qayil hue, baahar aa kar phir inkar kar gaye, toh kya yeh nahi ho sakta ke phir tum dobara daryayi safar karo aur baad-e-tund ke thapeede tumhari kashti ko dagmaga dein aur aakhir dobo dein aur tumhein tumhare kufr ka maza aa jaye, phir toh koi madadgar khada na ho, na koi aisa mil sake ke hum se tumhara badla le." Hamara peecha koi nahi kar sakta, kis ki majaal ke hamare fael par ungli uthaye.

Insan par Allah ke inaamat sab se achhi paidaish insan ki hai jaise farman hai ayat (Laqad khalaqnal insana fi ahsani taqwim) (95. At-Tin: 4) Hum ne insan ko behtareen saakht par paida kiya hai. Woh apne pairon par seedha khada ho kar sahi chaal chalta hai, apne haathon se tameez ke sath apni ghiza khata hai aur haivanat hath paon se chalte hain munh se chara chgte hain. Phir use samajh boojh di hai jis se nafa nuqsan bhalayi burayi sochta hai. Deini duniyavi faida maloom kar leta hai. Uski sawari ke liye khushki mein janwar chopaye ghore khachar oont vaghairah. Aur tari ke safar ke liye use kashtiyan banani sikha din. Use behtareen, khushgwar aur khush zaika khane pine ki cheezein dein. Khetiyan hain, phal hain, gosht hain, doodh hain aur behtareen bahut si zaike dar lazeez mazedar cheezein. Phir umda makanat rehne ko, achhe khushnuma libas pehnne ko, qism qism ke, rang barang ke, yahan ki cheezein yahan le jaane le aane ke asbab us ke liye muhaiya kar diye aur makhlooq mein se umuman har ek par use bartari bakshi. Is ayat karima se is amr par istidlal kiya gaya hai ke insan farishton se afzal hai. Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam kehte hain ke farishton ne kaha اے Allah tu ne aulad-e-Adam ko duniya de rakhi hai ke woh khate pite hain aur mauj maze kar rahe hain to tu is ke badle hamein akhirat mein hi ata farma kyunke hum is duniya se mehroom hain. Is ke jawab mein Allah Jalla Shanahu ne irshad farmaya ke mujhe apni izrat aur jalal ki qasam is ki naik aulad ko jise main ne apne hath se paida kiya is ke barabar mein hargiz na karunga jise main ne kalma 'Kun' se paida kiya hai. Yeh riwayat mursal hai. Lekin aur sanad se mutasil bhi marvi hai Ibn Asakir mein hai ke farishton ne kaha ae hamare parwardigar hamein bhi tu ne paida kiya aur Bani Israel ka khaliq bhi tu hi hai unhein tu khana peena de raha, kapre latte woh pehnte hain, nikah shadiyan woh karte hain, sawariyan un ke liye hain, rahat-o-aram unhein hasil hai, un mein se kisi cheez ke hisse dar hum nahi. Khair yeh agar duniya mein un ke liye hai to yeh cheezein akhirat mein to hamare liye kar de. Is ke jawab mein Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne farmaya jise main ne apne hath se paida kiya hai aur apni rooh jis mein main ne phoonki hai is mein is jaisa na karunga jise main ne keh diya ke hojao woh ho gaya. Tabarani mein hai qayamat ke din Ibn-e-Adam se ziyada buzurg Allah ke han koi na hoga. Poocha gaya ke farishte bhi nahi? Farmaya farishte bhi nahi woh to majboor hain jaise sooraj chand. Yeh riwayat bahut hi ghareeb hai.

Al-Kitab hi hidayat o imam hai, imam se murad yahan Nabi hain. Har ummat Qiyamat ke din apne Nabi ke sath bulai jayegi, jaise is ayat mein hai: (Wa likulli ummatin rasoolun fa iza ja'a rasooluhum qudiya bainahum bil-qisti wa hum la yuzlamoon) (10. Yunus: 47). Har ummat ka rasool hai, phir jab un ke rasool ayenge to un ke darmiyan adl ke sath hisab kiya jaye. Ba'z salaf ka qaul hai ki is mein Ahl-e-Hadith ki bahut badi buzurgi hai, is liye ki un ke imam An-Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ hain. Ibn Zaid kehte hain murad yahan imam se Kitabullah hai jo un ki shariat ke bare mein utri thi. Ibn Jarir is tafsir ko bahut pasand farmate hain aur isi ko mukhtar kehte hain. Mujahid (R.H) kehte hain murad is se un ki kitabein hain. Mumkin hai kitab se murad ya to ahkaam ki Kitabullah ho ya namah-e-a'mal. Chunanche Ibn Abbas (R.A) is se murad a'mal namah lete hain. Abu Al-Aliya, Hasan, Dahhak bhi yahi kehte hain aur yahi zyada tarjeeh wala qaul hai, jaise farman-e-Ilahi hai ayat: (Wa kulla shai'in ahsainahu fi imamin mubeen) (36. Ya-Sin: 12). Har cheez ka hum ne zahir kitab mein ihata kar liya hai. Aur ayat mein hai, wa ayat (Wa wudi'al-kitabu) al-kh, kitab ya'ni namah-e-a'mal darmiyan mein rakh diya jayega, us waqt tu dekhega ki gunahgar log us ki tehreer se khaufzada ho rahe honge al-kh. Aur ayat mein hai, har ummat ko tu ghutnon ke bal giri hui dekhega, har ummat apne namah-e-a'mal ki janib bulai ja rahi hogi, aaj tumhein tumhare a'mal ka badla diya jayega. Yeh hai hamari kitab jo tum par haq aur insaaf ke sath faisla karegi, jo kuch tum karte rahe hum barabar likhte rehte the. Yeh yaad rahe ki yeh tafsir pehli tafsir ke khilaf nahi, ek taraf namah-e-a'mal hath mein hoga, doosri janib khud Nabi samne maujood hoga, jaise farman hai ayat: (Wa ashraqatil-ardu bi-noori rabbiha wa wudi'al-kitabu wa ji'a bin-nabiyyeena wa-sh-shuhada'i wa qudiya bainahum bil-haqqi wa hum la yuzlamoon) (39. Az-Zumar: 69). Zameen apne Rabb ke noor se chamakne lagegi, namah-e-a'mal rakh diya jayega aur nabiyon aur gawahon ko maujood kar diya jayega. Ya'ni kya kaifiyat hogi us waqt jab ke har ummat ka hum gawah layenge aur tujhe is teri ummat par gawah kar ke layenge. Lekin murad yahan imam se namah-e-a'mal hai, isi liye is ke baad hi farmaya ki jin ke dayen hath mein de diya gaya, woh to apni nekiyan farhat o suroor, khushi aur rahat se padhne lagenge, balki doosron ko dikhate aur padhwate phirenge. Lekin kafir ka chehra siyah hojaye ga is ka jism barh jaye ga, ise dekh kar is ke sathi kehne lagenge Allah ise ruswa kar, yeh jawab dega, Allah tumhen ghaflat kare, tum mein se har shakhs ke liye yehi Allah ki maar hai. Makkar-o-fujjar ki chalakiyon se Allah Ta'ala hamesha apne Rasool ko bachata raha, Aap ko masoom aur sabit qadam hi rakha, khud hi Aap ka Wali-o-Nasir raha, apni hi hifazat aur siyanat mein hamesha Aap ko rakha, Aap ki ta'eed aur nusrat barabar karta raha, Aap ke deen ko duniya ke tamam deenon par ghalib kar diya, Aap ke mukhalifeen ke buland bang iradon ko past kar diya, mashriq se maghrib tak Aap ka kalma phaila diya. Isi ka bayaan in donon aayton mein hai. Allah Ta'ala Aap par qayamat tak beshumar durood-o-salam bheja kare. Ameen.

Watani Asabiyat aur Yahudi kehte hain ke Yahudiyon ne Huzoor ﷺ se kaha tha ke Aap ko Mulk-e-Sham chala jana chahiye wahi Nabiyon ka watan hai is shehar Madina ko chor dena chahiye is par yeh ayat utri. Lekin yeh qoul zaeef hai is liye ke ayat Makki hai aur Madine mein Aap ki rehaish is ke baad hui hai, kehte hain ke Tabuk ke bare mein yeh ayat utri hai Yahudiyon ke kehne se ke Sham jo Nabiyon ki aur mahshar ki zameen hai Aap ko wahin rehna chahiye, agar aap sachhe hi hain. Surah Bani Israel ki ayatein utrin, is ke baad surat khatam kar di gayi thi ayat:

(Wa in kaadu layastafizzunaka min-al-ardi liyukhrijuka minha wa izal la yalbasuna khilafaka illa qalila. Sunnata man qad arsalna qablaka min rusulina wa la tajidu lisunnatina tahwila) (17. Al-Isra: 76-77)

Aur Allah Ta'ala ne Aap ko Madine ki wapsi ka hukm diya aur farmaya wahin Aap ki maut-e-zeest hai aur wahin se dobara uth kar khara hona hai. Lekin is ki sanad bhi ghor talab hai aur saaf zahir hai ke yeh waqia bhi theek nahi, Tabuk ka ghazwa Yahud ke kehne se na tha balki Allah ka farman mojood hai ayat:

(Ya ayyuha alladhina amanu qatiluu alladhina yalunakum min-al-kuffari walyajidu fikum ghilzatan wa'lamu anna Allaha ma'a al-muttaqin) (9. At-Tawbah: 123)

Jo kuffar tumhare ird gird hain un se jihad karo. Aur ayat mein hai ke jo Allah par aur qayamat par iman nahi rakhte, Allah Rasool ke haram karda ko haram nahi samjhte hain aur haq ko qubool nahi karte, aise Ahl-e-Kitab se Allah ki raah mein jihad karo yahan tak ke woh zillat ke sath jaziya dena manzoor kar lein. Aur is ghazway ki wajah yeh thi ke Aap ke jo ashab Jang-e-Mota mein shaheed kar diye gaye the un ka badla liya jaye, Wallahu A'lam. 

Aur agar mundarja bala waqia sahi hojaye to usi par woh hadith mahmool ki jayegi, jis mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain Makka, Madina aur Sham mein Quran nazil huwa hai. Waleed to is ki sharah mein likhte hain ke Sham se murad Bait-ul-Muqaddas hai lekin Sham se murad Tabuk kyun na liya jaye jo bilkul saaf aur bohat durust hai, Wallahu A'lam. 

Ek qoul yeh hai ke is se murad kafiron ka woh irada hai jo unhon ne Makka se jala watan karne ke bare mein kiya tha, chunacha yahi huwa bhi ke jab unhon ne Aap ko nikala, phir yeh bhi wahan zyada muddat na guzaar sake, Allah Ta'ala ne foran hi Aap ko ghalib kiya. Derh saal hi guzra tha ke Badr ki l<bos>2 larai baghair kisi tayyari aur ittila ke achanak ho gayi aur wahin kafiron ka aur kufr ka dhara toot gaya, un ke shareef o raees teh-tegh huwe, un ki shaan o shaukat khaak mein mil gayi, un ke sardar qaid mein aagaye. 

Pas farmaya ke yahi aadat pehle se jari hai. Sabqa Rasoolon ke sath bhi yahi huwa ke kuffar ne jab unhein tang kiya aur dais se nikaal diya phir woh bach na sake, azab-e-Allah ne unhein gharat aur be-nishan kar diya.

Haan chunke hamare paighambar Rasul-e-Rahmat (ﷺ) thay, is liye koi asmaani aam azaab un kafiron par na aaya. Jaise farman hai ayat: (Wama kana Allahu liyu'azzibahum wa anta fihum) yani teri maujudgi mein Allah unhein azaab na karega.
