Auqat-e-Salat ki nishandahi: Namazon ko waqton ki pabandi ke sath ada karne ka hukum ho raha hai. Dulook se murad ghuroob hai ya zawal hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir zawal ke qaul ko pasand farmate hain aur aksar mufassireen ka qaul bhi yahi hai. Hazrat Jabir (R.A) kehte hain main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aur aap ke sath un Sahaba (Razi Allahu Anhum / R.A) ki jinhein aap ne chaha dawat ki, khana kha kar suraj dhal jaane ke baad aap mere yahan se chale, Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se farmaya, chalo yahi waqt Dulook-e-Shams ka hai. Pas panchhon namazon ka waqt is aayat mein bayan ho gaya. Ghasaq se murad andhera hai. Jo kehte hain ke Dulook se murad ghuroobi hai, un ke nazdeek Zohar, Asr, Maghrib, Isha ka bayan to is mein hai aur Fajr ka bayan waquran-al-fajr mein hai. Hadith se ba-tawatur aqwal-o-af'al-e-Anhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se panchhon namazon ke auqat sabit hain aur Musalman bi-hamdillah ab tak is par hain, har pichhle zamane ke log agle zamane walon se barabar lete chale aate hain. Jaise ke in masail ke bayan ki jagah is ki tafseel majood hai walhamdulillah. Subh ki tilawat-e-Quran par din aur raat ke farishte aate hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai tanha shakhs ki namaz par jamaat ki namaz pachis darje zyada fazeelat rakhti hai. Subh ki namaz ke waqt din aur raat ke farishte ikatthe hote hain. Ise bayan farma kar rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne farmaya tum Quran ki aayat ko parh lo waquran-al-fajr al-kh. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke raat ke aur din ke farishte tum mein barabar pai-dar-pai aate rehte hain, subh ki aur Asr ki namaz ke waqt un ka ijtima ho jata hai. Tum mein jin farishton ne raat guzari woh jab charh jaate hain to Allah Ta'ala un se daryaft farmata hai, bawajood ye ke woh un se zyada jaanne wala hai ke tum ne mere bandon ko kis haal mein chhora? Woh jawab dete hain ke hum un ke paas pahunche to unhein namaz mein paya aur wapas aaye to namaz mein chhor kar aaye. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) farmate hain ke ye chaukidar farishte subh ki namaz mein jama hote hain phir ye charh jaate hain aur woh thehar jaate hain. Ibn-e-Jarir ki ek hadith mein Allah Ta'ala ke nazool farmane aur is irshad farmane ka zikr kiya ke koi hai? Jo mujh se istighfar kare aur main use bakhshoon, koi hai? Ke mujh se sawal kare aur main use doon. Koi hai? Jo mujh se dua kare aur main us ki dua ko qabool karoon. Yahan tak ke subh tuloo ho jaati hai pas is waqt par Allah Ta'ala majood hota hai aur raat ke farishte jama hote hain. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Tahajjud ki namaz ka hukum farmata hai, farishton ka to hukum hai hi. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha gaya ke farz namaz ke baad kaunsi namaz afzal hai? Aap ne farmaya raat ki namaz. Tahajjud kehte hain neend ke baad ki namaz ko, lughat mein, mufassireen ki tafseeron mein aur hadith mein ye majood hai, aap ki aadat bhi yahi thi ke so kar uthte phir Tahajjud parhte. Jaise ke apni jagah bayan majood hai. Haan Hasan Basri ka qaul hai ke jo namaz Isha ke baad ho. Mumkin hai ke is se bhi murad so jaane ke baad ho.

Phir farmaya yeh ziyadati tere liye hai. Baaz toh kehte hain, Tahajjud ki namazon ke barkhilaf sirf Huzoor ﷺ par farz thi. Baaz kehte hain yeh khususiyat is wajah se hai ki aap ke tamam agle pichle gunah maaf the aur umtiyon ki is namaz ke wajah se un ke gunah door ho jate hain. Hamare is hukm ki baja-awari par hum tujhe is jagah khada karenge ki jahan khada hone par tamam makhlooq aap ki tareefein karegi aur khud Khaliq-e-Akbar bhi. Kehte hain ki Maqaam-e-Mahmoud par Qayamat ke din aap apni ummat ki shafaat ke liye jayenge taaki is din ki ghabrahat se aap unhein raahat dein. Hazrat Huzaifa ؓ farmate hain log ek hi maidan mein jama kiye jayenge pukarne wala apni aawaz unhein sunayega, aankhein khul jayengi, nange paon nange badan honge, jaise ke paida kiye gaye the, sab khade honge, koi bhi baghair ijazat-e-Ilahi baat na kar sakega, aawaz aayegi, Aye Muhammad ﷺ! Aap kahenge Labbaik wa Sa'daik. Aye Allah tamam bhalayi tere hi haath hai. Burayi teri janib se nahi. Rah-yafta wahi hai jise tu hidayat baksh, tera ghulam tere samne mojood hai, woh teri hi madad se qaim hai, woh teri hi janib jhukne wala hai. Teri pakad se siwaye tere darbar ke aur koi panah nahi tu barkaton aur bulandiyon wala hai Aye Rabb-ul-Bait tu paak hai. Maqaam-e-Mahmoud ka taaruf yeh Maqaam-e-Mahmoud jiska zikr Allah Azza wa Jalla ne is aayat mein kiya hai. Pas yeh maqam maqam-e-shafaat hai. Qatadah ؒ farmate hain Qayamat ke din sab se pehle zameen se aap bahar aayenge aur sab se pehle shafaat aap hi karenge. Ahl-e-Ilm kehte hain ki yahi Maqaam-e-Mahmoud hai jiska wada Allah Kareem ne apne Rasool-e-Maqbool se kiya hai ﷺ. Beshak Huzoor ﷺ ki bohat si buzurgiyan aisi milengi jin mein koi aap ki barabari ka nahi. Sab se pehle aap hi ki qabr ki zameen shaq hogi aur aap sawari par sawar mahshar ki taraf jayenge, aap ka ek jhanda hoga ki Hazrat Adam A.S, Hazrat Nuh A.S, Hazrat Ibrahim A.S, Hazrat Musa A.S aur Hazrat Isa A.S ke paas ho aayenge aur sab inkar kar dein. Phir aap ke paas aayenge aur aap iske liye taiyar honge jaise ke iski hadeethein mufassal aa rahi hain Insha'Allah aap un logon ki shafaat karenge jin ki babat hukm ho chuka hoga ki unhein Jahannam ki taraf le jayen. Phir woh aap ki shafaat se wapas lota diye jayenge, sab se pehle aap hi Jannat mein le jane ke pehle sifarshi honge. Jaise ke Sahih Muslim ki hadees se sabit hai. Soor ki hadees mein hai ki tamam momin aap hi ki shafaat se Jannat mein jayenge. Sab se pehle aap Jannat mein jayenge aur aap ki ummat aur ummaton se pehle jayegi. Aap ki shafaat se kam darje ke jannati aala aur buland darje payenge. Aap hi Sahib-e-Waseela hain jo Jannat ki sab se aala manzil hai jo aap ke siwa kisi aur ko nahi milne ki. Yeh sahih hai ki bi-hukm-e-Ilahi gunahgaron ki shafaat farishte bhi karenge, nabi bhi karenge, momin bhi karenge lekin Huzoor ﷺ ki shafaat jis qadar logon ke bare mein hogi un ki ginti ka siwa Allah Ta'ala ke kisi ko ilm nahi is mein koi aap ki misl aur barabar nahi.

Kitab-e-Sirat ke aakhir mein Bab-ul-Khwasis mein maine ise khoob tafseel se bayan kiya hai walhamdulillah. Ab Maqam-e-Mahmud ke bare ki hadeesein suniye. Allah hamari madad kare. Bukhari mein hai Hazrat Ibn Umar ؓ farmate hain log qayamat ke din ghutnon ke bal gire hue honge har ummat apne nabi ke peeche hogi ke aye falan hamari shafaat kijiye, aye falan hamari shafaat kijiye yahan tak ke shafaat ki inteha Muhammad ﷺ ki taraf hogi. Pas yahi woh hai ke Allah Ta'ala Aap ko Maqam-e-Mahmud par khada karega. Ibn Jarir mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain sooraj bahut nazdeek hoga yahan tak ke paseena aadhe kanon tak pahunch jayega, isi halat mein log Hazrat Adam ؑ se fariyaad karenge, woh saaf inkar kar denge phir Hazrat Musa ؑ se kahenge aap yahi jawab denge ke main is qabil nahi phir Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ se kahenge Aap makhlooq ki shafaat ke liye chalenge yahan tak ke jannat ke darwaze ka kanda tham lenge, pas us waqt Aap ki taareefein karenge. Bukhari mein hai jo shakhs azan sun kar dua (Allahumma Rabb hazihi-d-da'wat-at-tammah) al-kh parh le us ke liye qayamat ke din meri shafaat halal hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain qayamat ke din main nabiyon ka imam aur un ka khatib aur un ka safarishi hunga main ye kuch bator fakr ke nahi kahta. Ise Tirmidhi bhi laye hain aur Hasan Sahih kaha hai. Ibn Majah mein bhi ye hai. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'b ؓ se woh hadees guzar chuki hai jis mein Quran ko saat qiraaton par parhne ka bayan hai us ke aakhir mein hai ke main ne kaha aye Allah meri ummat ko bakhsh, Elahi meri ummat ko bakhsh, teri dua main ne us din ke liye utha rakhi hai, jis din तमाम makhlooq meri taraf ragbat karegi, yahan tak ke agar Ibrahim ؑ bhi. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke qayamat ke din jam honge phir un ke dil mein khayal dala jayega ke hum kisi se kahen ke woh hamari sifarish kar ke hamein is jagah se aaram de, pas sab ke sab Hazrat Adam ؑ ke paas aayenge aur kahenge ke aye Adam aap tamam insano ke baap hain, Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko apne haath se paida kiya, aap ke liye apne farishton se sajda karaya aap ko tamam cheezon ke naam bataye aap apne Rab ke paas hamari sifarish le jayiye taaki hamein is jagah se rahat mile, Hazrat Adam ؑ jawab denge ke main is qabil nahi hun aap ko apna gunah yaad aa jayega aur Allah Ta'ala se sharmane lagenge, farmayenge tum Hazrat Nuh ؓ ke paas jao woh Allah ke pehle Rasool hain, jinhein zameen walon ki taraf Allah Pak ne bheja ye aayenge yahan se bhi jawab payenge ke main is ke layak nahi hun, aap ko bhi apni khata yaad aaye gi ke Allah se woh sawal kiya tha jis ka aap ko ilm na tha. Pas apne parwardigar se sharmayenge jayenge aur farmayenge tum Ibrahim Khalil-ur-Rahman ؑ ke paas jao woh aap ke paas aayenge, aap farmayenge, main is qabil nahi tum Hazrat Musa ؑ ke paas jao, un se Allah ne kalam kiya hai aur unhein Taurat di hai log Hazrat Musa ؑ ke paas aayenge lekin woh kahenge mujh mein itni qabiliyat kahan?

Phir aap us qatl ka zikar karenge jo baghair kisi maqtool ke muaweze ke aap ne kardiya tha pas wajah is ke sharmane lagenge aur kahenge tum Isa (A.S) ke paas jao jo Allah ke bande, us ka kalma aur us ki rooh hain. Woh yahan aayenge lekin aap farmayenge main is jagah ke qabil nahi hoon. Tum Muhammad (ﷺ) ke paas jao jin ke awwal aakhir tamam gunah bakhsh diye gaye hain, pas woh mere paas aayenge main khada hounga. Apne Rab se ijazat chahunga jab use dekhunga toh sajde mein gir padunga. Jab tak Allah ko manzoor hoga main sajde mein hi rahoonga phir farmaya jayega, Aae Muhammad sar uthaiye, kahiye, suna jayega, shafaa't kijiye, qabool ki jayegi, mangiye diya jayega, pas main sar uthaunga aur Allah ki woh tareefein karunga jo woh mujhe sikhayega. Phir main sifarish pesh karunga, mere liye ek had muqarrar kardi jayegi, main unhein jannat mein pucha aunga, phir dobara Janab-e-Bari mein hazir ho kar apne Rab ki woh hamd bayan karunga jo woh mujhe sikhayega phir main shafaa't karunga toh mere liye ek had muqarrar ki jayegi main unhein bhi jannat mein pohcha aunga. Phir teesri martaba lotunga apne Rab ko dekhte hi sajde mein gir padunga jab tak woh chahe usi halat mein pada rahoonga phir farmaya jayega ke Muhammad (ﷺ) sar utha, baat kar, suni jayegi. Sawaal kar, ata farmaya jayega. Sifarish kar, qabool ki jaye. Chunacha main sar utha kar woh hamd bayan kar ke jo mujhe wahi sikhayegi sifarish karunga. Phir chothi baar wapas aunga aur kahunga Bari Ta'ala ab toh sirf wohi baaki reh gaye hain jinhein Quran ne rok liya hai. Farmate hain jahannam mein se woh shakhs bhi nikal aayega jis ne La ilaha illallah kaha ho aur un ke dil mein ek zarre jitna iman ho. Yeh hadis Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai aap farmate hain meri ummat pul-e-sirat se guzar rahi hogi main wahin khada dekh raha hounga ke mere paas Hazrat Isa (A.S) aayenge aur farmayenge Aae Muhammad (ﷺ) anbiya ki jamaat aap se kuch mangti hai woh sab aap ke liye jama hain aur Allah se dua karte hain ke tamam ummaton ko jahan bhi chahe, alag alag kar de, us waqt woh sakht gham mein hain, tamam makhlooq paseenon mein goya lagam chadhai gayi hai. Momin par toh woh misl zukam ke hai lekin kafir par toh maut ka dhanp lena hai.

Aap farmayeinge ke thairo main aata hoon pas aap jayeinge arsh tale khade rahein ge aur woh izzat-o-abro milegi ke kisi barguzida farishte aur kisi bheje hue nabi rasool ko na mili ho phir Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Jibril A.S ki taraf wahi karega ke Muhammad ﷺ ke paas jao aur kaho ke aap sar uthaiye, mangiye, milega, sifarish kijiye, qubool hogi, pas mujhe apni ummat ki shafahat milegi ke har nannaway mein se ek nikaal laoon main baar baar apne Rab Azza wa Jalla ki taraf aata jaata rahoon ga aur har baar sifarish karoon ga yahan tak ke Janaab-e-Bari mujh se irshaad farmayega ke Ae Muhammad ﷺ jao makhlooq-e-Ilahi mein se jis ne ek din bhi khulus ke saath la ilaha illallah ki gawahi di ho aur usi par mara ho, use bhi jannat mein pohancha aao. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Buraidah R.A Hazrat Muawiyah R.A ke paas gaye us waqt ek shakhs kuch keh raha tha, unhon ne bhi kuch kehne ki ijazat mangi, Hazrat Muawiyah R.A ne ijazat di. Aap ka khayal yeh tha ke jo kuch yeh pehla shakhs keh raha hai wahi Buraidah R.A bhi kahenge. Hazrat Buraidah R.A ne farmaya main ne Rasool اللہ ﷺ se suna hai aap farmate hain mujhe Allah Ta'ala se ummeed hai ke zameen par jitne darakht aur kankar hain, un ki ginti ke barabar logon ki shafahat main karoon ga, pas Ae Muawiyah R.A aap ko to is ki ummeed ho aur Hazrat Ali R.A is se na-umeed hon? Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Malikah ke dono ladke Rasool Akram ﷺ ke paas aaye aur kehne lage hamari maan hamare walid ki badi hi izzat karti thin, bachon par badi meharbani aur shafqat karti thin, mehmandari mein koi daqiqah utha na rakhti thin. Haan unhon ne jahiliyat ke zamane mein apni zinda ladkiyan dargor kar di thin, aap ne farmaya phir woh jahannam mein pohanchi. Woh dono malool-e-khatir ho kar lote toh aap ne hukm diya ke unhein wapas bula lao woh lote aur un ke chehron par khushi thi ke ab Huzoor ﷺ koi achhi baat sunayeinge. Aap ne farmaya suno meri maan aur tumhari maan dono ek saath hi hain, ek munafiq yeh sun kar kehne laga ke is se is ki maan ko kya faida? Hum is ke peeche jaate hain ek Ansari jo Huzoor ﷺ se sab se zyada sawalaat karne ka aadi tha, kehne laga Ya RasoolAllah ﷺ kya is ke ya un dono ke bare mein aap se Allah Ta'ala ne koi wada kiya hai? Aap samajh gaye ke is ne kuch suna hai, farmane lage na mere Rab ne chaha na mujhe is bare mein koi tama' mili. Suno main qayamat ke din Maqam-e-Mahmood par pohanchaya jaaunga Ansari ne kaha woh kya maqam hai? Aap ne farmaya yeh us waqt jab ke tumhein nange badan be-khatna laya jayega. Sab se pehle Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ko kapde pehnaye jayeinge. Allah Ta'ala farmayega mere Khalil ko kapde pehnao.

Pas do chadrein safed rang ki pehnai jayengi aur aap Arsh ki taraf munh kiye baith jayenge phir mera libas laya jayega main un ki dayin taraf us jagah khada hounga ke tamam agle pichle log rashq karenge aur Kausar se lag kar hauz tak un ke liye khol diya jayega, munafiq kehne lage pani ke jari hone ke liye to mitti aur kankar lazmi hain aapne farmaya us ki mitti mushk hai aur kankar moti hain. Usne kaha, humne to kabhi aisa nahi suna. Achha pani ke kinare darakht bhi hone chahiyen, ansari ne kaha ya Rasulullah ﷺ kya wahan darakht bhi honge? Aapne farmaya haan sone ki shakhon wale. Munafiq ne kaha aaj jaisi baat to humne kabhi nahi suni. Achha darakhton mein patte aur phal bhi hone chahiyen. Ansari ne Huzoor ﷺ se pucha ke kya un darakhton mein phal bhi honge? Aapne farmaya haan rangarang ke Jawahir uska pani doodh se zyada safed hoga aur shahd se zyada meetha hoga. Ek ghont bhi jisne usmein se pi liya, woh kabhi bhi pyasa na hoga aur jo usse mehroom reh gaya woh phir kabhi asoodah na hoga. Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hai ke phir Allah Ta'ala Azza wa Jall shafahat ki ijazat dega, pas Rooh-ul-Qudus Hazrat Jibril A.S khade honge, phir Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah A.S khade honge aap se zyada kisi ki shafahat na hogi yahi Maqam-e-Mahmood hai jiska zikr is ayat mein hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke log qayamat ke din uthaye jayenge, main apni ummat samet ek teele par khada hounga, mujhe Allah Ta'ala sabz rang chola pehnayega, phir mujhe ijazat di jayegi aur jo kuch kehna chahunga, kahunga yahi Maqam-e-Mahmood hai jiska zikr is ayat mein hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke qayamat ke din sabse pehle mujhe sajda karne ki ijazat di jayegi aur mujhe hi sabse pehle sar uthane ki ijazat milegi, main apne aage peeche dayin bayin dekh kar apni ummat ko aur ummaton mein pehchan lunga, kisi ne pucha Huzoor ﷺ aur sari ummaten jo Hazrat Noh ke waqt tak ki hongi un sab mein se aap khaas apni ummat kaise pehchan lenge? Aapne farmaya wazu ke asar se unke hath paon munh chamak rahe honge unke siwa aur koi aisa na hoga aur main unhein yun pehchan lunga ke unke nama-e-amal unke dayin hath mein milenge aur nishan yeh hai ke unki auladein unke aage aage chal phir rahi hongi. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ke paas gosht laya gaya aur shane ka gosht chunke aapko zyada marghoob tha, wahi aapko diya gaya aap usmein se gosht tod tod kar khane lage aur farmaya qayamat ke din tamam logon ka sardar main hoon. Allah Ta'ala tamam aglon pichlon ko ek hi maidan mein jama karega aawaz dene wala unhein sunayega. Nigahein upar ko chadh jayengi sooraj bilkul nazdeek ho jayega aur log aisi sakhti aur ranj-o-gham mein mubtala hojayenge jo naqabil-e-bardasht hai. Us waqt woh aapas mein kahenge ke dekho to sahi hum sab kis museebat mein mubtala hain, chalo kisi se keh kar use sifarshi bana kar Allah Ta'ala ke paas bhejen.

Chanacha mashware se tay hoga aur log Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) ke paas jayenge aur kahenge aap tamam insano ke baap hain Allah Ta'ala ne apne haath se paida kiya hai, aap mein apni rooh phoonki hai, apne farishton ko aap ke saamne sajda karne ka hukum de kar un se sajda karaya hai. Aap kya hamari khasta haali mulahiza nahi farma rahe? Aap parvardigar se shafaat ki dua kijiye. Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) jawab denge ke mera Rab aaj is qadr ghazabnak ho raha hai ke kabhi is se pehle aisa ghazabnak nahi hua aur na us ke baad kabhi hoga. Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe ek darakht se roka tha, lekin mujh se nafarmani ho gayi. Aaj to mujhe khud apna khyal laga hua hai. Nafsa nafsi lagi hui hai. Tum kisi aur ke paas jao Nooh (Alaihis Salam) ke paas jao. Log wahan se Hazrat Nooh (Alaihis Salam) ke paas aayenge aur kahenge ke ae Nooh (Alaihis Salam) aap ko zameen walon ki taraf sab se pehle Allah Ta'ala ne Rasool bana kar bheja. Aap ka naam us ne shukar guzaar banda rakha. Aap hamare liye apne Rab ke paas shafaat kijiye, dekhiye to hum kis museebat mein mubtala hain? Hazrat Nooh (Alaihis Salam) jawab denge ke aaj to mera parvardigar is qadr ghazabnak hai ke is se pehle kabhi aisa gusse mein hua na us ke baad kabhi aisa gusse hoga. Mere liye ek dua thi jo main ne apni qaum ke khilaf maang li mujhe to aaj apni padi hai, nafsa nafsi lag rahi hai tum kisi aur ke paas jao. Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ke paas jao. Log Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ke paas jayenge aur kahenge ke, aap Nabiullah hain, aap Khalilullah hain, kya aap hamari yeh bapta nahi dekhte? Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) farmayenge ke mera Rab aaj is qadr ghazabnak hai ke kabhi is se pehle aisa naraz hua aur na us ke baad kabhi is se zyada gusse mein aayega phir aap apne jhoot yaad kar ke nafsi nafsi karne lagenge aur farmayenge mere siva kisi aur ke paas jao. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ke paas jao. Log Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ke paas jayenge aur kahenge ae Musa (Alaihis Salam) hamari shafaat le jayiye dekhiye to kaisi sakht aafat mein hain? Aap farmayenge aaj to mera Rab is qadr naraz hai aisa ke is se pehle kabhi aisa naraz nahi hua aur na kabhi is ke baad aisa naraz hoga, main ne Allah Ta'ala ke hukum ke baghair ek insaan ko maar dala tha. Nafsi nafsi tum mujhe chhod kisi aur se kaho tum Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ke paas chale jao. Log Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ke paas aayenge aur kahenge ae Isa (Alaihis Salam) aap Rasoolullah, Kalimatullah aur Roohullah hain jo Maryam (Raiha Allahu Anha) ki taraf bheji gayi bachpan mein gahware mein hi aap ne bolna shuru kar diya tha chahe hamare Rab se hamari shafaat kijiye khyal to farmaiye ke hum kis qadr bechain hain? Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) jawab denge ke aaj jaisa gussa to na pehle tha, na baad mein hoga, nafsi nafsi nafsi, aap apne kisi gunah ka zikr na karenge. Farmayenge tum kisi aur hi ke paas jao. Dekho main bataun tum sab Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas jao chanacha woh sab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aayenge aur kahenge ae Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap Rasoolullah hain, aap Khatam-ul-Anbiya hain, Allah Ta'ala ne aap ke tamam agle pichle gunah maaf farma diye hain.

Aap hamari shafa'at keejiye dekhiyye toh hum kaisi sakht balaon mein ghare hue hain, phir main khara hounga aur Arsh tale aa kar apne Rab 'Azza wa Jall ke samne sajde mein gir parunga. Phir Allah Ta'ala mujh par apni hamd-o-sana ke woh alfaaz khole ga jo mujh se pehle kisi aur par nahi khole the. Phir mujh se farmaya jayega aye Muhammad ﷺ apna sar uthao, mango, tumhein milega, shafa'at karo, manzoor hogi. Main apna sar sajde se uthaunga aur kahunga mere Parwardigar meri ummat, mere Rab meri ummat, aye Allah meri ummat, pas mujh se farmaya jayega, jao apni ummat mein se un logon ko jin par hisab nahi, Jannat mein le jao unhein Jannat ke dahini taraf ke darwaze se pahunchao lekin aur tamam darwaze se bhi rok nahi. Us Allah ki kasam jiske hath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, Jannat ki do chokhaton ke darmiyan itna fasla hai jitna Makkah aur Hameer mein ya Makkah aur Basri mein. Yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Muslim Sharif mein hai Qiyamat ke din Aulad-e-Adam ka sardar main hun is din sab se pehle meri qabr ki zamin shaq hogi, main hi pehla shafi hun aur pehla shafa'at qabul kiya gaya. Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ se is ayat ka matlab pucha gaya toh aap ne farmaya yeh shafa'at hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Maqam-e-Mahmoud woh maqam hai, jismein main apni ummat ki shafa'at karunga. Abdur Razzaq mein hai ke Qiyamat ke din khal ki tarah Allah Ta'ala zamin ko khinch lega yahan tak ke har shakhs ke liye sirf apne dono qadam tikane ki jagah hi rahegi sab se pehle ise usne nahi dekha. Main kahunga ke Bari Ta'ala is farishte ne mujh se kaha tha ke ise toh meri taraf bhej raha tha Allah Ta'ala 'Azza wa Jall farmayega usne sach kaha ab main yeh keh kar shafa'at karunga ke aye Allah tere bandon ne zamin ke mukhtalif hisson mein teri ibadat ki hai, Aap farmate hain yehi Maqam-e-Mahmoud hai. Yeh hadith mursal hai.

Auqat-e-Salat ki nishandahi: Namazon ko waqton ki pabandi ke sath ada karne ka hukum ho raha hai. Dulook se murad ghuroob hai ya zawal hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir zawal ke qaul ko pasand farmate hain aur aksar mufassireen ka qaul bhi yahi hai. Hazrat Jabir (R.A) kehte hain main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aur aap ke sath un Sahaba (Razi Allahu Anhum / R.A) ki jinhein aap ne chaha dawat ki, khana kha kar suraj dhal jaane ke baad aap mere yahan se chale, Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se farmaya, chalo yahi waqt Dulook-e-Shams ka hai. Pas panchhon namazon ka waqt is aayat mein bayan ho gaya. Ghasaq se murad andhera hai. Jo kehte hain ke Dulook se murad ghuroobi hai, un ke nazdeek Zohar, Asr, Maghrib, Isha ka bayan to is mein hai aur Fajr ka bayan waquran-al-fajr mein hai. Hadith se ba-tawatur aqwal-o-af'al-e-Anhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se panchhon namazon ke auqat sabit hain aur Musalman bi-hamdillah ab tak is par hain, har pichhle zamane ke log agle zamane walon se barabar lete chale aate hain. Jaise ke in masail ke bayan ki jagah is ki tafseel majood hai walhamdulillah. Subh ki tilawat-e-Quran par din aur raat ke farishte aate hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai tanha shakhs ki namaz par jamaat ki namaz pachis darje zyada fazeelat rakhti hai. Subh ki namaz ke waqt din aur raat ke farishte ikatthe hote hain. Ise bayan farma kar rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne farmaya tum Quran ki aayat ko parh lo waquran-al-fajr al-kh. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke raat ke aur din ke farishte tum mein barabar pai-dar-pai aate rehte hain, subh ki aur Asr ki namaz ke waqt un ka ijtima ho jata hai. Tum mein jin farishton ne raat guzari woh jab charh jaate hain to Allah Ta'ala un se daryaft farmata hai, bawajood ye ke woh un se zyada jaanne wala hai ke tum ne mere bandon ko kis haal mein chhora? Woh jawab dete hain ke hum un ke paas pahunche to unhein namaz mein paya aur wapas aaye to namaz mein chhor kar aaye. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) farmate hain ke ye chaukidar farishte subh ki namaz mein jama hote hain phir ye charh jaate hain aur woh thehar jaate hain. Ibn-e-Jarir ki ek hadith mein Allah Ta'ala ke nazool farmane aur is irshad farmane ka zikr kiya ke koi hai? Jo mujh se istighfar kare aur main use bakhshoon, koi hai? Ke mujh se sawal kare aur main use doon. Koi hai? Jo mujh se dua kare aur main us ki dua ko qabool karoon. Yahan tak ke subh tuloo ho jaati hai pas is waqt par Allah Ta'ala majood hota hai aur raat ke farishte jama hote hain. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Tahajjud ki namaz ka hukum farmata hai, farishton ka to hukum hai hi. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha gaya ke farz namaz ke baad kaunsi namaz afzal hai? Aap ne farmaya raat ki namaz. Tahajjud kehte hain neend ke baad ki namaz ko, lughat mein, mufassireen ki tafseeron mein aur hadith mein ye majood hai, aap ki aadat bhi yahi thi ke so kar uthte phir Tahajjud parhte. Jaise ke apni jagah bayan majood hai. Haan Hasan Basri ka qaul hai ke jo namaz Isha ke baad ho. Mumkin hai ke is se bhi murad so jaane ke baad ho.

Phir farmaya yeh ziyadati tere liye hai. Baaz toh kehte hain, Tahajjud ki namazon ke barkhilaf sirf Huzoor ﷺ par farz thi. Baaz kehte hain yeh khususiyat is wajah se hai ki aap ke tamam agle pichle gunah maaf the aur umtiyon ki is namaz ke wajah se un ke gunah door ho jate hain. Hamare is hukm ki baja-awari par hum tujhe is jagah khada karenge ki jahan khada hone par tamam makhlooq aap ki tareefein karegi aur khud Khaliq-e-Akbar bhi. Kehte hain ki Maqaam-e-Mahmoud par Qayamat ke din aap apni ummat ki shafaat ke liye jayenge taaki is din ki ghabrahat se aap unhein raahat dein. Hazrat Huzaifa ؓ farmate hain log ek hi maidan mein jama kiye jayenge pukarne wala apni aawaz unhein sunayega, aankhein khul jayengi, nange paon nange badan honge, jaise ke paida kiye gaye the, sab khade honge, koi bhi baghair ijazat-e-Ilahi baat na kar sakega, aawaz aayegi, Aye Muhammad ﷺ! Aap kahenge Labbaik wa Sa'daik. Aye Allah tamam bhalayi tere hi haath hai. Burayi teri janib se nahi. Rah-yafta wahi hai jise tu hidayat baksh, tera ghulam tere samne mojood hai, woh teri hi madad se qaim hai, woh teri hi janib jhukne wala hai. Teri pakad se siwaye tere darbar ke aur koi panah nahi tu barkaton aur bulandiyon wala hai Aye Rabb-ul-Bait tu paak hai. Maqaam-e-Mahmoud ka taaruf yeh Maqaam-e-Mahmoud jiska zikr Allah Azza wa Jalla ne is aayat mein kiya hai. Pas yeh maqam maqam-e-shafaat hai. Qatadah ؒ farmate hain Qayamat ke din sab se pehle zameen se aap bahar aayenge aur sab se pehle shafaat aap hi karenge. Ahl-e-Ilm kehte hain ki yahi Maqaam-e-Mahmoud hai jiska wada Allah Kareem ne apne Rasool-e-Maqbool se kiya hai ﷺ. Beshak Huzoor ﷺ ki bohat si buzurgiyan aisi milengi jin mein koi aap ki barabari ka nahi. Sab se pehle aap hi ki qabr ki zameen shaq hogi aur aap sawari par sawar mahshar ki taraf jayenge, aap ka ek jhanda hoga ki Hazrat Adam A.S, Hazrat Nuh A.S, Hazrat Ibrahim A.S, Hazrat Musa A.S aur Hazrat Isa A.S ke paas ho aayenge aur sab inkar kar dein. Phir aap ke paas aayenge aur aap iske liye taiyar honge jaise ke iski hadeethein mufassal aa rahi hain Insha'Allah aap un logon ki shafaat karenge jin ki babat hukm ho chuka hoga ki unhein Jahannam ki taraf le jayen. Phir woh aap ki shafaat se wapas lota diye jayenge, sab se pehle aap hi Jannat mein le jane ke pehle sifarshi honge. Jaise ke Sahih Muslim ki hadees se sabit hai. Soor ki hadees mein hai ki tamam momin aap hi ki shafaat se Jannat mein jayenge. Sab se pehle aap Jannat mein jayenge aur aap ki ummat aur ummaton se pehle jayegi. Aap ki shafaat se kam darje ke jannati aala aur buland darje payenge. Aap hi Sahib-e-Waseela hain jo Jannat ki sab se aala manzil hai jo aap ke siwa kisi aur ko nahi milne ki. Yeh sahih hai ki bi-hukm-e-Ilahi gunahgaron ki shafaat farishte bhi karenge, nabi bhi karenge, momin bhi karenge lekin Huzoor ﷺ ki shafaat jis qadar logon ke bare mein hogi un ki ginti ka siwa Allah Ta'ala ke kisi ko ilm nahi is mein koi aap ki misl aur barabar nahi.

Kitab-e-Sirat ke aakhir mein Bab-ul-Khwasis mein maine ise khoob tafseel se bayan kiya hai walhamdulillah. Ab Maqam-e-Mahmud ke bare ki hadeesein suniye. Allah hamari madad kare. Bukhari mein hai Hazrat Ibn Umar ؓ farmate hain log qayamat ke din ghutnon ke bal gire hue honge har ummat apne nabi ke peeche hogi ke aye falan hamari shafaat kijiye, aye falan hamari shafaat kijiye yahan tak ke shafaat ki inteha Muhammad ﷺ ki taraf hogi. Pas yahi woh hai ke Allah Ta'ala Aap ko Maqam-e-Mahmud par khada karega. Ibn Jarir mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain sooraj bahut nazdeek hoga yahan tak ke paseena aadhe kanon tak pahunch jayega, isi halat mein log Hazrat Adam ؑ se fariyaad karenge, woh saaf inkar kar denge phir Hazrat Musa ؑ se kahenge aap yahi jawab denge ke main is qabil nahi phir Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ se kahenge Aap makhlooq ki shafaat ke liye chalenge yahan tak ke jannat ke darwaze ka kanda tham lenge, pas us waqt Aap ki taareefein karenge. Bukhari mein hai jo shakhs azan sun kar dua (Allahumma Rabb hazihi-d-da'wat-at-tammah) al-kh parh le us ke liye qayamat ke din meri shafaat halal hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain qayamat ke din main nabiyon ka imam aur un ka khatib aur un ka safarishi hunga main ye kuch bator fakr ke nahi kahta. Ise Tirmidhi bhi laye hain aur Hasan Sahih kaha hai. Ibn Majah mein bhi ye hai. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'b ؓ se woh hadees guzar chuki hai jis mein Quran ko saat qiraaton par parhne ka bayan hai us ke aakhir mein hai ke main ne kaha aye Allah meri ummat ko bakhsh, Elahi meri ummat ko bakhsh, teri dua main ne us din ke liye utha rakhi hai, jis din तमाम makhlooq meri taraf ragbat karegi, yahan tak ke agar Ibrahim ؑ bhi. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke qayamat ke din jam honge phir un ke dil mein khayal dala jayega ke hum kisi se kahen ke woh hamari sifarish kar ke hamein is jagah se aaram de, pas sab ke sab Hazrat Adam ؑ ke paas aayenge aur kahenge ke aye Adam aap tamam insano ke baap hain, Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko apne haath se paida kiya, aap ke liye apne farishton se sajda karaya aap ko tamam cheezon ke naam bataye aap apne Rab ke paas hamari sifarish le jayiye taaki hamein is jagah se rahat mile, Hazrat Adam ؑ jawab denge ke main is qabil nahi hun aap ko apna gunah yaad aa jayega aur Allah Ta'ala se sharmane lagenge, farmayenge tum Hazrat Nuh ؓ ke paas jao woh Allah ke pehle Rasool hain, jinhein zameen walon ki taraf Allah Pak ne bheja ye aayenge yahan se bhi jawab payenge ke main is ke layak nahi hun, aap ko bhi apni khata yaad aaye gi ke Allah se woh sawal kiya tha jis ka aap ko ilm na tha. Pas apne parwardigar se sharmayenge jayenge aur farmayenge tum Ibrahim Khalil-ur-Rahman ؑ ke paas jao woh aap ke paas aayenge, aap farmayenge, main is qabil nahi tum Hazrat Musa ؑ ke paas jao, un se Allah ne kalam kiya hai aur unhein Taurat di hai log Hazrat Musa ؑ ke paas aayenge lekin woh kahenge mujh mein itni qabiliyat kahan?

Phir aap us qatl ka zikar karenge jo baghair kisi maqtool ke muaweze ke aap ne kardiya tha pas wajah is ke sharmane lagenge aur kahenge tum Isa (A.S) ke paas jao jo Allah ke bande, us ka kalma aur us ki rooh hain. Woh yahan aayenge lekin aap farmayenge main is jagah ke qabil nahi hoon. Tum Muhammad (ﷺ) ke paas jao jin ke awwal aakhir tamam gunah bakhsh diye gaye hain, pas woh mere paas aayenge main khada hounga. Apne Rab se ijazat chahunga jab use dekhunga toh sajde mein gir padunga. Jab tak Allah ko manzoor hoga main sajde mein hi rahoonga phir farmaya jayega, Aae Muhammad sar uthaiye, kahiye, suna jayega, shafaa't kijiye, qabool ki jayegi, mangiye diya jayega, pas main sar uthaunga aur Allah ki woh tareefein karunga jo woh mujhe sikhayega. Phir main sifarish pesh karunga, mere liye ek had muqarrar kardi jayegi, main unhein jannat mein pucha aunga, phir dobara Janab-e-Bari mein hazir ho kar apne Rab ki woh hamd bayan karunga jo woh mujhe sikhayega phir main shafaa't karunga toh mere liye ek had muqarrar ki jayegi main unhein bhi jannat mein pohcha aunga. Phir teesri martaba lotunga apne Rab ko dekhte hi sajde mein gir padunga jab tak woh chahe usi halat mein pada rahoonga phir farmaya jayega ke Muhammad (ﷺ) sar utha, baat kar, suni jayegi. Sawaal kar, ata farmaya jayega. Sifarish kar, qabool ki jaye. Chunacha main sar utha kar woh hamd bayan kar ke jo mujhe wahi sikhayegi sifarish karunga. Phir chothi baar wapas aunga aur kahunga Bari Ta'ala ab toh sirf wohi baaki reh gaye hain jinhein Quran ne rok liya hai. Farmate hain jahannam mein se woh shakhs bhi nikal aayega jis ne La ilaha illallah kaha ho aur un ke dil mein ek zarre jitna iman ho. Yeh hadis Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai aap farmate hain meri ummat pul-e-sirat se guzar rahi hogi main wahin khada dekh raha hounga ke mere paas Hazrat Isa (A.S) aayenge aur farmayenge Aae Muhammad (ﷺ) anbiya ki jamaat aap se kuch mangti hai woh sab aap ke liye jama hain aur Allah se dua karte hain ke tamam ummaton ko jahan bhi chahe, alag alag kar de, us waqt woh sakht gham mein hain, tamam makhlooq paseenon mein goya lagam chadhai gayi hai. Momin par toh woh misl zukam ke hai lekin kafir par toh maut ka dhanp lena hai.

Aap farmayeinge ke thairo main aata hoon pas aap jayeinge arsh tale khade rahein ge aur woh izzat-o-abro milegi ke kisi barguzida farishte aur kisi bheje hue nabi rasool ko na mili ho phir Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Jibril A.S ki taraf wahi karega ke Muhammad ﷺ ke paas jao aur kaho ke aap sar uthaiye, mangiye, milega, sifarish kijiye, qubool hogi, pas mujhe apni ummat ki shafahat milegi ke har nannaway mein se ek nikaal laoon main baar baar apne Rab Azza wa Jalla ki taraf aata jaata rahoon ga aur har baar sifarish karoon ga yahan tak ke Janaab-e-Bari mujh se irshaad farmayega ke Ae Muhammad ﷺ jao makhlooq-e-Ilahi mein se jis ne ek din bhi khulus ke saath la ilaha illallah ki gawahi di ho aur usi par mara ho, use bhi jannat mein pohancha aao. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Buraidah R.A Hazrat Muawiyah R.A ke paas gaye us waqt ek shakhs kuch keh raha tha, unhon ne bhi kuch kehne ki ijazat mangi, Hazrat Muawiyah R.A ne ijazat di. Aap ka khayal yeh tha ke jo kuch yeh pehla shakhs keh raha hai wahi Buraidah R.A bhi kahenge. Hazrat Buraidah R.A ne farmaya main ne Rasool اللہ ﷺ se suna hai aap farmate hain mujhe Allah Ta'ala se ummeed hai ke zameen par jitne darakht aur kankar hain, un ki ginti ke barabar logon ki shafahat main karoon ga, pas Ae Muawiyah R.A aap ko to is ki ummeed ho aur Hazrat Ali R.A is se na-umeed hon? Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Malikah ke dono ladke Rasool Akram ﷺ ke paas aaye aur kehne lage hamari maan hamare walid ki badi hi izzat karti thin, bachon par badi meharbani aur shafqat karti thin, mehmandari mein koi daqiqah utha na rakhti thin. Haan unhon ne jahiliyat ke zamane mein apni zinda ladkiyan dargor kar di thin, aap ne farmaya phir woh jahannam mein pohanchi. Woh dono malool-e-khatir ho kar lote toh aap ne hukm diya ke unhein wapas bula lao woh lote aur un ke chehron par khushi thi ke ab Huzoor ﷺ koi achhi baat sunayeinge. Aap ne farmaya suno meri maan aur tumhari maan dono ek saath hi hain, ek munafiq yeh sun kar kehne laga ke is se is ki maan ko kya faida? Hum is ke peeche jaate hain ek Ansari jo Huzoor ﷺ se sab se zyada sawalaat karne ka aadi tha, kehne laga Ya RasoolAllah ﷺ kya is ke ya un dono ke bare mein aap se Allah Ta'ala ne koi wada kiya hai? Aap samajh gaye ke is ne kuch suna hai, farmane lage na mere Rab ne chaha na mujhe is bare mein koi tama' mili. Suno main qayamat ke din Maqam-e-Mahmood par pohanchaya jaaunga Ansari ne kaha woh kya maqam hai? Aap ne farmaya yeh us waqt jab ke tumhein nange badan be-khatna laya jayega. Sab se pehle Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ko kapde pehnaye jayeinge. Allah Ta'ala farmayega mere Khalil ko kapde pehnao.

Pas do chadrein safed rang ki pehnai jayengi aur aap Arsh ki taraf munh kiye baith jayenge phir mera libas laya jayega main un ki dayin taraf us jagah khada hounga ke tamam agle pichle log rashq karenge aur Kausar se lag kar hauz tak un ke liye khol diya jayega, munafiq kehne lage pani ke jari hone ke liye to mitti aur kankar lazmi hain aapne farmaya us ki mitti mushk hai aur kankar moti hain. Usne kaha, humne to kabhi aisa nahi suna. Achha pani ke kinare darakht bhi hone chahiyen, ansari ne kaha ya Rasulullah ﷺ kya wahan darakht bhi honge? Aapne farmaya haan sone ki shakhon wale. Munafiq ne kaha aaj jaisi baat to humne kabhi nahi suni. Achha darakhton mein patte aur phal bhi hone chahiyen. Ansari ne Huzoor ﷺ se pucha ke kya un darakhton mein phal bhi honge? Aapne farmaya haan rangarang ke Jawahir uska pani doodh se zyada safed hoga aur shahd se zyada meetha hoga. Ek ghont bhi jisne usmein se pi liya, woh kabhi bhi pyasa na hoga aur jo usse mehroom reh gaya woh phir kabhi asoodah na hoga. Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hai ke phir Allah Ta'ala Azza wa Jall shafahat ki ijazat dega, pas Rooh-ul-Qudus Hazrat Jibril A.S khade honge, phir Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah A.S khade honge aap se zyada kisi ki shafahat na hogi yahi Maqam-e-Mahmood hai jiska zikr is ayat mein hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke log qayamat ke din uthaye jayenge, main apni ummat samet ek teele par khada hounga, mujhe Allah Ta'ala sabz rang chola pehnayega, phir mujhe ijazat di jayegi aur jo kuch kehna chahunga, kahunga yahi Maqam-e-Mahmood hai jiska zikr is ayat mein hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke qayamat ke din sabse pehle mujhe sajda karne ki ijazat di jayegi aur mujhe hi sabse pehle sar uthane ki ijazat milegi, main apne aage peeche dayin bayin dekh kar apni ummat ko aur ummaton mein pehchan lunga, kisi ne pucha Huzoor ﷺ aur sari ummaten jo Hazrat Noh ke waqt tak ki hongi un sab mein se aap khaas apni ummat kaise pehchan lenge? Aapne farmaya wazu ke asar se unke hath paon munh chamak rahe honge unke siwa aur koi aisa na hoga aur main unhein yun pehchan lunga ke unke nama-e-amal unke dayin hath mein milenge aur nishan yeh hai ke unki auladein unke aage aage chal phir rahi hongi. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ke paas gosht laya gaya aur shane ka gosht chunke aapko zyada marghoob tha, wahi aapko diya gaya aap usmein se gosht tod tod kar khane lage aur farmaya qayamat ke din tamam logon ka sardar main hoon. Allah Ta'ala tamam aglon pichlon ko ek hi maidan mein jama karega aawaz dene wala unhein sunayega. Nigahein upar ko chadh jayengi sooraj bilkul nazdeek ho jayega aur log aisi sakhti aur ranj-o-gham mein mubtala hojayenge jo naqabil-e-bardasht hai. Us waqt woh aapas mein kahenge ke dekho to sahi hum sab kis museebat mein mubtala hain, chalo kisi se keh kar use sifarshi bana kar Allah Ta'ala ke paas bhejen.

Chanacha mashware se tay hoga aur log Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) ke paas jayenge aur kahenge aap tamam insano ke baap hain Allah Ta'ala ne apne haath se paida kiya hai, aap mein apni rooh phoonki hai, apne farishton ko aap ke saamne sajda karne ka hukum de kar un se sajda karaya hai. Aap kya hamari khasta haali mulahiza nahi farma rahe? Aap parvardigar se shafaat ki dua kijiye. Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) jawab denge ke mera Rab aaj is qadr ghazabnak ho raha hai ke kabhi is se pehle aisa ghazabnak nahi hua aur na us ke baad kabhi hoga. Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe ek darakht se roka tha, lekin mujh se nafarmani ho gayi. Aaj to mujhe khud apna khyal laga hua hai. Nafsa nafsi lagi hui hai. Tum kisi aur ke paas jao Nooh (Alaihis Salam) ke paas jao. Log wahan se Hazrat Nooh (Alaihis Salam) ke paas aayenge aur kahenge ke ae Nooh (Alaihis Salam) aap ko zameen walon ki taraf sab se pehle Allah Ta'ala ne Rasool bana kar bheja. Aap ka naam us ne shukar guzaar banda rakha. Aap hamare liye apne Rab ke paas shafaat kijiye, dekhiye to hum kis museebat mein mubtala hain? Hazrat Nooh (Alaihis Salam) jawab denge ke aaj to mera parvardigar is qadr ghazabnak hai ke is se pehle kabhi aisa gusse mein hua na us ke baad kabhi aisa gusse hoga. Mere liye ek dua thi jo main ne apni qaum ke khilaf maang li mujhe to aaj apni padi hai, nafsa nafsi lag rahi hai tum kisi aur ke paas jao. Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ke paas jao. Log Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ke paas jayenge aur kahenge ke, aap Nabiullah hain, aap Khalilullah hain, kya aap hamari yeh bapta nahi dekhte? Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) farmayenge ke mera Rab aaj is qadr ghazabnak hai ke kabhi is se pehle aisa naraz hua aur na us ke baad kabhi is se zyada gusse mein aayega phir aap apne jhoot yaad kar ke nafsi nafsi karne lagenge aur farmayenge mere siva kisi aur ke paas jao. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ke paas jao. Log Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ke paas jayenge aur kahenge ae Musa (Alaihis Salam) hamari shafaat le jayiye dekhiye to kaisi sakht aafat mein hain? Aap farmayenge aaj to mera Rab is qadr naraz hai aisa ke is se pehle kabhi aisa naraz nahi hua aur na kabhi is ke baad aisa naraz hoga, main ne Allah Ta'ala ke hukum ke baghair ek insaan ko maar dala tha. Nafsi nafsi tum mujhe chhod kisi aur se kaho tum Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ke paas chale jao. Log Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ke paas aayenge aur kahenge ae Isa (Alaihis Salam) aap Rasoolullah, Kalimatullah aur Roohullah hain jo Maryam (Raiha Allahu Anha) ki taraf bheji gayi bachpan mein gahware mein hi aap ne bolna shuru kar diya tha chahe hamare Rab se hamari shafaat kijiye khyal to farmaiye ke hum kis qadr bechain hain? Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) jawab denge ke aaj jaisa gussa to na pehle tha, na baad mein hoga, nafsi nafsi nafsi, aap apne kisi gunah ka zikr na karenge. Farmayenge tum kisi aur hi ke paas jao. Dekho main bataun tum sab Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas jao chanacha woh sab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aayenge aur kahenge ae Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap Rasoolullah hain, aap Khatam-ul-Anbiya hain, Allah Ta'ala ne aap ke tamam agle pichle gunah maaf farma diye hain.

Aap hamari shafa'at keejiye dekhiyye toh hum kaisi sakht balaon mein ghare hue hain, phir main khara hounga aur Arsh tale aa kar apne Rab 'Azza wa Jall ke samne sajde mein gir parunga. Phir Allah Ta'ala mujh par apni hamd-o-sana ke woh alfaaz khole ga jo mujh se pehle kisi aur par nahi khole the. Phir mujh se farmaya jayega aye Muhammad ﷺ apna sar uthao, mango, tumhein milega, shafa'at karo, manzoor hogi. Main apna sar sajde se uthaunga aur kahunga mere Parwardigar meri ummat, mere Rab meri ummat, aye Allah meri ummat, pas mujh se farmaya jayega, jao apni ummat mein se un logon ko jin par hisab nahi, Jannat mein le jao unhein Jannat ke dahini taraf ke darwaze se pahunchao lekin aur tamam darwaze se bhi rok nahi. Us Allah ki kasam jiske hath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, Jannat ki do chokhaton ke darmiyan itna fasla hai jitna Makkah aur Hameer mein ya Makkah aur Basri mein. Yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Muslim Sharif mein hai Qiyamat ke din Aulad-e-Adam ka sardar main hun is din sab se pehle meri qabr ki zamin shaq hogi, main hi pehla shafi hun aur pehla shafa'at qabul kiya gaya. Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ se is ayat ka matlab pucha gaya toh aap ne farmaya yeh shafa'at hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Maqam-e-Mahmoud woh maqam hai, jismein main apni ummat ki shafa'at karunga. Abdur Razzaq mein hai ke Qiyamat ke din khal ki tarah Allah Ta'ala zamin ko khinch lega yahan tak ke har shakhs ke liye sirf apne dono qadam tikane ki jagah hi rahegi sab se pehle ise usne nahi dekha. Main kahunga ke Bari Ta'ala is farishte ne mujh se kaha tha ke ise toh meri taraf bhej raha tha Allah Ta'ala 'Azza wa Jall farmayega usne sach kaha ab main yeh keh kar shafa'at karunga ke aye Allah tere bandon ne zamin ke mukhtalif hisson mein teri ibadat ki hai, Aap farmate hain yehi Maqam-e-Mahmoud hai. Yeh hadith mursal hai.

Hukm-e-Hijrat Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke Nabi ﷺ Makkah Sharif mein the phir Aap ko hijrat ka hukm hua aur yeh ayat utri. Imam Tirmizi R.H farmate hain yeh hadis Hasan Sahih hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain ke kuffar-e-Makkah ne mashwara kiya ke Aap ko qatal kardein ya nikal dein ya qaid karlein pas Allah ka yahi irada hua ke ahl-e-Makkah ko un ki bad-aamaliyon ka maza chakha de. Us ne apne paighambar ﷺ ko Madine jaane ka hukm farmaya. Yahi is ayat mein bayan ho raha hai. Qatadah R.H farmate hain Madine mein dakhil hona aur Makkah se nikalna yahi qaul sab se zyada mashhoor hai. Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke sachai ke dakhile se murad maut hai aur sachai se nikalne se murad maut ke baad ki zindagi hai aur aqwal bhi hain lekin zyada sahi pehla qaul hi hai. Imam Ibn Jarir bhi isi ko ikhtiyar karte hain phir hukm hua ke ghalbe aur madad ki dua hum se karo. Is dua par Allah Ta'ala ne Fars aur Room ka mulk aur izrat dene ka wada farma liya itna to Huzoor ﷺ maloom kar chuke the ke baghair ghalbe ke deen ki ishaat aur zor namumkin hai is liye Allah Ta'ala se madad-o-ghalba talab kiya taake Kitabullah aur Hududullah, Faraiz-e-Shara aur Qiyam-e-Deen Aap kar sakein yeh ghalba bhi Allah ki ek zabardast rahmat hai. Agar yeh na hota to ek dusre ko kha jata. Har zorawar kamzor ka shikar kar leta. Sultanan Nasiran se murad khuli daleel bhi hai lekin pehla qaul pehla hi hai is liye ke haq ke sath ghalba aur taqat bhi zaroori cheez hai taake mukhalifeen-e-haq dabay rahein isi liye Allah Ta'ala ne lohe ke utaarne ke ehsan ko Quran mein khas taur par zikr kiya hai. Ek hadis mein hai ke saltanat ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala bohat si buraiyon ko rok deta hai jo sirf Quran se nahi ruk sakti theen. Yeh bilkul waqia hai bohat se log hain ke Quran ki naseehtein us ke waade waeed un ko badkariyon se nahi hata sakte. Lekin islami taqat se maroob ho kar woh buraiyon se ruk jaate hain phir kafiron ki goshmali ki jaan hai ke Allah ki jaanib se haq aa chuka. Sachai utar aayi, jis mein koi shakk shubah nahi, Quran iman nafa dene wala sacha ilm minjanib Allah aa gaya, kufr barbad-o-gharat aur benam-o-nishan ho gaya, woh haq ke muqable mein bedast-o-pa sabit hua, haq ne batil ka dimaagh pash pash kar diya aur nabood aur bewajood ho gaya. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ Makkah mein aaye Baitullah ke aas paas teen sau saths but the, Aap apne haath ki lakhdi se unhe kachoke de rahe the aur yahi ayat padhte the aur farmate jaate the haq aa chuka batil na dobara aa sakta hai na loot sakta hai. Abu Yala mein hai ke hum Huzoor ﷺ ke sath Makkah mein aaye, Baitullah ke gird-o-nawah teen sau saths but the, jin ki pooja paat ki jaati thi Aap ne foran hukm diya ke in sab ko ondhay munh gira do phir Aap ne yahi ayat tilawat farmai.

Hukm-e-Hijrat Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke Nabi ﷺ Makkah Sharif mein the phir Aap ko hijrat ka hukm hua aur yeh ayat utri. Imam Tirmizi R.H farmate hain yeh hadis Hasan Sahih hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain ke kuffar-e-Makkah ne mashwara kiya ke Aap ko qatal kardein ya nikal dein ya qaid karlein pas Allah ka yahi irada hua ke ahl-e-Makkah ko un ki bad-aamaliyon ka maza chakha de. Us ne apne paighambar ﷺ ko Madine jaane ka hukm farmaya. Yahi is ayat mein bayan ho raha hai. Qatadah R.H farmate hain Madine mein dakhil hona aur Makkah se nikalna yahi qaul sab se zyada mashhoor hai. Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke sachai ke dakhile se murad maut hai aur sachai se nikalne se murad maut ke baad ki zindagi hai aur aqwal bhi hain lekin zyada sahi pehla qaul hi hai. Imam Ibn Jarir bhi isi ko ikhtiyar karte hain phir hukm hua ke ghalbe aur madad ki dua hum se karo. Is dua par Allah Ta'ala ne Fars aur Room ka mulk aur izrat dene ka wada farma liya itna to Huzoor ﷺ maloom kar chuke the ke baghair ghalbe ke deen ki ishaat aur zor namumkin hai is liye Allah Ta'ala se madad-o-ghalba talab kiya taake Kitabullah aur Hududullah, Faraiz-e-Shara aur Qiyam-e-Deen Aap kar sakein yeh ghalba bhi Allah ki ek zabardast rahmat hai. Agar yeh na hota to ek dusre ko kha jata. Har zorawar kamzor ka shikar kar leta. Sultanan Nasiran se murad khuli daleel bhi hai lekin pehla qaul pehla hi hai is liye ke haq ke sath ghalba aur taqat bhi zaroori cheez hai taake mukhalifeen-e-haq dabay rahein isi liye Allah Ta'ala ne lohe ke utaarne ke ehsan ko Quran mein khas taur par zikr kiya hai. Ek hadis mein hai ke saltanat ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala bohat si buraiyon ko rok deta hai jo sirf Quran se nahi ruk sakti theen. Yeh bilkul waqia hai bohat se log hain ke Quran ki naseehtein us ke waade waeed un ko badkariyon se nahi hata sakte. Sachai utar aayi, jis mein koi shakk shubah nahi, Quran iman nafa dene wala sacha ilm minjanib Allah aa gaya, kufr barbad-o-gharat aur benam-o-nishan ho gaya, woh haq ke muqable mein bedast-o-pa sabit hua, haq ne batil ka dimaagh pash pash kar diya aur nabood aur bewajood ho gaya. Abu Yala mein hai ke hum Huzoor ﷺ ke sath Makkah mein aaye, Baitullah ke gird-o-nawah teen sau saths but the, jin ki pooja paat ki jaati thi Aap ne foran hukm diya ke in sab ko ondhay munh gira do phir Aap ne yahi ayat tilawat farmai.

Qur'an Hakim Shifa hai Allah Ta'ala apni Kitab ki babat jis mein batil ka shaiba bhi nahi, farmata hai ki woh imandaron ke dilon ki tamam bemariyon ke liye shifa hai. Shak, nifaq, shirk, terh pan aur batil ki lagawat sab is se door ho jati hai. Iman, hikmat, bhalai, rahmat, nekiyon ki raghbat, is se hasil hoti hai. Jo bhi is par iman-o-yaqin laye use sach samajh kar is ki tabadari kare, yeh use Allah ke Rahmat ke niche la khra karta hai. Haan jo zalim jabir ho, jo is se inkar kare woh Allah se aur door ho jata hai. Qur'an sun kar is ka kufr aur barh jata hai pas yeh aafat khud kafir ki taraf se, is ke kufr ki wajah se hoti hai na ki Qur'an ki taraf se woh to sarasar rahmat-o-shifa hai chunache aur ayat Qur'an mein hai (Qul huwa lilladhina amanu hudan wa shifa'un walladhina la yu'minuna fi adanihim waqrun wa huwa ‘alaihim ‘aman ula'ika yunadawna min makanin ba'id) (41. Fussilat: 44) keh de ki yeh imandaron ke liye hidayat aur shifa hai aur bey-imaron ke kanon mein parde hain aur un ki nigahon par parda hai yeh to door daraz se awazein diye jate hain. Aur ayat mein hai (Wa idha ma unzilat suratun faminhum man yaqulu ayyukum zadathu hadhihi imanan fa ammal-ladhina amanu fazadathum imanan wahum yastabshirun) (9. At-Tawbah: 124) jahan koi surat utri ki ek groh ne puchna shuru kiya ki tum mein se kis ko is ne iman mein barhaya? Suno iman walon ke to iman barh jate hain aur woh hashash bashash ho jate hain haan jin ke dilon mein bemari hai un ki gandagi par gandagi barh jati hai aur marte dam tak kufr par qaim rehte hain. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si ayatein hain. Al-Gharz momin is pak Kitab ko sun kar nafa uthata hai, ise hifz karta hai, ise yaad karta hai, is ka khayal rakhta hai. Bey-insaf log na is se nafa hasil karte hain, na ise hifz karte hain, na is ki nigahbani karte hain, Allah ne ise shifa-o-rahmat sirf mominon ke liye banaya hai.

Insani fitrat mein khair-o-shar maujud hai. Khair-o-shar, burai, bhalai jo insan ki fitrat mein hain, Quran-e-Kareem unko bayan farma raha hai. Maal, afiyat, fath, rizq, nusrat, ta'eed, kushadgi, aaram patay hi nazrein pher leta hai. Allah se door hojata hai goya usay kabhi burai pohnchnay ki hi nahi. Allah se karwat badal leta hai goya kabhi ki jaan pehchan hi nahi aur jahan musibat, takleef, dukh, dard, aafat, hadsa pohncha aur yeh na-umeed huwa, samajh leta hai ke ab bhalai, afiyat, rahat, aaram milnay hi ka nahi. 

Quran-e-Kareem aur jagah irshad farmata hai, ayat: (Wa la-in azqnal-insana minna rahmatan thumma naza'naha minhu innahu layasoonun kafoor) (11. Hud: 9). Insan ko rahaten dey kar jahan hum nay wapas lay leen ke yeh mahz mayus aur nashukra ban gaya aur jahan musibaton ke baad hum nay afiyaten deen yeh phool gaya, ghamand mein aagya aur haank laganay laga ke bas ab buraiyan mujh se door hogaein. 

Farmata hai ke har shakhs apni apni tarz par, apni tabiyat par, apni niyat par, apnay deen aur tareeqay par amil hai to lagay rahen. Uska ilm ke fi-waqia rah-e-raast par kaun hai, sirf Allah hi ko hai. Is mein mushrikeen ko tanbeeh hai ke woh apnay maslak par go kar-band hon aur achha samajh rahay hon lekin Allah ke paas ja kar khulay ga ke jis rah par woh thay woh kaisi khatarnak thi. Jaisay farman hai ke be-e-manon se keh do ke achha hum apni jagah apnay kaam kartay jao al-kh. Badlay ka waqt yeh nahi, Qayamat ka din hai, neki badi ki tameez us din hogi, sab ko badlay milengay, Allah par koi amr poshida nahi.

Bukhari waghaira mein Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ Madine ke kheton mein ja rahe the, aap ke haath mein lakڑی thi, main aap ke hamrah tha. Yahoodi ke ek giroh ne aap ko dekh kar aapas mein kana phoonsi shuru ki ke aao in se rooh ki baabit sawal karein. Koi kehne laga achha, kisi ne kaha mat pucho. Koi kehne lage tumhe is se kya natija, koi kehne laga shayad koi jawab aisa dein jo tumhare khilaf ho. Jane do na pucho. Aakhir woh aaye aur Hazrat se sawal kiya aur aap apni lakri par tek laga kar thehar gaye. Main samajh gaya ke wahi utar rahi hai, khamosh khara reh gaya, is ke baad aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat ki. Is se to ba-zahir maloom hota hai ke yeh ayat Madani hai halanki poori surat Makki hai, lekin yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke Makkah ki utri hui ayat se hi is moqa par Madine ke Yahoodiyon ko jawab dene ki wahi hui ho ya yeh ke dobara yahi ayat nazil hui ho. Musnad Ahmad ki riwayat se bhi is ayat ka Makkah mein utarna hi maloom hota hai. 

Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke Qurayshiyon ne Yahoodiyon se darkhwast ki koi mushkil sawal batao ke hum in se poochein, unhon ne sawal sujhaya. Is ke jawab mein yeh ayat utri to yeh sarkash kehne lage humein bara ilm hai, Taurat humein mili hai aur jis ke paas Taurat ho use bahut si bhalai mil gayi. Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat nazil farmaayi: 
Qul lau kanal bahru midadal li-kalimati rabbi la-nafidal bahru qabla an tanfada kalimatu rabbi wa lau ji'na bi-mithlihi madada (Surah Al-Kahf: 109). 
Yaani agar tamam samundaron ki siyahi ban jaye aur is se Kalimat-e-Ilahi likhne shuru kiye jayein toh yeh roshnai sab khushk ho jayegi aur Allah ke kalmaat baaki reh jayein ge, toh phir tum is ki madad mein aise hi aur bhi laao. 

Ikrimah ne Yahoodiyon ke sawal par is ayat ka utrna aur un ke is makrooh qaul par doosri ayat: 
Wa lau anna ma fil-ardi min shajaratin aqlamun wal-bahru yamudduhu mim ba'dihi sab'atu abhurin ma nafidat kalimatullahi inn-Allaha ‘Azizun Hakim (Surah Luqman: 27) ka bayan farmaya hai. 
Yaani rooye zameen ke darakhton ki qalamein aur rooye zameen ke samundaron ki roshnai aur un ke sath hi sath aise hi aur samundar bhi hon, jab bhi Allah ke ilm ke muqabla mein bahut thori cheez hai. 

Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq Rahimahullah ne zikr kiya hai ke Makkah mein yeh ayat utri ke tumhein bahut thora ilm diya gaya hai. Jab aap hijrat kar ke Madina phonche toh Madine ke ulama-e-yahood aap ke paas aaye aur kehne lage humne suna hai aap yun kehte hain ke tumhein toh bahut hi kam ata farmaya gaya hai, is se murad aap ki qoum hai ya hum? Aap ne farmaya tum bhi aur woh bhi. Unhon ne kaha suno khud Quran mein parhte ho ke hum ko Taurat mili hai aur yeh bhi Quran mein hai ke is mein har cheez ka bayan hai. Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya Ilm-e-Ilahi ke muqabale mein yeh bhi kam hai.

Haan beshak tumhein Allah ne itna ilm de rakha hai ki agar tum is par amal karo toh tumhein bahut kuch nafa mile aur yeh ayat utri: Wa lau anna ma fil-ardi min shajaratin aqlamun wal-bahru yamudduhu mim ba'dihi sab'atu abhurin ma nafidat kalimatullahi innal-laha azizun hakim (Surah Luqman: 27). 

Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se manqul hai ki yahudiyon ne Huzoor ﷺ se ruh ki babat sawal kiya ki isi jism ke sath azab kyun hota hai? Woh toh Allah ki taraf se hai kyunke is bare mein koi ayat wahi aap par nahi utri thi, aap ne unhein kuch na farmaya. Isi waqt aap ke paas Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) aaye aur yeh ayat utri. Yeh sun kar yahudiyon ne kaha aap ko is ki khabar kis ne di? Aap ne farmaya Jibrail Allah ki taraf se yeh farman laye. Woh kehne lage woh toh hamara dushman hai. Is par ayat: Qul man kana aduwwan li-Jibrila fa innahu nazzalahu 'ala qalbihi bi-iznillahi musaddiqan lima baina yadaihi wa hudan wa bushra lil-mu'minin (Surah Al-Baqarah: 97) nazil hui, yaani Jibrail ke dushman ka dushman Allah hai aur aisa shakhs kafir hai. 

Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke yahan ruh se murad Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) hain. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke murad ek aisa azeem-ush-shan farishta hai jo tamam makhlooq ke barabar hai. Ek hadith mein hai ke Allah ka ek farishta aisa bhi hai ke agar us se saton zaminon aur saton asmanon ko ek luqma banane ko kaha jaye toh woh bana le. Us ki tasbih yeh hai: Subhanaka haisu kunta, "Aise Allah tu pak hai jahan bhi hai." Yeh hadith gharib hai balki munkar hai. 

Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke yeh ek farishta hai jis ke sattar hazar munh hain aur har mun

Khizar Alaihis Salam aur Musa Alaihis Salam ke qisse mein aa raha hai ki jab yeh dono buzurg kashti par sawaar ho rahe the us waqt ek chiriya kashti ke takhte par baith kar apni chonch paani mein dubo kar ud gayi toh janab Khizar ne farmaya, "Aiye Musa! Mera aur tera aur tamaam makhlooq ka ilm Allah ke ilm ke saamne aisa aur itna hi hai jitna yeh chiriya is samandar se le udi." (Au kama qala). 

Ba-qaul-e-Suhaili baaz log kehte hain ki unhein unke sawal ka jawab nahi diya kyunki unka sawal zidd karne aur na maane ke taur par tha aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki jawab ho gaya. Muraad yeh hai ki rooh Shariat-e-Ilahi mein se hai, tumhe is mein na jaana chahiye, tum jaan rahe ho ki iske pehchanne ki koi tabii aur ilmi raah nahi balki woh shariat ki jihat se hai, pas tum shariat ko qubool kar lo lekin hamein toh yeh tareeqa khatre se khaali nazar nahi aata wallahu alam. 

Phir Suhaili ne ikhtilaf-e-ulama bayan kiya hai ki rooh nafs hi hai ya uske siwa. Aur is baat ko sabit kiya hai ki rooh jism mein misl hawa ke jaari hai aur nihayat lateef cheez hai jaise ki darakhton ki rago mein paani chadhta hai aur farishta jo rooh maa ke pet mein bachche mein phoonkta hai woh jism ke saath milte hi nafs ban jaati hai aur jism ki madad se woh achchi buri sifatein apne andar haasil kar leti hai, ya toh zikrullah ke saath mutma'in hone wali ho jaati hai ya buraiyon ka hukum karne wali ban jaati hai. 

Masalan paani darakht ki hayat hai, uske darakht se milne ke baais woh ek khaas baat apne andar paida kar leta hai masalan angoor paida hue phir unka paani nikala gaya ya sharab banayi gayi, pas woh asli paani ab jis soorat mein aaya use asli paani nahi kaha ja sakta. Isi tarah ab jism ke ittisal ke baad rooh ko aala rooh nahi kaha ja sakta, isi tarah ise nafs us se aur uske badan ke saath ke ittisal se murakkab hai. Pas rooh nafs hai lekin ek wajah se na ki tamaam wujooh se. 

Baat toh yeh dil ko lagti hai lekin haqeeqat ka ilm Allah hi ko hai. Logon ne is baare mein bahut kuch kaha hai aur badi badi mustaqil kitabein is par likhi hain. Is mazmoon par behtareen kitab Hafiz Ibn Manda ki kitab Ar-Rooh hai.

Quran Allah Ta'ala ka ehsan-e-azeem. Allah Ta'ala apne zabardast ehsan aur azeem-ush-shan nemat ko bayan farma raha hai jo us ne apne habeeb Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ par inaam ki hai yani Aap par aisi Kitab nazil farmai jis mein kahin se bhi kisi waqt baatil ki amizish na-mumkin hai. Agar woh chahe to is wahi ko salb bhi kar sakta hai. Ibn Masood R.A farmate hain aakhir zamane mein ek surkh hawa chalegi Sham ki taraf se yeh uthegi us waqt Quran ke warqon mein se aur hafizon ke dilon mein se Quran salb ho jayega. Ek harf bhi baaki nahi rahega phir Aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat ki. Phir apna fazl-o-karam aur ehsan bayan kar ke farmata hai ki is Quran-e-Kareem ki buzurgi ek yeh bhi hai ki tamam makhlooq is ke muqabale se aajiz hai. Kisi ke bas mein is jaisa kalam nahi jis tarah Allah Ta'ala be-misl be-nazeer be-shareek hai usi tarah is ka kalam misal se nazeer se apne jaise se paak hai. Ibn Ishaq ne waarid kiya hai ki yahood aaye the aur unhon ne kaha tha ki hum bhi isi jaisa kalam bana late hain pas yeh ayat utri lekin humein is ke manne mein taammul hai is liye ke yeh surat Makki hai aur is ka kul bayan Quraishon se hai wahi mukhatib hain aur yahood ke sath Makkah mein Aap ka ijtima nahi hua Madine mein un se mel hua wallahu aalam. Hum ne is paak Kitab mein har qism ki dalelein bayan farma kar haq ko wazeh kar diya hai aur har baat ko sharh-o-bast se bayan farma diya hai bawajood is ke bhi aksar log haq ki mukhalifat kar rahe hain aur haq ko dhakke de rahe hain aur Allah ki nashukri mein lage hue hain.

Quran Allah Ta'ala ka ehsan-e-azeem. Allah Ta'ala apne zabardast ehsan aur azeem-ush-shan nemat ko bayan farma raha hai jo us ne apne habeeb Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ par inaam ki hai yani Aap par aisi Kitab nazil farmai jis mein kahin se bhi kisi waqt baatil ki amizish na-mumkin hai. Agar woh chahe to is wahi ko salb bhi kar sakta hai. Ibn Masood R.A farmate hain aakhir zamane mein ek surkh hawa chalegi Sham ki taraf se yeh uthegi us waqt Quran ke warqon mein se aur hafizon ke dilon mein se Quran salb ho jayega. Ek harf bhi baaki nahi rahega phir Aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat ki. Phir apna fazl-o-karam aur ehsan bayan kar ke farmata hai ki is Quran-e-Kareem ki buzurgi ek yeh bhi hai ki tamam makhlooq is ke muqabale se aajiz hai. Kisi ke bas mein is jaisa kalam nahi jis tarah Allah Ta'ala be-misl be-nazeer be-shareek hai usi tarah is ka kalam misal se nazeer se apne jaise se paak hai. Ibn Ishaq ne waarid kiya hai ki yahood aaye the aur unhon ne kaha tha ki hum bhi isi jaisa kalam bana late hain pas yeh ayat utri lekin humein is ke manne mein taammul hai is liye ke yeh surat Makki hai aur is ka kul bayan Quraishon se hai wahi mukhatib hain aur yahood ke sath Makkah mein Aap ka ijtima nahi hua Madine mein un se mel hua wallahu aalam. Hum ne is paak Kitab mein har qism ki dalelein bayan farma kar haq ko wazeh kar diya hai aur har baat ko sharh-o-bast se bayan farma diya hai bawajood is ke bhi aksar log haq ki mukhalifat kar rahe hain aur haq ko dhakke de rahe hain aur Allah ki nashukri mein lage hue hain.

Quraish ke umra ki akhiri koshish. Ibn Abbas (R.A) kehte hain ke Rabia ke jo bete Utba aur Shaiba aur Abu Sufyan bin Harb aur Bani Abd-ud-Dar qabele ke do shakhs aur Abu Al-Bahtari Bani Asad ka aur Aswad bin Muttalib bin Asad aur Zumah bin Aswad aur Waleed bin Mughirah aur Abu Jahl bin Hisham aur Abdullah bin Abi Umayyah aur Umayyah bin Khalaf aur Aas bin Wail aur Nabih aur Munbih Sahmi Hajjaj ke ladke, yeh sab ya in mein se kuch suraj ke ghuroob ho jaane ke baad Ka'batullah ke peeche jama hue aur kehne lage bhai kisi ko bhej kar Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bula lo aur us se keh sun kar aaj faisla kar lo taake koi uzr baqi na rahe. Chunancha qasid gaya aur khabar di ke aap ki qaum ke ashraf log jama hue hain aur aap ko yaad kiya hai. Kyunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko un logon ka har waqt khayal rehta tha, aap ke jee mein aayi ke bahut mumkin hai Allah ne unhe sahi samajh de di ho aur yeh rah-e-rast par aa jayen, is liye aap foran hi tashreef laye. 

Quraishiyon ne aap ko dekhte hi kaha suniye aaj hum aap par hujjat poori kar dete hain taake phir hum par kisi qism ka ilzam na aaye, isi liye hum ne aap ko bulwaya hai. Wallah kisi ne apni qaum ko is museebat mein nahi dala hoga jo museebat tum ne hum par khadi kar rakhi hai, tum hamare baap dadaon ko galiyan dete ho, hamare deen ko bura kehte ho, hamare buzurgon ko bewuqoof batate ho, hamare ma'boodon ko bura kehte ho, tum ne hum mein tafreeq daal di, ladaiyan khadi kar di. Wallah aap ne humein kisi burai ke pohchane mein koi kasar utha nahi rakhi, ab saaf saaf sun lijiye aur soch samajh kar jawab deejiye. 

Agar aap ka irada in tamam baaton se maal jama karne ka hai to hum mojood hain, hum khud aap ko is qandar maal jama kar dete hain ke aap ke barabar hum mein se koi maldar na ho. Aur agar aap ka irada is se yeh hai ke aap hum par sardari karein to lo hum is ke liye bhi tayyar hain, hum aap ki sardari ko tasleem karte hain aur aap ki tabadari manzoor karte hain. Agar aap badshahat ke talib hain to wallah hum aap ki badshahat ka elan kar dete hain aur agar waqai aap ke dimagh mein koi fatoor hai, koi jinn aap ko sata raha hai to hum mojood hain, dil khol kar raqmein kharch kar ke tumhara ilaj mu'alija karenge yahan tak ke aap ko shifa ho jaye ya hum mazoor samajh liye jayen. 

Yeh sab sun kar sardar-e-rusoolan shafi-e-paighambaran (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jawab diya ke suno, bi-hamdillah mujhe koi dimaghi arza ya khalal ya aaseeb nahi, na main apni is risalat ki wajah se maldar banna chahta hoon, na kisi sardari ki tama hai, na badshah banna chahta hoon, balki mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne tum sab ki taraf apna rasool barhaq bana kar bheja hai aur mujh par apni kitab nazil farmai hai aur mujhe hukum diya hai ke main tumhein khushkhabriyaan suna doon aur dara dhamka doon.

Main ne apne Rabb ke paighamat tumheñ pahuñcha diye, tumhari sachi khair khwahi ki, tum agar qubool karlo ge toh dono jahan mein jahan naseeb dar ban jao ge aur agar na-manzoor kardo ge toh main sabr karunga yahan tak ke Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala Shanuh mujh mein aur tum mein sacha faisla farma de (au kama qaal). Ab sardaran-e-qoum ne kaha ke Muhammad ﷺ agar aap ko hamari in baaton mein se ek bhi manzoor nahi toh ab aur suno yeh toh khud tumheñ bhi maloom hai ke hum se ziyada tang shehar kisi aur ka nahi, hum se ziyada kam maal koi qoum nahi, hum se peet peet kar bohat kam rozi hasil karne wali bhi koi qoum nahi toh aap apne Rabb se jis ne aap ko apni risalat de kar bheja hai dua kijiye ke yeh pahad yahan se hata le taake hamara ilaqa kushada hojaye, hamare sheharon ko wusat hojaye. Is mein narein, chashmey aur darya jari hojayein jaise ke Sham aur Iraq mein hain aur yeh bhi dua kijiye ke hamare baap dada zinda hojayein aur un mein Qusayy bin Kilab zaroor ho woh hum mein ek buzurg aur sacha shakhs tha hum us se pooch lenge woh aap ki babat jo keh dega hamein itminan hojayega agar aap ne yeh kardiya toh hamein aap ki risalat par iman ajayega aur hum aap ki dil se tasdeeq karne lagenge aur aap ki buzurgi ke qayil hojayenge. Aap ne farmaya main in cheezon ke sath nahi bheja gaya. In mein se koi kaam mere bas ka nahi. Main toh Allah ki baatein tumheñ pahuñchane ke liye aya hoon. Tum qubool karlo, dono jahan mein khush raho ge. Na qubool karo ge toh main sabr karunga. Allah ke hukm par muntazir rahunga yahan tak ke Parwardigar-e-Alam mujh mein aur tum mein faisla farma de. Unhon ne kaha acha yeh bhi na sahi lijiye hum khud aap ke liye hi tajweez karte hain aap Allah se dua kijiye ke woh koi farishta aap ke paas bheje jo aap ki baaton ki sachai aur tasdeeq kar de aap ki taraf se hame

Naamumkin hai ki hum ise maanein, hum ne aap se sabukdoshi hasil kar li, jo kuch kehna sunna tha keh sun chuke aur aap ne hamari wajibi aur insaaf ki baat bhi nahi mani, ab kaan khol kar hoshiyar ho kar sun lijiye ki hum aap ko is halat mein aazad nahi rakh sakte, ab ya to hum aap ko halak kar denge ya aap hamein tabaah kar denge. Koi kehne laga hum to farishton ko poojte hain jo Allah ki betiyan hain, kisi ne kaha jab tak tu Allah Ta'ala ko aur uske farishton ko khullam khulla hamare paas na laaye hum iman na laayenge. Phir majlis barkhast hui. Abdullah bin Ubayy, Umayyah bin Mughirah bin Abdullah bin Makhzum jo aap ki phuphi Hazrat Atikah bint Abdul Muttalib ka larka tha, aap ke sath ho liya aur kehne laga ki yeh toh badi namunsafi ki baat hai ki kaum ne jo kaha woh bhi aap ne manzoor na kiya, phir jo talab kiya woh bhi aap ne pura na kiya, phir jis cheez se aap unhe darate the woh maanga woh bhi aap ne na kiya, ab toh Allah ki kasam main aap par iman laaunga hi nahi jab tak ki aap seerhi laga kar aasman par chadh kar koi kitab na laaye aur chaar farishte apne sath apne gawah bana kar na laayein. Huzoor ﷺ in tamam baaton se sakht ranjeeda hue. Gaye toh aap bade shauk se the ki shayad kaum ke sardar meri kuch maan lein lekin jab unki sarkashi aur iman se doori aap ne dekhi bade hi maghmoom ho kar wapas apne ghar aaye, ﷺ.

Baat yeh hai ki unki yeh tamam baatein ba-taur kufr-o-inaad aur ba-taur neecha dikhane aur lajawab karne ke theen, warna agar iman laane ke liye naik neeti se yeh sawalat hote toh bahut mumkin tha ki Allah Ta'ala unhe yeh mojeze dikha deta. Chunanche Huzoor ﷺ se farmaya gaya ki agar aap ki chahat ho toh jo yeh maangte hain main dikha dun lekin yeh yaad rahe ki agar phir bhi iman na laaye toh unhe woh ibratnak sazayein dunga jo kisi ko na di hon aur agar aap chahein toh main un par tauba ki qubuliyat ka aur rehmat ka darwaza khula rakhun, aap ne doosri baat pasand far

Jaise farman hai (Inna-llazina haqqat ‘alaihim kalimatu Rabbika la yu’minun) (10. Yunus: 96) yaani jin par tere Rab ki baat sabit ho chuki hai unhein bawajood tamam tar mojzat dekh lene ke bhi iman naseeb na hoga yahan tak ki woh almanaq azabon ka mu’aina na kar lein. Wa lau annan-na al-ayah mein farmaya ke aye Nabi in ki khwahish ke mutabiq agar hum an par farishte bhi nazil farmayein aur murde bhi in se baatein kar lein aur itna hi nahi balki ghaib ki tamam cheezein khulm khula in ke samne zahir kar dein to bhi yeh kafir baghair mashiyat-e-Ilahi iman lane ke nahi in mein se aksar jahalat ke putle hain. Apne liye darya talab karne ke baad unhon ne kaha acha aap hi ke liye baghat aur nahrein ho jayein. Phir kaha ke acha yeh bhi na sahi toh aap kehte hi hain ke qayamat ke din aasman phat jayega, tukde tukde ho jayega toh ab aaj hi hum par iske tukde gira deejiye chunache unhon ne khud bhi Allah Ta'ala se yahi dua ki aye Allah agar yeh sab kuch teri janib se hi barhaq hai hum par aasman se patthar barsa, al-ayah. Shu'aib A.S ki qoum ne bhi yahi khwahish ki thi jis bina par un par saiban ke din ka azab utra. Lekin chunke hamare Nabi Hadhrat Muhammad ﷺ Rahmat-ul-Lil-Alamin aur Nabiy-ut-Taubah thay aap ne Allah se dua ki ke woh inhein halakat se bacha le mumkin hai yeh nahi toh in ki auladein hi iman qubool kar lein, tauhid ikhtiyar kar lein aur shirq chhod dein. Aap ki yeh aarzoo poori hui, azab na utra. Khud un mein se bhi bohat soun ko iman ki doulat naseeb hui yahan tak ke Abdullah bin Umayyah jis ne aakhir mein Hadhrat ke sath ja kar aap ko baatein sunai thin aur iman na lane ki qasmein khayi thin woh bhi Islam ke jhande tale aaye R.A. Zukhruf se murad sona hai balki Ibn Mas'ood R.A ki qirat mein lafz min zahab hai. Kuffar ka aur mutaliba yeh tha ke tere liye sone ka ghar ho jaye ya hamare dekhte hue tu seedhi laga kar aasman par pahunch jaye aur wahan se koi kitab laye jo har ek ke naam ki alag alag ho raton raat un ke sarhane woh parche pahunch jayein un par un ke naam likhe hue hon. Is ke jawab mein hukum huwa ke in se keh do ke Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala ke aage kisi ki kuch nahi chalti woh apni saltanat aur mamlakat ka tanha malik hai jo chahe kare jo na chahe na kare tumhari munh mangi cheez zahir kare na kare yeh us ke ikhtiyar ki baat hai main toh sirf paigham-e-Rab pohnchane wala hoon main ne apna farz ada kar diya ahkaam-e-Ilahi tumhein pohncha diye ab jo tum ne manga woh Allah ki bas ki baat hai na ke mere bas ki. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain Batha-e-Makkah ki babat mujh se farmaya gaya ke agar tum chaho toh main ise sone ka bana doon main ne guzarish ki ke nahi aye Allah meri toh yeh chahat hai ke ek roz peet bhara rahoon aur doosre roz bhooka rahoon main teri taraf jhukoon, tadarru-o-zari karoon aur bakasrat teri yaad karoon. Bhare peet ho jaoon toh teri hamd karoon, tera shukr baja laoon. Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh hadith hai aur Imam Tirmidhi R.H ne ise zaeef kaha hai.

Quraish ke umra ki akhiri koshish. Ibn Abbas (R.A) kehte hain ke Rabia ke jo bete Utba aur Shaiba aur Abu Sufyan bin Harb aur Bani Abd-ud-Dar qabele ke do shakhs aur Abu Al-Bahtari Bani Asad ka aur Aswad bin Muttalib bin Asad aur Zumah bin Aswad aur Waleed bin Mughirah aur Abu Jahl bin Hisham aur Abdullah bin Abi Umayyah aur Umayyah bin Khalaf aur Aas bin Wail aur Nabih aur Munbih Sahmi Hajjaj ke ladke, yeh sab ya in mein se kuch suraj ke ghuroob ho jaane ke baad Ka'batullah ke peeche jama hue aur kehne lage bhai kisi ko bhej kar Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bula lo aur us se keh sun kar aaj faisla kar lo taake koi uzr baqi na rahe. Chunancha qasid gaya aur khabar di ke aap ki qaum ke ashraf log jama hue hain aur aap ko yaad kiya hai. Kyunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko un logon ka har waqt khayal rehta tha, aap ke jee mein aayi ke bahut mumkin hai Allah ne unhe sahi samajh de di ho aur yeh rah-e-rast par aa jayen, is liye aap foran hi tashreef laye. 

Quraishiyon ne aap ko dekhte hi kaha suniye aaj hum aap par hujjat poori kar dete hain taake phir hum par kisi qism ka ilzam na aaye, isi liye hum ne aap ko bulwaya hai. Wallah kisi ne apni qaum ko is museebat mein nahi dala hoga jo museebat tum ne hum par khadi kar rakhi hai, tum hamare baap dadaon ko galiyan dete ho, hamare deen ko bura kehte ho, hamare buzurgon ko bewuqoof batate ho, hamare ma'boodon ko bura kehte ho, tum ne hum mein tafreeq daal di, ladaiyan khadi kar di. Wallah aap ne humein kisi burai ke pohchane mein koi kasar utha nahi rakhi, ab saaf saaf sun lijiye aur soch samajh kar jawab deejiye. 

Agar aap ka irada in tamam baaton se maal jama karne ka hai to hum mojood hain, hum khud aap ko is qandar maal jama kar dete hain ke aap ke barabar hum mein se koi maldar na ho. Aur agar aap ka irada is se yeh hai ke aap hum par sardari karein to lo hum is ke liye bhi tayyar hain, hum aap ki sardari ko tasleem karte hain aur aap ki tabadari manzoor karte hain. Agar aap badshahat ke talib hain to wallah hum aap ki badshahat ka elan kar dete hain aur agar waqai aap ke dimagh mein koi fatoor hai, koi jinn aap ko sata raha hai to hum mojood hain, dil khol kar raqmein kharch kar ke tumhara ilaj mu'alija karenge yahan tak ke aap ko shifa ho jaye ya hum mazoor samajh liye jayen. 

Yeh sab sun kar sardar-e-rusoolan shafi-e-paighambaran (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jawab diya ke suno, bi-hamdillah mujhe koi dimaghi arza ya khalal ya aaseeb nahi, na main apni is risalat ki wajah se maldar banna chahta hoon, na kisi sardari ki tama hai, na badshah banna chahta hoon, balki mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne tum sab ki taraf apna rasool barhaq bana kar bheja hai aur mujh par apni kitab nazil farmai hai aur mujhe hukum diya hai ke main tumhein khushkhabriyaan suna doon aur dara dhamka doon.

Main ne apne Rabb ke paighamat tumheñ pahuñcha diye, tumhari sachi khair khwahi ki, tum agar qubool karlo ge toh dono jahan mein jahan naseeb dar ban jao ge aur agar na-manzoor kardo ge toh main sabr karunga yahan tak ke Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala Shanuh mujh mein aur tum mein sacha faisla farma de (au kama qaal). Ab sardaran-e-qoum ne kaha ke Muhammad ﷺ agar aap ko hamari in baaton mein se ek bhi manzoor nahi toh ab aur suno yeh toh khud tumheñ bhi maloom hai ke hum se ziyada tang shehar kisi aur ka nahi, hum se ziyada kam maal koi qoum nahi, hum se peet peet kar bohat kam rozi hasil karne wali bhi koi qoum nahi toh aap apne Rabb se jis ne aap ko apni risalat de kar bheja hai dua kijiye ke yeh pahad yahan se hata le taake hamara ilaqa kushada hojaye, hamare sheharon ko wusat hojaye. Is mein narein, chashmey aur darya jari hojayein jaise ke Sham aur Iraq mein hain aur yeh bhi dua kijiye ke hamare baap dada zinda hojayein aur un mein Qusayy bin Kilab zaroor ho woh hum mein ek buzurg aur sacha shakhs tha hum us se pooch lenge woh aap ki babat jo keh dega hamein itminan hojayega agar aap ne yeh kardiya toh hamein aap ki risalat par iman ajayega aur hum aap ki dil se tasdeeq karne lagenge aur aap ki buzurgi ke qayil hojayenge. Aap ne farmaya main in cheezon ke sath nahi bheja gaya. In mein se koi kaam mere bas ka nahi. Main toh Allah ki baatein tumheñ pahuñchane ke liye aya hoon. Unhon ne kaha acha yeh bhi na sahi lijiye hum khud aap ke liye hi tajweez karte hain aap Allah se dua kijiye ke woh koi farishta aap ke paas bheje jo aap ki baaton ki sachai aur tasdeeq kar de aap ki taraf se hame

Naamumkin hai ki hum ise maanein, hum ne aap se sabukdoshi hasil kar li, jo kuch kehna sunna tha keh sun chuke aur aap ne hamari wajibi aur insaaf ki baat bhi nahi mani, ab kaan khol kar hoshiyar ho kar sun lijiye ki hum aap ko is halat mein aazad nahi rakh sakte, ab ya to hum aap ko halak kar denge ya aap hamein tabaah kar denge. Uske baad Allah apne lutf-o-karam aur insanon mein se rasoolon ke bhejne ki wajah ko bayan farmata hai aur us hikmat ko zahir farmata hai ke agar farishtey risalat ka kaam anjam dete to na unke paas tum baith uth sakte na unki baatein poori tarah se samajh sakte. Insani rasool chunke tumhare hi hamjins hote hain tum un se ghula mila rakh sakte ho, un ki adaat-o-atwar dekh sakte ho aur mil jul kar un se apni zaban mein taleem hasil kar sakte ho, un ka amal dekh kar khud sikh sakte ho jaise farman hai ayat (Laqad mannal-laha 'alal-muminin) (3. Al-Imran: 164). Aur ayat mein hai (Laqad jaakum rasoolun min anfusikum) al-ayah. Aur ayat mein hai (Kama arsalna fiukum rasoolan minkum yatloo 'alaykum ayatina wa yuzakkikum wa yu'allimukumul-kitaba wal-hikmata wa yu'allimukum ma lam takoonu ta'lamoon) (2. Al-Baqarah: 151). Matlab sab ka yehi hai ke yeh to Allah ka zabardast ehsan hai ke us ne tum mein se hi apne rasool bheje ke woh ayat-e-ilahi tumhein padh kar sunayein, tumhare akhlaq pakeeza karein aur tumhein kitab-o-hikmat sikhayein aur jin cheezon se tum be-ilm thay woh tumhein alim bana dein pas tumhe meri yaad ki kasrat karni chahiye taake main bhi tumhein yaad karun. Tumhein meri shukr guzari karni chahiye aur nashukri se bachna chahiye. Yahan farmata hai ke agar zameen ki abadi farishton ki hoti to beshak hum kisi asmani farishte ko un mein rasool bana kar bhejte chunke tum khud insan ho hum ne isi maslihat se insanon mein se hi apne rasool bana kar tum mein bheje.

Fikri mughaltay aur kuffar aksar log iman se aur rasoolon ki tabadari se isi bina par ruk gaye ke unhein yeh samajh na aya ke koi insan bhi rasool ban sakta hai. Woh is par sakht tar mutajjub hue aur akhir inkar kar baithe aur saaf keh gaye ke kya ek insan hamari rehbari karega? Firaun aur uski kaum ne bhi yehi kaha tha ke hum apne jaise do insanon par iman kaise layein khususan is soorat mein ke unki sari kaum hamare mat-hati mein hai. Al-Imran: 164). Aur ayat mein hai (Laqad jaakum rasoolun min anfusikum) al-ayah. Aur ayat mein hai (Kama arsalna fiukum rasoolan minkum yatloo 'alaykum ayatina wa yuzakkikum wa yu'allimukumul-kitaba wal-hikmata wa yu'allimukum ma lam takoonu ta'lamoon) (2. Al-Baqarah: 151).
