Sadaqat-e-Risalat par Allah ki gawahi: Apni sachai par main aur gawah kyun dhoondoun? Allah ki gawahi kafi hai. Main agar us ki pak zat par tuhmat bandhta hoon toh woh khud mujh se intiqam lega. Chunancha Quran ki Surah Al-Haqqah mein bayan hai ke agar yeh paighambar zabardasti koi baat hamare sar chipka deta toh hum us ka dahina hath tham kar us ki gardan uda dete aur hamein us se koi na rok sakta. Phir farmaya ke kisi bande ka hal Allah se makhfi nahi, woh inam-o-ehsan, hidayat-o-lutf ke kabil logon ko aur gumrahi aur badbakhti ke kabil logon ko bakhubi janta hai.

Maidan-e-Hashar ka ek haolnak manzar Allah Ta'ala is baat ko bayan farmata hai ki tamam makhlooq mein tasarruf sirf usi ka hai, uska koi hukm tal nahi sakta, uske rah dikhaye hue ko koi behka nahi sakta, na uske behkaye hue ki koi rahnumai kar sakta hai, uska wali aur murshid koi nahi ban sakta. Hum unhein oundhe munh maidan-e-qiyamat (Mahshar ke majma') mein layenge. Huzoor ﷺ se sawal hua, yeh kaise ho sakta hai? Aap ne farmaya, jis ne pairon par chalaya hai woh sar ke bal bhi chala sakta hai. Yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai. Musnad mein hai, Hazrat Abu Zar ؓ ne khade ho kar farmaya ki, "Aaye Bani Ghifar qabilay ke logo! Sach kaho aur qasmein na khao, Sadiq-o-Masdooq paighambar ne mujhe yeh hadith sunayi hai ki log teen qisam ke bana kar hashar mein laye jayenge: ek fauj toh khane peene odhne wali, ek chalne aur daudne wali, ek woh jinhein farishtey oundhe munh ghasit kar jahannam ke samne jama karenge." Logon ne kaha, "Do qisameen toh samajh mein aa gayin lekin yeh chalne aur daudne wale samajh mein nahi aaye." Aap ne farmaya, "Sawariyon par aafat aa jayegi yahan tak ki ek insan apna hara bhara bagh de kar palan wali oontni khareedna chahega lekin na mil sakegi." Yeh us waqt nabina honge, bezuban honge, kuch bhi na sun sakenge, gharz mukhtatif haal honge aur gunahon ki shamat mein gunahon ke mutabiq giraftar kiye jayenge. Duniya mein haq se andhe, behre aur goonge bane rahe, aaj saxt ehtiyaaj wale din, sach much andhe, behre, goonge bana diye gaye. Unka asli thikana, ghoom phir kar aane aur rehne sehne basne theharne ki jagah jahannam qarar di gayi. Wahan ki aag jahan madham padne ko aayi aur bhadka di gayi, saxt tez kar di gayi, jaise farmaya aayat: (Fazoqu fa lan nazeedakum illa azaba 30) (78. An-Naba: 30) yaani ab saza bardasht karo, siwaye azab ke koi cheez tumhein zyada na di jayegi.

Bosida haddiyan phir tawana hongi. Farman hai ke ooper jin munkiron ko jis saza ka zikr hua hum wohi usi ke qabil thay, woh hamari daleelon ko jhoot samajhte thay aur qayamat ke qayil hi na thay aur saaf kehte thay ke bosida haddiyan hojane ke baad, mitti ke rezon se mil jane ke baad, halak aur barbad ho chukne ke baad ka dobara ji uthna to aql ke bahar hai. 

Pas un ke jawab mein Quran ne is ki ek daleel pesh ki ke is zabardast qudrat ke malik ne aasman-o-zameen ko baghair kisi cheez ke awwal bar bila namoona paida kiya jis ki qudrat in buland-o-bala, wasee aur sakht makhlooq ki ibtidai paidaish se ajiz nahi. Kya woh tumhein dobara paida karne se ajiz hojaye ga? 

Aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish to tumhari paidaish se bohat bari hai, woh in ke paida karne mein nahi thaka, kya woh murdon ko zinda karne se be-ikhtiyar hojaye ga? Kya aasman-o-zameen ka khaliq insano jese aur paida nahi kar sakta? Beshak kar sakta hai, us ka hukm hi cheez ke wajood ke liye kafi wafi hai. 

Woh unhein qayamat ke din dobara nayi paidaish mein zaroor aur qatan paida karega, us ne un ke aada ki, un ki qabron se nikal khare hone ki muddat muqarrar kar rakhi hai. Us waqt yeh sab kuch ho kar rahega, yahan ki qadray takheer sirf moeyna waqt ko poora karne ke liye hai. 

Afsos, kis qadar wazeh dalaail ke baad bhi log kufr-o-zalalat ko nahi chortay.

Insani fitrat ka nafsiyati tajziya insani tabiyat ka khasa bayan ho raha hai ke Rahmat-e-Ilahi jaisi nah kam hone wali cheezon par bhi agar yeh qabiz ho jaye toh wahan bhi apni bakhili aur tang-dili nah chhodein. Jaise aur ayat mein hai ke agar mulk ke kisi hisse ke yeh maalik ho jayein toh kisi ko ek kodi rakhne ko nah dein. Pas yeh insani tabiyat hai, haan jo Allah ki taraf se hidayat kiye jayein aur taufeeq-e-khair diye jayein woh is bad-khaslat se nafrat karte hain, woh sakhi aur doosron ka bhala karne wale hote hain. Insan bada hi jald-baz hai, takleef ke waqt ladkhada jata hai aur rahat ke waqt bhool jata hai aur doosron ke faide se apne hath rokne lagta hai, haan namazi log is se bari hain, al-akh. Aisi ayatein Quran mein aur bhi bahut si hain. Is se Allah ke fazl-o-karam, us ki bakhshish-o-rahm ka pata chalta hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke din raat ka kharch Allah ke hath mein hai, is mein koi kami nahi lata, ibtida se ab tak ke kharch ne bhi us ke khazane mein koi kami nahi ki.

Panch mojize Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko toh aise mojize mile jo Aap ki nubuwwat ki sadaqat aur nubuwwat par khuli daleel thi. Lakri, haath, qaht, darya, toofan, tiddiyan, jooyen, mendak aur khoon. Yeh thin tafseel waar aayatein. Muhammad bin Ka'ab ka qaul hai ki yeh mojize yeh hain: haath ka chamkila ban jana, lakri ka saanp hojana aur paanch woh jin ka bayaan Surah A'raf mein hai aur maalon ka mit jana aur patthar. Ibn Abbas waghera se marwi hai ki yeh mojize Aap ka haath, Aap ki lakri, qaht saaliyan, phalon ki kami, toofan, tiddiyan, jooyen, mendak aur khoon hain. Yeh qaul zyada zahir, bahut saaf, behtar aur qawi hai. Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) ne in mein se qaht saali aur phalon ki kami ko ek gin kar nawaan mojiza Aap ki lakri ka jadugaron ke saanpon ko kha jana bayaan kiya hai. Lekin in tamam mojizon ke bawajood Fir'awniyon ne takabbur kiya aur gunhgari par are rahe bawajoodike dil yaqeen la chuka tha magar zulm-o-ziyadati kar ke kufr-o-inkar par jam gaye. Agli aayaton se in aayaton ka rabt yeh hai ki jaise Aap ki kaum Aap se mojize talab karti hai aise hi Fir'awniyon ne bhi Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) se mojize talab kiye jo zahir hue lekin unhein iman naseeb na hua aakhirsh halak kar diye gaye. Isi tarah agar Aap ki kaum bhi mojizon ke aajane ke baad kafir rahi toh phir mohlat na milegi aur foran tabaah barbaad kar di jayegi. Khud Fir'awn ne mojize dekhne ke baad Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko jadugar keh kar apna peecha chura liya. Pas yahan jin nau nishaniyon ka bayaan hai yeh wahi hain aur in ka bayaan "Wa alqi asaka" se "qouman fasiqeen" tak mein hai, in aayaton ka bayaan Surah A'raf mein hai. In ke alawa bhi Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko bahut se mojize diye the misal ke taur par Aap ki lakri ke lagne se ek patthar mein se barah chashmon ka jari hojana, baadal ka saya karna, Mann-o-Salwa ka utarna waghera waghera. Yeh sab neamatein Bani Israel ko Misr ke shehar chhorne ke baad milin pas in mojizon ko yahan is liye bayaan nahi farmaya ki woh Fir'awniyon ne dekhe the aur unhein jhutlaya tha. Musnd-e-Ahmad mein hai ki ek yahudi ne apne sathi se kaha chal toh zara is Nabi se un ke Quran ki is aayat ke bare mein pooch lein ki Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko woh nau aayatein kya mili thin? Doosre ne kaha Nabi na keh, sun liya toh us ki chaar aankhein hojayengi. Ab dono ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya, Aap ne farmaya: Yeh ki Allah ke sath kisi ko shareek na karo, chori na karo, zina na karo, kisi jaan ko na-haq qatal na karo, jadoo na karo, sood na khao, be-gunah logon ko pakad kar baadshah ke darbaar mein na le jao ki use qatal kara do aur paak daman aurton par buhtan na bandho, ya farmaya jehad se na bhago. Aur aey yahudiyon! Tum par khaas kar yeh hukm bhi tha ki hafte ke din ziadati na karo. Ab toh woh be-sakhta Aap ke haath paaun choomne lage aur kehne lage hamari gawahi hai ki Aap Allah ke Nabi hain. Aap ne farmaya phir tum meri tabadari kyun nahi karte?

Kehne lage Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki thi ke meri nasl mein nabi zaroor rahenge aur humein khauf hai ke aap ki tabadari ke baad yahood humein zinda chhodenge. Tirmizi, Nasai aur Ibn Majah mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Imam Tirmizi (Rahimahullah) ise Hasan Sahih batlate hain lekin hai zara mushkil kaam is liye ke is ke rawi Abdullah bin Salamah ke hafiz mein qadray qusoor hai aur un par jarh bhi hai, mumkin hai no kalmaat ka shubh no ayaat se unhein ho gaya ho is liye ke yeh Taurat ke ahkaam hain, Firaun par hujjat qayim karne wali yeh cheezein nahi. Wallahu A'lam. Isi liye Firaun se Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne farmaya ke Aai Firaun yeh to tujhe bhi maloom hai ke yeh sab maujize sachhe hain aur in mein se ek ek meri sachchai ki jeeti jaagti daleel hai, mera khayal hai ke tu halak hona chahta hai, Allah ki laanat tujh par utra hi chahti hai, tu maghloob hoga aur tabahi ko pahuchega. Masboor ke maani halak hone ke is sher mein bhi hain: 
Iza jara-ash-shaitanu fi sunan-il-ghayyi wa man mala mailahu masboor 
Yaani shaitan ke dost halak shuda hain. 
Alimta ki doosri qiraat alimta te ke zabar ke badle te ke pesh se bhi hai lekin jamhoor ki qiraat te ke zabar se hi hai. Aur isi maani ko wazahat se isi aayat mein bayaan farmata hai (Wa jahadoo biha wa istaiqanatha anfusuhum zulman wa uluwwan fanzur kaifa kana aqibat-ul-mufsideen) (Surah An-Naml: 14). Yaani jab un ke paas hamari zahir aur baseerat afroz nishaniyan pahunch chukin to woh bole ke yeh to khula hua jadoo hai, yeh keh kar munkireen inkar kar baithe halanki un ke dilon mein yaqin aa chuka tha lekin sirf zulm aur ziyadati ki raah se na mane, Al-Akhir. 

Al-Gharz yeh saaf baat hai ke jin no nishaniyon ka zikr huwa hai yeh asa, haath, qaht-saali, phalon ki kam paidawari, tiddiyan, joaein, mendak aur dam (khoon) thien. Jo Firaun aur us ki kaum ke liye Allah ki taraf se daleel-o-burhan tha aur aap ke maujize the jo aap ki sachchai aur Allah ke wajood par dalail the, in no nishaniyon se murad ahkaam nahi jo upar ki hadith mein bayaan hue kyunke woh Firaun aur firaniyon par hujjat hone aur un ahkaam ke bayaan hone ke darmiyan koi munasibat hi nahi. Yeh waham sirf Abdullah bin Salamah rawi-e-hadith ki wajah se logon ko paida huwa, us ki baaz baatein waqai qabil-e-inkar hain, Wallahu A'lam. Bahut mumkin hai ke in dono yahudiyon ne das kalmaat ka sawal kiya ho aur rawi ko no aayaton ka waham reh gaya ho. 

Firaun ne irada kiya ke unhein jala-watan kar diya jaye. Pas hum ne khud use machhliyon ka luqma banaya aur us ke tamam sathiyon ko bhi. Us ke baad hum ne Bani Israel se keh diya ke ab zameen tumhari hai, raho, saho, khao, piyo. Is aayat mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bhi zabardast basharat hai ke Makkah aap ke haathon fateh hoga. Halanki surat Makki hai, hijrat se pehle nazil hui.

Waqai mein hua bhi isi tarah ke Ahl-e-Makkah ne aap ko Makkah Sharif se nikal dena chaha jese Quran ne aayat (Wa in kadoo layastafizzoonaka min al-ardi liyukhrijooka minha wa iza la yalbasoonaa khilafaka illa qaleela) (17. Al-Isra: 76) mein bayan farmaya hai phir Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi-e-Kareem ﷺ ko ghalib kiya aur Makkah ka malik bana diya aur fatihana haisiyat se aap baad az jang Makkah mein aaye aur yahan apna qabza kiya aur phir apne hilm-o-karam se kaam le kar Makkah ke mujrimon ko aur apne jaani dushmanon ko aam taur par muafi ata farma di, ﷺ. Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala ne Bani Israel jaisi zaeef kaum ko mashriqu-maghrib ka waris bana diya tha aur Firaun jese sakht aur mutakabbir badshah ke maal, zameen, phal, kheti aur khazanon ka malik kar diya jese aayat (Kazaalika wa aurasnaaha Bani Israil) (26. Ash-Shu'ara: 59) mein bayan hua hai. Yahan bhi farmata hai ki Firaun ki halakat ke baad hum ne Bani Israel se farmaya ki ab tum yahan raho saho, Qiyamat ke waade ke din tum aur tumhare dushman sab hamare samne ikatthe laye jaaoge, hum tum sab ko jama kar layenge.

Iza jara-ash-shaitanu fi sunan-il-ghayyi wa man mala mailahu masboor

Lakri, haath, qaht, darya, toofan, tiddiyan, jooyen, mendak aur khoon. Yeh thin tafseel waar aayatein. Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) ne in mein se qaht saali aur phalon ki kami ko ek gin kar nawaan mojiza Aap ki lakri ka jadugaron ke saanpon ko kha jana bayaan kiya hai. In ke alawa bhi Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko bahut se mojize diye the misal ke taur par Aap ki lakri ke lagne se ek patthar mein se barah chashmon ka jari hojana, baadal ka saya karna, Mann-o-Salwa ka utarna waghera waghera. Yeh sab neamatein Bani Israel ko Misr ke shehar chhorne ke baad milin pas in mojizon ko yahan is liye bayaan nahi farmaya ki woh Fir'awniyon ne dekhe the aur unhein jhutlaya tha. Doosre ne kaha Nabi na keh, sun liya toh us ki chaar aankhein hojayengi. Ab dono ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya, Aap ne farmaya: Yeh ki Allah ke sath kisi ko shareek na karo, chori na karo, zina na karo, kisi jaan ko na-haq qatal na karo, jadoo na karo, sood na khao, be-gunah logon ko pakad kar baadshah ke darbaar mein na le jao ki use qatal kara do aur paak daman aurton par buhtan na bandho, ya farmaya jehad se na bhago. Wahan se mutafarriq thoda thoda kar ke waqeat ke mutabiq teis baras mein duniya par nazil huwa. Iski dusri qirat Farqnah hai yaani ek ek ayat kar ke tafseer aur tafseel aur tabyeen ke sath utara hai ke tu ise logo ko ba-sahulat pohancha de aur ahista ahista unhe suna de hum ne ise thoda thoda kar ke nazil farmaya hai.

Sama'at-e-Quran-e-Azim ke baad farman hai ki tumhare iman par sadaqat-e-Quran mauquf nahi, tum mano ya na mano Quran fi nafsihi Kalamullah aur beshak barhaq hai. Iska zikr to hamesha se qadeem kitabon mein chala aa raha hai. Jo Ahl-e-Kitab, saleh aur amil-e-Kitabullah hain, jinhone agli kitabon mein koi tehreef-o-tabdeeli nahi ki, woh to is Quran ko sunte hi be-chain ho kar shukriya ka sajda karte hain ki Allah tera shkar hai ki tune hamari maujudgi mein is Rasul ko bheja aur is kalam ko nazil farmaya. Apne Rab ki qudrat-e-kamila par uski ta'zim-o-tauqeer karte hain. Jante the ki Allah ka wada sacha hai, ghalat nahi hota. Aaj woh wada poora dekh kar khush hote hain, apne Rab ki tasbeeh bayan karte hain aur uske wade ki sachai ka ikrar karte hain. Khushoo-o-khuzoo, farutani aur aajizi ke sath rote gar-garate Allah ke samne apni thudiyon ke bal sajde mein gir parte hain, iman-o-tasdeeq aur Kalam-e-Ilahi aur Rasulullah ki wajah se woh iman-o-islam mein, hidayat-o-taqwa mein, dar aur khauf mein aur barh jaate hain. Yeh atf sifat ka sifat par hai sajde ka sajde par nahi.

Rahman ya Rahim? Kuffar Allah ki rahmat ki sifat ke munkir thay us ka naam Rahman nahi samajhte thay to Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala apne nafs ke liye is naam ko sabit karta hai aur farmata hai ke yehi nahi ke Allah ka naam Allah ho, Rahman ho ya Rahim aur ism in ke siwa bhi bahut se behtareen aur ahsan naam is ke hain. Jis pak naam se chaho us se duayein karo. Surah Hashr ke aakhir mein bhi apne bahut se naam is ne bayan farmaye hain. Ek mushrik ne Huzoor ﷺ se sajde ki halat mein ya Rahman ya Rahim sun kar kaha ke lijiye ye muwahid hain do maboodon ko pukarte hain is par ye ayat utri. Phir farmata hai apni namaz ko bahut oonchi aawaz se na padho. Is ayat ke nuzool ke waqt Huzoor ﷺ Makkah mein poshida thay jab sahaba ko namaz padhate aur buland aawaz se is mein qirat padhte to mushrikin Quran ko, Allah ko, Rasul ko galiyan dete is liye hukm hua ke is qadar buland aawaz se padhne ki zarurat nahi ke mushrikin sunein aur galiyan bakein haan aisa ahista bhi na padhna ke aap ke sathi bhi na sun sakein balki darmiyani aawaz se qirat kiya karo. Phir jab aap hijrat kar ke Madine pahuche toh yeh takleef jati rahi ab jis tarah chahein padhein. Mushrikin jahan Quran ki tilawat shuru hoti toh bhag khade hote. Agar koi sunna chahta toh un ke khof ke mare chhup chhup kar bach bacha kar kuch sun leta. Lekin jahan mushrikon ko maloom hua toh unhon ne unhein sakht eza-dahi shuru ki ab agar bahut buland aawaz karein toh un ki chidh aur un ki galiyon ka khayal aur agar bahut past kar lein toh woh jo chupe lage kaan lagaye baithe hain woh mahroom is liye darmiyani aawaz se qirat karne ka hukm hua. Al-Gharz namaz ki qirat ke bare mein yeh ayat nazil hui hai. Marwi hai ke Hazrat Abu Bakr ؓ apni namaz mein past aawaz se qirat padhte thay aur Hazrat Umar ؓ ba-aawaz buland qirat padha karte thay. Hazrat Siddiq Akbar ؓ se pucha gaya ke aap ahista kyun padhte hain? Aap ne jawab diya ke apne Rab se sargoshi hai woh meri hajaton ka ilm rakhta hai toh farmaya ke yeh bahut achha hai. Hazrat Umar ؓ se pucha ke aap buland aawaz se kyun padhte hain? Aap ne farmaya shaitan ko bhagata hu aur soton ko jagata hu toh aap se bhi farmaya gaya bahut achha hai lekin jab yeh ayat utri toh Hazrat Abu Bakr ؓ se qadre buland aawaz karne ko aur Hazrat Umar Farooq ؓ se qadre past aawaz karne ko farmaya gaya. Ibn Abbas ؓ farmate hain yeh ayat dua ke bare mein nazil hui hai isi tarah Thawri aur Malik Hisham bin Urwah se woh apne baap se woh Hazrat Ayesha se riwayat karte hain aap farmati hain ke yeh ayat dua ke bare mein nazil hui hai yehi qoul Hazrat Mujahid, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair, Hazrat Abu Ayaz, Hazrat Makhool, Hazrat Urwah bin Zubair Rahimahumullah ka bhi hai. Marwi hai ke Banu Tamim qabeela ka ek a'rabi jab bhi Huzoor ﷺ namaz se salam pherte yeh dua karta ke Allah mujhe oont ata farma mujhe aulaad de pas yeh ayat utri. Ek doosra qoul yeh bhi hai ke yeh ayat tashahhud ke bare mein nazil hui hai.

Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke murad is se yeh hai ke na to riya kari karo na amal chhodo. Yeh bhi karo ke alaniya to umda kar ke padho aur khufiya bura kar ke padho. Ahl-e-Kitab poshida padhte aur usi darmiyan koi fiqra bahut buland awaz se cheekh kar zaban se nikaalte is par sab sath mil kar shor macha dete to un ki muwafaqat se mamanat hui aur jis tarah aur log chhupate the is se bhi roka gaya phir is ke darmiyan ka rasta Hazrat Jibril (A.S) ne batlaya jo Huzoor (ﷺ) ne masnoon farmaya hai. Allah ki hamd karo jis mein tamam tar kamalat aur pakeezgi ki sifathein hain. Jis ke tamam tar behtareen naam hain jo tamam tar nuqsanaat se paak hai. Us ki aulad nahi, us ka shareek nahi, woh Wahid hai, Samad hai, na us ke maa baap, na aulad, na us ki jins ka koi aur, na woh aisa haqeer ke kisi ki himayat ka mohtaj ho ya wazeer-o-maseer ki use haajat ho balkih tamam cheezon ka khaliq malik sirf wahi hai sab ka mudabbir muqaddar wahi hai usi ki mashiyyat tamam makhlooq mein chalti hai woh Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu hai na us ki kisi se bhai bandi hai na woh kisi ki madad ka talib hai. To har waqt us ki azmat jalalat kibriyai badai aur buzurgi bayan karta rah aur mushrikeen jo tumhein is par bandhte hain to un se us ki zat ki buzurgi burai aur pakeezgi bayan karta rah. Yahood-o-Nasara to kehte the ke Allah ki aulad hai. Mushrikeen kehte the Labbaik La Sharika Laka Illa Shariqan Huwa Laka Tamlakuha Wa Ma Malaq yaani hum hazir bash ghulam hain اے Allah tera koi shareek nahi lekin jo khud teri malkiyat mein hain tu hi un ka aur un ki malkiyat ka malik hai. Sabi aur Majoosi kehte the ke agar Awliyaullah na hon to Allah sare nizaam aap nahi kar sakta. Is par yeh ayat utri aur un sab batil parastoon ki tardeed kar di gayi. Nabi Kareem (ﷺ) apne ghar ke tamam chhote bade logon ko yeh ayat sikhaya karte the. Aap ne is ayat ka naam Ayat-ul-Izz yaani izzat wali ayat rakha hai. Ba'z asar mein hai ke jis ghar mein raat ko yeh ayat padhi jaye is ghar mein koi aafat ya chori nahi ho sakti Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) farmate hain ke main Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sath nikla mera hath aap ke hath mein tha ya aap ka hath mere hath mein tha rah chalte ek shakhs ko aap ne dekha nihayat radi halat mein hai us se poocha ke kya baat hai? Us ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) bimariyon aur nuqsanaat ne meri yeh durgat kar rakhi hai aap ne farmaya kya main tumhe kuch wazifa bata dun ke yeh dukh bimari sab kuch jati rahe? Us ne kaha haan haan ya Rasoolallah (ﷺ) zaroor batlaye Uhad aur Badr mein aap ke sath na hone ka afsos mera jata rahega is par aap hans pade aur farmaya tu badri aur uhadi sahabah ke martabe ko kahan se pa sakta hai tu un ke muqabale mein mahz khali hath aur be-sarmaya hai. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne kaha ya Rasoolallah (ﷺ) unhe jaane dijiye aap mujhe batla dijiye.

Aap ne farmaya Abu Huraira R.A yun kaho: "Tawakkaltu 'alal-laziy la yamutu, al-hamdulillahil-laziy lam yattakhiz walada" al-akh. Main ne yeh wazifa parhna shuru kar diya tha, chand din guzray thay ke meri halat bahut hi sanwar gayi. Huzoor ﷺ ne mujhe dekha aur poocha: "Abu Huraira R.A, yeh kya hai?" Main ne kaha: "In kalmat ki wajah se Allah ki taraf se barkat hai jo aap ne mujhe sikhaye thay." Iski sanad zaeef hai aur iske matan mein bhi nakarat hai. Ise Hafiz Abu Ya'la apni kitab mein laye hain, Wallahu A'lam.
